definition_en: used after a number to say the hour
example1_en: The gates close at six o'clock.
example1_zh: 大门六点钟关。
example2_en: Please be in the lab at nine o'clock, not ten past, because the demonstration starts on time.
example2_zh: 请九点到实验室，不要九点十分，演示会准时开始。
collocations: at six o'clock｜在六点 ; two o'clock｜两点钟
tip_zh: 只跟整点：three o'clock。3:15 不说 three fifteen o'clock。参考表标成名词，本卡按副词。

definition_en: starting at a place, time, or source
example1_en: This postcard is from my cousin in Nanjing.
example1_zh: 这张明信片是南京的表哥寄来的。
example2_en: Ideas from different subjects can be combined when students explain a real problem in their town.
example2_zh: 学生解释家乡的真实问题时，可以结合不同学科的想法。
collocations: from now on｜从现在起 ; come from｜来自 ; far from｜远离
tip_zh: from...to... 表示从……到……，时间和地点都可以用。

definition_en: ornaments such as rings and necklaces
example1_en: She keeps jewellery in a locked box.
example1_zh: 她把珠宝放在上锁的盒子里。
example2_en: The museum does not allow jewellery near the open tanks, because a ring can fall in.
example2_zh: 博物馆不允许珠宝靠近敞开的水箱，因为戒指可能掉进去。
collocations: a piece of jewellery｜一件珠宝 ; costume jewellery｜人造珠宝
word_family: jewel (n. 宝石) ; jeweller (n. 珠宝商)
tip_zh: 英式 jewellery 不可数。一件说 a piece of jewellery。美式 jewelry 已另列。

definition_en: the town or city where you grew up
example1_en: His hometown is a small port.
example1_zh: 他的家乡是一个小港口。
example2_en: She returns to her hometown every spring to see the people who taught her to read.
example2_zh: 她每年春天回乡，去看教她识字的那些人。
collocations: one's hometown｜某人的家乡 ; hometown food｜家乡菜
tip_zh: hometown 是一个词。故乡的国土感更强时可用 homeland。

definition_en: having a lot of rain
example1_en: A rainy Monday kept us indoors.
example1_zh: 下雨的星期一让我们待在室内。
example2_en: On rainy days the team practises in the hall and leaves the muddy field alone.
example2_zh: 雨天队伍在礼堂训练，不去动那片泥地。
collocations: a rainy day｜雨天 ; the rainy season｜雨季
word_family: rain (n. 雨) ; rain (v. 下雨) ; rainfall (n. 降雨量)
tip_zh: rainy 形容天气或季节。下雨的动作是 rain。降雨量 rainfall 本库另有一条。

definition_en: a piece of clothing hanging from the waist
example1_en: Her skirt caught on the back of the chair.
example1_zh: 她的裙子挂在了椅背上。
example2_en: The costume skirt is too long for the dance, so a parent will hem it tonight.
example2_zh: 演出的裙子跳舞太长，今晚会有家长把它改短。
collocations: a long skirt｜长裙 ; skirt length｜裙长
tip_zh: 裙子是 skirt。衬衫是 shirt。只差一个字母。

definition_en: a woman who serves food in a restaurant
example1_en: The waitress recommended the soup.
example1_zh: 女服务员推荐了汤。
example2_en: Thank the waitress when the plate arrives, and ask her to repeat a word you did not catch.
example2_zh: 盘子端上来时向女服务员道谢，没听清的词请她再说一遍。
collocations: a friendly waitress｜和气的女服务员 ; work as a waitress｜当女服务员
word_family: waiter (n. 男服务员) ; wait (v. 服务；等候)
tip_zh: waitress 指女性。和本批的 waiter 成对。性别不明时用 server 更稳妥。

definition_en: trousers of strong cotton cloth
example1_en: He wore jeans under the lab coat.
example1_zh: 他在实验服里面穿了牛仔裤。
example2_en: The jeans had a hole at one knee, so he changed before the interview.
example2_zh: 牛仔裤有一边膝盖破了，所以面试前他换了衣服。
collocations: a pair of jeans｜一条牛仔裤 ; blue jeans｜蓝牛仔裤
tip_zh: jeans 作复数。一条牛仔裤是 a pair of jeans，不是 a jeans。

definition_en: a long curved yellow fruit
example1_en: She shared a banana with her deskmate.
example1_zh: 她和同桌分了一根香蕉。
example2_en: The banana in his bag was too ripe, and it left a brown mark on the notebook.
example2_zh: 他包里的香蕉太熟了，在笔记本上留下一块褐色印子。
collocations: a banana｜一根香蕉 ; a bunch of bananas｜一串香蕉
tip_zh: 一根香蕉是 a banana。一串是 a bunch of bananas。

definition_en: belonging to her
example1_en: The green bag is hers, not mine.
example1_zh: 绿包是她的，不是我的。
example2_en: I picked up two coats, then remembered the grey one is hers and put it back.
example2_zh: 我拿起两件外套，忽然想起灰的那件是她的，就放了回去。
collocations: a friend of hers｜她的一个朋友 ; of hers｜她的
tip_zh: hers 后面不再加名词。her book 用 her，the book is hers 用 hers。

definition_en: used for a point in time or place
example1_en: We meet at the school gate at seven.
example1_zh: 我们七点在校门口见面。
example2_en: Looking at screens late at night can make it harder for teenagers to fall asleep.
example2_zh: 深夜看屏幕会让青少年更难入睡。
collocations: at night｜在夜里 ; at least｜至少 ; be good at｜擅长
tip_zh: 钟点和较小地点用 at；街道、城市一般用 in。

definition_en: a container for cut flowers
example1_en: The vase holds three branches.
example1_zh: 花瓶里插着三根枝条。
example2_en: Move the vase off the piano before rehearsal, because a bump would send water onto the keys.
example2_zh: 排练前把花瓶从钢琴上挪走，碰一下水就会洒到琴键上。
collocations: a flower vase｜花瓶 ; in the vase｜在花瓶里
tip_zh: 英式 vase 常读 /vɑːz/，美式常读 /veɪs/。两种都对，跟词条音标走。

definition_en: to do something repeatedly in order to improve
example1_en: Practise the scale before the song.
example1_zh: 唱歌之前先练音阶。
example2_en: Musicians practise slowly at first, then raise the speed only when the notes stay clean.
example2_zh: 乐手起初练得很慢，只有音符仍然干净时才把速度加上去。
collocations: practise doing｜练习做 ; practise the piano｜练钢琴
word_family: practice (n. 练习) ; practised (adj. 熟练的)
tip_zh: practise 是英式动词。名词练习是 practice，已在库里。美式也用 practice 作动词。practise doing，不说 practise to do。

definition_en: a person who plays or writes music
example1_en: A musician from the city band played at the fair.
example1_zh: 市乐队的一位乐师在集市上演奏。
example2_en: The musician stopped twice so the students could copy the rhythm on the board.
example2_zh: 乐师停了两次，让学生把节奏抄到黑板上。
collocations: a musician｜一位音乐家 ; a professional musician｜职业乐师
tip_zh: musician 是人。music 是音乐，musical 可以是音乐剧或形容词。

definition_en: a large shop that sells food and other goods
example1_en: The supermarket closes at ten.
example1_zh: 超市十点关门。
example2_en: We met at the supermarket entrance because the bus stop beside it has a roof.
example2_zh: 我们在超市门口见面，因为旁边的公交站有棚。
collocations: at the supermarket｜在超市 ; a supermarket shelf｜超市货架
word_family: market (n. 市场) ; superstore (n. 大型超市)
tip_zh: 在超市购物用 at the supermarket。比它小的食品店是 a grocery。

definition_en: a soft red fruit eaten as a vegetable
example1_en: Slice one tomato for the noodles.
example1_zh: 切一个番茄下面条。
example2_en: The cook washed every tomato under the tap, then kept the soft ones for soup.
example2_zh: 厨师把每个番茄都在水龙头下洗了，软的留着做汤。
collocations: tomato sauce｜番茄酱 ; a slice of tomato｜一片番茄
tip_zh: 复数是 tomatoes，要加 es，不是 tomatos。

definition_en: a person from another country
example1_en: A foreigner asked the way to the museum.
example1_zh: 一位外国人问路去博物馆。
example2_en: The foreigner visiting the school shared a song from home, and the class learned the chorus.
example2_zh: 来学校访问的外国朋友分享了家乡的一首歌，全班学会了副歌。
collocations: a foreigner abroad｜在国外的外国人 ; treat a foreigner kindly｜善待外国人
tip_zh: foreign 已在库里。foreigner 是人。写作时具体、尊重，不要用这个词去贴刻板印象。

definition_en: a flying vehicle with wings and an engine
example1_en: The airplane landed ten minutes early.
example1_zh: 飞机早到了十分钟。
example2_en: From the airplane the river looked like a silver line between dark fields.
example2_zh: 从飞机上看，河像一条银线，夹在深色的田野之间。
collocations: by airplane｜乘飞机 ; airplane ticket｜飞机票
tip_zh: 美式拼作 airplane。英式常作 aeroplane。坐飞机是 by airplane。

meanings_zh: conj. 引导从句，无实义 | pron. 那；那个
definition_en: used to introduce a clause | the one already mentioned
example1_en: I think that the answer is right.
example1_zh: 我认为这个答案是对的。
example2_en: Researchers argue that regular sleep is as important as extra lessons for students under exam pressure.
example2_zh: 研究者认为，对备考压力大的学生来说，规律睡眠和额外补课一样重要。
collocations: so that｜以便 ; that is｜也就是说
tip_zh: 引导宾语从句的 that 可以省略，但写作里保留更清楚。

definition_en: a light frame covered with paper or cloth, flown in the wind
example1_en: The kite caught in the tree.
example1_zh: 风筝挂在了树上。
example2_en: Hold the kite until the wind is steady, then let the line out a little at a time.
example2_zh: 等风稳定了再抓住风筝，然后一次放出一点线。
collocations: fly a kite｜放风筝 ; a kite string｜风筝线
tip_zh: 高考里 kite 几乎总是风筝。它也可以是一种鸟，那不是这条的重点。放风筝注意电线。

definition_en: mathematics, in British English
example1_en: Maths homework is on page 40.
example1_zh: 数学作业在第 40 页。
example2_en: She likes maths because a wrong step can be found and corrected on the same line.
example2_zh: 她喜欢数学，因为错的一步能在同一行里找出来改掉。
collocations: maths teacher｜数学老师 ; be good at maths｜数学好
word_family: mathematics (n. 数学) ; mathematical (adj. 数学的)
tip_zh: 英式 maths 带 s，仍作单数：maths is fun。美式 math 已在库里，不合并。

definition_en: to say hello, or to react to something in a particular way
example1_en: Greet guests at the door by name.
example1_zh: 在门口按名字问候客人。
example2_en: The crowd did not greet the news with cheers; they waited to hear the full score.
example2_zh: 人群没有用欢呼迎接这个消息，他们等着听完整比分。
collocations: greet sb with｜以……问候某人 ; greet the new year｜迎接新年
word_family: greeting (n. 问候) ; greetings (n. 贺词)
tip_zh: greet sb。名词 a greeting。贺卡上的 greetings 常用复数。

meanings_zh: modal v. 将；愿意 | n. 意愿；遗嘱
definition_en: used for the future, or for willingness | a desire, or a legal document about one's property
example1_en: I will call you after the meeting.
example1_zh: 散会后我会给你打电话。
example2_en: A city that will face water shortages needs to teach children why saving water matters.
example2_zh: 一座将面临缺水的城市，需要让孩子明白为什么节水重要。
collocations: will be able to｜将能够
tip_zh: will 表示将来或意愿；遗嘱这一名词读音相同，写作里要靠词性区分。

definition_en: a folding cover on a stick that keeps off rain
example1_en: Take an umbrella; the sky is dark.
example1_zh: 带把伞，天阴了。
example2_en: Her umbrella turned inside out in the wind, so they shared mine for the last block.
example2_zh: 她的伞被风吹翻了，最后一条街我们合用我的。
collocations: put up an umbrella｜撑开伞 ; umbrella stand｜伞架
tip_zh: 伞是 umbrella。雨伞雨天用。阳伞也可以是 umbrella 或 parasol。

definition_en: used for an agent, a deadline, or a means
example1_en: The poster was drawn by our art group.
example1_zh: 这张海报是我们美术小组画的。
example2_en: Please hand in the form by Friday so that the school can arrange seats before the test.
example2_zh: 请在周五前交表，以便学校在考试前排好座位。
collocations: by bus｜乘公共汽车 ; by the way｜顺便说 ; by oneself｜独自
tip_zh: by 加交通工具时不用冠词：by bus。截止时间也用 by。

definition_en: a piece of clothing for the legs, used as a plural
example1_en: Those grey trousers need a hem.
example1_zh: 那条灰裤子需要改裤脚。
example2_en: Pack a dry pair of trousers for the field walk, because the grass stays wet until noon.
example2_zh: 野外步行再带一条干裤子，因为草到中午还是湿的。
collocations: a pair of trousers｜一条裤子 ; trouser pockets｜裤兜
tip_zh: trousers 是复数，动词用 are。一条裤子说 a pair of trousers。美式常说 pants。

definition_en: intended for someone, or lasting a length of time
example1_en: This seat is for our class monitor.
example1_zh: 这个座位是给我们班长的。
example2_en: Schools that set aside time for reading often see students become more willing to discuss difficult texts.
example2_zh: 留出阅读时间的学校，常常发现学生更愿意讨论难懂的文章。
collocations: for example｜例如 ; wait for｜等待 ; for a long time｜很长时间
tip_zh: for 接一段时间；since 接时间点。

definition_en: a sweet brown fizzy drink
example1_en: He bought a bottle of coke after practice.
example1_zh: 训练后他买了一瓶可乐。
example2_en: The machine only had coke and water, so the team shared two cold bottles.
example2_zh: 机器里只有可乐和水，于是队员们分了两瓶冰的。
collocations: a can of coke｜一罐可乐 ; diet coke｜无糖可乐
tip_zh: 参考表这一行是「可口可乐」。品牌写法常大写 Coke。焦炭是另一个意思，本卡不收。

meanings_zh: adj. 不同的 | adj. 各不相同的；各种的
definition_en: not the same | used to describe several separate people, things, or types
example1_en: Each student has a different style.
example1_zh: 每个学生都有不同风格。
example2_en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
example2_zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。
collocations: different from｜与……不同 ; different perspectives｜不同视角 ; completely different｜完全不同
tip_zh: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

definition_en: a book of plain or lined paper for writing notes
example1_en: Leave the notebook open at page six.
example1_zh: 笔记本翻开到第六页放着。
example2_en: His notebook holds the dates of every match, written in pencil so he can correct them.
example2_zh: 他的笔记本用铅笔记下每场比赛的日期，方便修改。
collocations: a notebook computer｜笔记本电脑 ; take out a notebook｜拿出笔记本
tip_zh: 纸质笔记本是 notebook。笔记本电脑也可以叫 a notebook，看上下文。

definition_en: an activity you do for pleasure
example1_en: Her hobby is collecting used stamps.
example1_zh: 她的爱好是收集用过的邮票。
example2_en: He turned a hobby into a small repair service for classmates' radios.
example2_zh: 他把爱好做成了一项小活，给同学修收音机。
collocations: take up a hobby｜开始一项爱好 ; hobby horse｜木马；反复念叨的话题
tip_zh: 爱好是 hobby，复数 hobbies。职业才是 job 或 career。

definition_en: used to make a verb or phrase negative
example1_en: I am not ready for the oral test.
example1_zh: 我还没准备好口语考试。
example2_en: A short plan is not a waste of time if it stops you from revising the same page twice.
example2_zh: 如果一份简短计划能避免你把同一页复习两遍，它就不是浪费时间。
collocations: not only｜不仅 ; not at all｜一点也不
tip_zh: 否定动词用 not；直接否定名词用 no，如 no time。

definition_en: on the subject of, or roughly
example1_en: We talked about the class trip.
example1_zh: 我们谈了班级出游的事。
example2_en: Reports about teenage sleep suggest that earlier school starts can harm attention in morning lessons.
example2_zh: 关于青少年睡眠的报告表明，过早上学可能影响上午课堂的注意力。
collocations: worry about｜担心 ; be about to｜即将 ; how about｜……怎么样
tip_zh: be about to do 表示马上要做，通常不再加具体将来时间。

definition_en: a small sweet biscuit
example1_en: He saved a cookie from lunch for the bus ride.
example1_zh: 他把午餐的一块小甜饼留到坐车时吃。
example2_en: The cookie broke in his pocket, and the crumbs covered the reading list.
example2_zh: 小甜饼在口袋里碎了，碎屑沾满了阅读清单。
collocations: a chocolate cookie｜巧克力饼干 ; cookie jar｜饼干罐
tip_zh: 美式 cookie 大致等于英式 biscuit。参考表写「小甜饼」。

definition_en: covered with clouds
example1_en: It is cloudy, so the solar panel is idle.
example1_zh: 天多云，所以太阳能板闲着。
example2_en: A cloudy morning can still become bright, which the weather diary from last May shows in three lines.
example2_zh: 多云的早晨后来仍可能放晴，去年五月的天气日记用三行字记下了这种情况。
collocations: a cloudy sky｜多云的天空 ; cloudy with rain｜多云有雨
antonyms: clear（晴朗的）, sunny（阳光充足的）
tip_zh: cloud 已在库里。cloudy 是形容词。比较级 cloudier。它也可以比喻「不清楚」，但天气义最常用。

definition_en: the legal status of belonging to a country
example1_en: Write your nationality in capitals.
example1_zh: 国籍用大写字母填写。
example2_en: Nationality is not the same as the language you speak at home.
example2_zh: 国籍和你在家里说的语言不是一回事。
collocations: Chinese nationality｜中国国籍 ; dual nationality｜双重国籍
word_family: nation (n. 国家；民族) ; national (adj. 国家的) ; national (n. 国民)
tip_zh: nationality 是国籍。民族有时用 nation 或 ethnic group。What's your nationality? 问的是哪国人。

definition_en: a straight tool for measuring, or a person who governs
example1_en: Bring a ruler for the geometry test.
example1_zh: 几何测验带一把尺子。
example2_en: The chapter compares a ruler who listens to the council with one who decides alone.
example2_zh: 这一章比较了听议会的统治者和独自做决定的统治者。
collocations: a 30-centimetre ruler｜一把 30 厘米的尺子 ; a ruler of the country｜国家的统治者
word_family: rule (v. 统治；画直线) ; rule (n. 规则) ; ruling (n. 统治)
tip_zh: 尺子和统治者是同一个词。画直线、统治都是动词 rule。看句子才能确定是哪一个。

definition_en: one of the hard white parts in the mouth
example1_en: I chipped a tooth on a piece of ice.
example1_zh: 我咬冰块时崩了一小块牙。
example2_en: The dentist said the back tooth needed a filling, not to be pulled.
example2_zh: 牙医说后面那颗牙需要补，不必拔。
collocations: brush one's teeth｜刷牙 ; a toothache｜牙痛
tip_zh: 复数 teeth，不是 tooths。刷牙用 teeth。

definition_en: a long soft seat for two or more people
example1_en: The cat sleeps on the sofa arm.
example1_zh: 猫睡在沙发扶手上。
example2_en: We moved the sofa away from the heater so the cloth would not dry and fade.
example2_zh: 我们把沙发从暖气旁挪开，免得布面发干褪色。
collocations: a leather sofa｜皮沙发 ; sofa bed｜沙发床
tip_zh: sofa 和 couch 都很常见。两人以上的长沙发才是 sofa，单人软椅是 armchair。

definition_en: a small animal with long ears
example1_en: A rabbit crossed the path behind the dorm.
example1_zh: 一只兔子穿过宿舍后面的小路。
example2_en: The science room keeps a rabbit in a large cage and feeds it hay twice a day.
example2_zh: 科学教室的大笼子里养着一只兔子，一天喂两次干草。
collocations: a rabbit｜一只兔子 ; rabbit hutch｜兔笼
tip_zh: rabbit 是兔子。hare 是野兔，耳朵更长。

definition_en: to take something for a time and then return it
example1_en: May I borrow your ruler for this question?
example1_zh: 这道题我可以借你的尺子用一下吗？
example2_en: She borrowed a charger until lunch and returned it before the afternoon class.
example2_zh: 她把充电器借到午饭，下午课前还了。
collocations: borrow sth from｜向……借 ; borrow a book｜借一本书
tip_zh: borrow 是借入。lend 是借出。借东西的人 borrow，物主 lend。

definition_en: a flat board fixed to a wall for storing things
example1_en: The atlas belongs on the shelf by the window.
example1_zh: 地图册应放在靠窗的架子上。
example2_en: The top shelf is too high for the younger students, so the dictionaries stay lower.
example2_zh: 顶层搁板对低年级学生太高，所以词典放在下面。
collocations: on the shelf｜在架子上 ; a bookshelf｜书架
tip_zh: 复数 shelves。在架子上用 on the shelf。

definition_en: an informal talk
example1_en: They had a long conversation about books.
example1_zh: 他们就书籍进行了长时间交谈。
example2_en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
example2_zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。
collocations: have a conversation｜交谈 ; start a conversation｜开始交谈 ; a conversation about｜关于……的谈话
tip_zh: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

definition_en: a thick food made from milk
example1_en: Yogurt and oats make a quick breakfast.
example1_zh: 酸奶加燕麦就是一份很快的早餐。
example2_en: Keep the yogurt cold on the trip, or it will separate and taste sharp by the time you unpack.
example2_zh: 路上要把酸奶冷藏，不然等你打开时它会分层，味道也发冲。
collocations: plain yogurt｜原味酸奶 ; a pot of yogurt｜一杯酸奶
tip_zh: yogurt 是美式拼写，英式常写 yoghurt。它通常不可数，一杯可以说 a pot of yogurt。

meanings_zh: modal v. 能；可以 | n. 罐头
definition_en: to be able to, or to be allowed to | a metal container for food
example1_en: I can finish this exercise before lunch.
example1_zh: 我能在午饭前做完这道练习。
example2_en: Public libraries can give students a quiet place to work when their homes are too crowded.
example2_zh: 当家里太挤时，公共图书馆可以为学生提供安静的学习场所。
collocations: can not｜不能 ; as...as one can｜尽可能
tip_zh: 能力用 can；过去的能力常用 could 或 was able to。

definition_en: a grandfather, used as a family name for him
example1_en: Grandpa waters the beans every dawn.
example1_zh: 爷爷每天天亮给豆子浇水。
example2_en: My grandpa tells the same river story, and my cousins still sit still for it.
example2_zh: 我外公总讲同一个江上的故事，表兄妹们仍然会坐着听完。
collocations: grandpa and grandma｜爷爷奶奶；外公外婆 ; my grandpa｜我的爷爷或外公
word_family: grandfather (n. 祖父；外祖父) ; grandma (n. 奶奶；外婆) ; grandson (n. 孙子；外孙)
tip_zh: grandpa 是口语。书面语用 grandfather。奶奶、外婆是 grandma 或 granny。

definition_en: a child's word for mother
example1_en: The little boy said, "Mommy, look at this."
example1_zh: 小男孩说：「妈妈，看这个。」
example2_en: She still says mommy when she is tired, though she writes mother on the school form.
example2_zh: 她累的时候仍叫 mommy，虽然在学校表格上写的是 mother。
collocations: mommy and daddy｜妈妈和爸爸
tip_zh: mommy 是儿童口语，美式很常见。mom 与 mum 已在本库，正式写作可用 mother。

meanings_zh: n. 野餐 | v. 野餐
definition_en: a meal eaten outdoors, often carried from home | to eat that kind of meal
example1_en: A picnic needs more water than cake.
example1_zh: 野餐需要的水比蛋糕多。
example2_en: We picnic by the lake only when the path is dry, and we carry every wrapper home.
example2_zh: 只有小路干了我们才在湖边野餐，而且每个包装都带回家。
collocations: go on a picnic｜去野餐 ; a picnic basket｜野餐篮
tip_zh: go on a picnic 或 have a picnic。动词过去式 picnicked，要加 k。

definition_en: a child's toy in the shape of a person
example1_en: A doll sat on the empty seat of the bus.
example1_zh: 一个玩偶坐在公共汽车的空座位上。
example2_en: The child would not leave the doll at the lost-property desk, so her mother waited.
example2_zh: 孩子不肯把玩偶留在失物处，于是她妈妈等着。
collocations: a rag doll｜布娃娃 ; a doll's house｜玩偶屋
tip_zh: doll 是玩具娃娃。洋娃娃也用这个词。

definition_en: together with, or having
example1_en: I walk home with my classmate.
example1_zh: 我和同学一起走回家。
example2_en: Teams that plan a project with a clear timetable are less likely to leave the hard work until the last night.
example2_zh: 用清晰时间表规划项目的小组，不太会把难的部分留到最后一夜。
collocations: with the help of｜在……的帮助下 ; deal with｜处理 ; agree with｜同意
tip_zh: with 后面接名词或代词，不接动词原形。

definition_en: a pain in the head
example1_en: Bright light gives me a headache.
example1_zh: 强光让我头疼。
example2_en: She left at half-time because the headache made it hard to follow the ball.
example2_zh: 她中场就走了，因为头疼得看不清球。
collocations: a bad headache｜剧烈的头痛 ; have a headache｜头疼
tip_zh: have a headache 要有 a。复数 headaches。

definition_en: a flying insect that makes honey
example1_en: A bee landed on the lemonade and nobody moved.
example1_zh: 一只蜜蜂落在柠檬水上，谁都没动。
example2_en: The keeper told us a bee stings only once, then showed the hive from behind glass.
example2_zh: 饲养员告诉我们蜜蜂只会蜇一次，然后隔着玻璃给我们看蜂箱。
collocations: a bee sting｜蜜蜂蜇伤 ; busy as a bee｜忙个不停
tip_zh: 复数 bees。不要写成 been 或 beer。

definition_en: on the condition that, or whether
example1_en: If it rains, we will stay in the classroom.
example1_zh: 如果下雨，我们就留在教室。
example2_en: If schools teach students how to check a source, they are less likely to trust a false story online.
example2_zh: 如果学校教学生如何核对来源，他们就不太会轻信网上的假消息。
collocations: if necessary｜如果有必要 ; even if｜即使 ; as if｜好像
tip_zh: 主将从现：if 从句常用一般现在时，主句用 will。

definition_en: a small restaurant that serves drinks and simple meals
example1_en: The café by the station sells soup.
example1_zh: 车站旁的小餐馆卖汤。
example2_en: We met at the café after rehearsal and shared one pot of tea between four people.
example2_zh: 排练后我们在咖啡馆见面，四个人合喝一壶茶。
collocations: a street café｜街边小餐馆 ; café culture｜咖啡馆文化
tip_zh: 考纲词头是 café，目录 id 用 cafe，因为文件名不能带音符。cafeteria 是自助食堂，不是同一词。

definition_en: a person who works on a ship
example1_en: The sailor retied the wet rope before the tide turned.
example1_zh: 涨潮前水手把那根湿绳子又系好了。
example2_en: An old sailor showed us which cloud means the wind will change before dark.
example2_zh: 一位老水手告诉我们，哪种云说明天黑前风会变。
collocations: a sailor suit｜水手服 ; an experienced sailor｜有经验的水手
word_family: sail (v. 航行) ; sailing (n. 航海)
tip_zh: sailor 是在船上工作的人。去航海是 go sailing。

definition_en: a game in which two teams hit a ball over a high net
example1_en: Volleyball practice starts at four.
example1_zh: 排球训练四点开始。
example2_en: They moved volleyball indoors after the wind kept lifting the ball over the fence.
example2_zh: 风老是把球吹过围栏，他们就把排球挪到室内。
collocations: play volleyball｜打排球 ; a volleyball court｜排球场
tip_zh: 球类名前通常不加 the：play volleyball。场地才说 a volleyball court。

definition_en: a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal
example1_en: Her bicycle has a bell and a small light.
example1_zh: 她的自行车有铃，还有一盏小灯。
example2_en: He locks his bicycle beside the gym because the rack by the gate is already full.
example2_zh: 他把自行车锁在体育馆旁边，因为门口的车架已经满了。
collocations: ride a bicycle｜骑自行车 ; bicycle pump｜自行车打气筒
tip_zh: 口语里也说 bike。骑自行车是 ride a bicycle，不是 drive。

definition_en: a seed of a climbing plant, eaten as food
example1_en: A single bean sprouted in the cotton wool.
example1_zh: 一颗豆子在棉花里发了芽。
example2_en: The soup has beans and rice, and it is the dish most students ask for on Thursdays.
example2_zh: 这汤里有豆子和米饭，是多数学生星期四要点的菜。
collocations: a bean｜一颗豆子 ; green beans｜青豆
tip_zh: bean 是豆。咖啡豆也叫 coffee bean。

definition_en: material made by weaving
example1_en: Cover the table with a clean cloth before you set out the paint.
example1_zh: 摆颜料之前先用一块干净的布把桌子铺上。
example2_en: The cloth for the costumes is still in the box, folded and unmarked.
example2_zh: 戏服的布还在箱子里，叠着，没有做记号。
collocations: a piece of cloth｜一块布 ; a table cloth｜桌布
tip_zh: cloth 是布。clothes 是衣服，已经在词库里，不要看混。

definition_en: an animal with a long tail that climbs trees
example1_en: A monkey grabbed the banana from the guide's hand.
example1_zh: 一只猴子从导游手里抢走了香蕉。
example2_en: The monkey house was closed for cleaning, so we watched the birds instead.
example2_zh: 猴馆在打扫，关着，于是我们改去看鸟。
collocations: a monkey｜一只猴子 ; monkey around｜胡闹
tip_zh: monkey around 是胡闹，不是「在猴子周围」。

definition_en: inside a place, or during a period
example1_en: The keys are in my schoolbag.
example1_zh: 钥匙在我的书包里。
example2_en: Students who read in short daily sessions often remember new words longer than those who study only before an exam.
example2_zh: 每天分段阅读的学生，往往比只在考前突击的人记得更久。
collocations: in the morning｜在早上 ; in time｜及时 ; in fact｜事实上
tip_zh: 地点或一段时间前常用 in；具体某一天用 on，钟点用 at。

definition_en: a small jumping animal that lives in and near water
example1_en: A frog sat on a leaf in the pond.
example1_zh: 一只青蛙坐在池塘的叶子上。
example2_en: Frogs are quiet in the daytime, then the pond gets loud after the lights go out.
example2_zh: 青蛙白天安静，灯灭之后池塘就吵了。
collocations: frog jump｜蛙跳 ; tree frog｜树蛙
tip_zh: 青蛙是 frog。蟾蜍是 toad。复数 frogs。

meanings_zh: adj. 晴朗的；阳光充足的
definition_en: bright with sunlight
example1_en: It is sunny, so the match can stay outside.
example1_zh: 天气晴朗，比赛可以留在室外。
example2_en: The sunny side of the dorm is hot by noon, and we close the curtain.
example2_zh: 宿舍朝阳的一面到中午就热，我们把窗帘拉上。
collocations: a sunny day｜晴天 ; sunny side｜向阳的一面
tip_zh: sunny 形容天气或地方光线好。人开朗也可以说 a sunny smile。

definition_en: a person who lives next door or nearby
example1_en: Our neighbour watered the plants.
example1_zh: 我们的邻居给植物浇了水。
example2_en: Ask a neighbour to take the parcel if you will be in the lab all afternoon.
example2_zh: 要是你整个下午都在实验室，就请邻居代收包裹。
collocations: a next-door neighbour｜隔壁邻居 ; neighbourhood watch｜邻里守望
word_family: neighbourhood (n. 街区；四邻) ; neighbouring (adj. 邻近的)
tip_zh: neighbour 是英式拼写。美式 neighbor 已在库里，不要并成一条。形容词 neighbouring，名词 neighbourhood。

definition_en: an insect with large coloured wings
example1_en: A butterfly landed on the open book.
example1_zh: 一只蝴蝶落在摊开的书上。
example2_en: Butterflies gather near the bush in May, which is why the art class sketches there.
example2_zh: 五月蝴蝶聚在那丛灌木旁，所以美术课在那里写生。
collocations: butterfly wing｜蝴蝶翅膀 ; butterfly net｜捕蝶网
tip_zh: 复数 butterflies。胃里发慌可以说 butterflies in one's stomach。

definition_en: a small green or purple fruit that grows in bunches
example1_en: A sour grape made her blink.
example1_zh: 一颗酸葡萄让她眨了眨眼。
example2_en: She rinsed every grape before packing lunch, because the market fruit still had dust on the skin.
example2_zh: 她把每颗葡萄洗过再装进午饭，因为集市上的水果皮上还有灰。
collocations: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄 ; grape juice｜葡萄汁
tip_zh: grape 常以复数 grapes 出现。一串是 a bunch of grapes。葡萄柚 grapefruit 是另一种水果。

definition_en: a man who serves food in a restaurant
example1_en: The waiter brought extra napkins.
example1_zh: 服务员又拿来了餐巾。
example2_en: Ask the waiter to repeat the dish if the name is unclear, rather than guessing from the picture.
example2_zh: 菜名如果看不清，就请服务员再说一遍，不要对着图片猜。
collocations: a head waiter｜领班 ; call the waiter｜叫服务员
word_family: waitress (n. 女服务员) ; wait (v. 等候)
tip_zh: waiter 传统上指男性。性别不明时可以说 server。女服务员 waitress 在本批后面。

definition_en: the one near the speaker
example1_en: This question is easier than the last one.
example1_zh: 这道题比上一道容易。
example2_en: This result suggests that short breaks can improve attention during long study hours.
example2_zh: 这一结果说明，长时间学习中的短休息有助于保持注意力。
collocations: this morning｜今天早上 ; this kind of｜这种
tip_zh: this 指近处或即将说到的事；those 是 that 的复数。

meanings_zh: n. 例子 | n. 榜样
definition_en: something that shows a rule | A person or action that others can learn from or copy
example1_en: Give an example to support your idea.
example1_zh: 举一个例子支持你的观点。
example2_en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
example2_zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。
collocations: for example｜例如 ; give an example｜举例 ; set an example｜树立榜样 ; a typical example｜典型例子
tip_zh: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

definition_en: cheerful and lively
example1_en: A merry song ended the show.
example1_zh: 一首欢快的歌结束了演出。
example2_en: The merry crowd stayed on the lawn until the lights over the stage went out.
example2_zh: 欢快的人群留在草地上，直到舞台上方的灯灭了。
collocations: Merry Christmas｜圣诞快乐 ; a merry laugh｜爽朗的笑
word_family: merrily (adv. 愉快地) ; merriment (n. 欢乐)
tip_zh: Merry Christmas 是固定说法。merry 比 happy 更热闹。副词 merrily。

definition_en: to enjoy or want | similar to
example1_en: I like reading by the window.
example1_zh: 我喜欢靠窗读书。
example2_en: Teenagers like being trusted with real tasks, not only praised for high marks.
example2_zh: 青少年喜欢被托付真正的任务，而不只是因为高分受到夸奖。
collocations: would like｜想要 ; feel like｜想要 ; like doing｜喜欢做
tip_zh: like 后接 doing 表示习惯喜好；would like to do 表示此刻想要。

meanings_zh: v. 同意 | v. 商定；答应
definition_en: to have the same opinion | Decide something together or promise to do something
example1_en: I agree with your suggestion.
example1_zh: 我同意你的建议。
example2_en: Most researchers agree that regular physical activity can improve both mental health and academic performance.
example2_zh: 大多数研究人员认为，经常运动可以改善心理健康和学业表现。
collocations: agree with someone｜同意某人的观点 ; agree on a plan｜就计划达成一致 ; agree to do something｜答应做某事 ; agree to a proposal｜同意一项提议
tip_zh: 同意某人用with；商定某事用on；答应做用to do。

meanings_zh: adv. 如此；所以 | conj. 所以
definition_en: to such a degree, or therefore | and for that reason
example1_en: The hallway was so noisy that we could not hear.
example1_zh: 走廊吵得我们听不见。
example2_en: The town has few buses, so many students cycle to school even on cold mornings.
example2_zh: 镇上公交很少，所以许多学生即使在寒冷的早晨也骑车上学。
collocations: so that｜以便 ; so far｜到目前为止 ; or so｜大约
tip_zh: so...that... 表示“如此……以至于”；such 后面接名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 困难的 | adj. 难相处的；难应付的
definition_en: hard to do | Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.
example1_en: The question is difficult.
example1_zh: 这道题很难。
example2_en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
example2_zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。
collocations: a difficult decision｜艰难的决定 ; difficult to understand｜难以理解 ; a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip_zh: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

definition_en: a thin wooden stick with graphite for writing
example1_en: Sharpen the pencil before the test starts.
example1_zh: 开考前把铅笔削好。
example2_en: She kept a spare pencil in the box because the first one broke during the drawing.
example2_zh: 她在盒子里留了一支备用铅笔，因为第一支在画图时断了。
collocations: pencil case｜铅笔盒 ; pencil sharpener｜卷笔刀
tip_zh: 铅笔是 pencil。钢笔是 pen。用铅笔写是 write in pencil。

definition_en: a funny drawing, or an animated film
example1_en: The cartoon on the notice board shows our principal with a megaphone.
example1_zh: 布告栏上的漫画画着校长拿着扩音器。
example2_en: We watched a short cartoon about recycling, then wrote down three facts from it.
example2_zh: 我们看了一部关于回收的短卡通，然后写下其中三件事实。
collocations: a cartoon character｜卡通人物 ; a political cartoon｜政治漫画
tip_zh: cartoon 既可以是纸上的漫画，也可以是动画片。

definition_en: a piece of cloth for drying skin or dishes
example1_en: Hang the wet towel on the rail.
example1_zh: 把湿毛巾挂在杆上。
example2_en: There was no clean towel in the washroom, so he dried his hands on a paper sheet.
example2_zh: 洗手间没有干净毛巾，他用一张纸把手擦干。
collocations: bath towel｜浴巾 ; towel rail｜毛巾架
tip_zh: 毛巾是 towel。塔是 tower。不要看混。

definition_en: the whole number or amount
example1_en: All the lights in the lab are off.
example1_zh: 实验室里的灯都关了。
example2_en: Not all famous people are suitable role models for teenagers who are still forming their own values.
example2_zh: 对仍在形成价值观的青少年来说，并非所有名人都是合适的榜样。
collocations: all over｜遍及 ; above all｜最重要的是 ; all day｜整天
tip_zh: all 与 not 连用常表示部分否定：Not all students agree.

definition_en: a very short time ago, or only
example1_en: I have just seen the notice on the board.
example1_zh: 我刚看到布告栏上的通知。
example2_en: A slogan that just sounds exciting may still fail if it does not tell people what to do.
example2_zh: 一句只是听着振奋的口号，如果没有告诉人们该做什么，仍然可能没有用。
collocations: just now｜刚才 ; just then｜就在那时
tip_zh: just 常放在助动词后、实义动词前。

definition_en: touching a surface, or on a particular day
example1_en: The notice is on the classroom door.
example1_zh: 通知贴在教室门上。
example2_en: Many cities now limit cars on weekdays in order to cut air pollution around schools.
example2_zh: 许多城市现在工作日限行，以减少学校周边的空气污染。
collocations: on Monday｜在星期一 ; on time｜准时 ; on the Internet｜在网上
tip_zh: 星期、具体日期用 on；钟点用 at，上午/年/月用 in。

definition_en: to say what something is like
example1_en: Can you describe the scene in detail?
example1_zh: 你能详细描述那个场景吗？
example2_en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
example2_zh: 该报告描述了公共公园的可达性如何影响人口密集城市居民的体育活动。
collocations: describe something in detail｜详细描述某事物 ; describe something as｜把某事物形容为 ; describe a process｜描述一个过程
tip_zh: 说describe something to someone，不说describe someone something。

meanings_zh: prep. 作为；像 | conj. 当……时；因为
definition_en: in the role of, or while something happens | while, or because
example1_en: She works as a library assistant after school.
example1_zh: 她放学后在图书馆当助理。
example2_en: As cities grow, schools have to find new ways to give every child a safe route to class.
example2_zh: 随着城市扩大，学校必须找到新办法，让每个孩子都有安全的上学路线。
collocations: as well｜也 ; as soon as｜一……就 ; such as｜例如
tip_zh: as 可表示“作为”或“当……时”；like 更常用于口语中的“像”。

definition_en: a plant grown for food
example1_en: Soup needs at least one green vegetable.
example1_zh: 汤里至少要有一种绿色蔬菜。
example2_en: The market sells vegetable seedlings in spring, and students grow them in pots.
example2_zh: 春天市场卖菜苗，学生们用花盆来种。
collocations: fresh vegetables｜新鲜蔬菜 ; vegetable garden｜菜园
tip_zh: vegetable 里的 e 在日常发音里常常很轻。复数 vegetables。

definition_en: a book that lists words and their meanings
example1_en: Look the word up in a dictionary, then write your own sentence.
example1_zh: 先在词典里查这个词，再写你自己的句子。
example2_en: A bilingual dictionary sits on the front desk, and it is chained so it stays there.
example2_zh: 前台放着一本双解词典，用链子拴着，免得被人拿走。
collocations: look sth up in a dictionary｜在词典里查 ; a bilingual dictionary｜双解词典
tip_zh: dictionary 是词典。查词是 look up a word。

definition_en: a group of sentences about one point
example1_en: Start a new paragraph when the speaker changes.
example1_zh: 说话的人变了，就另起一段。
example2_en: The last paragraph of her report gives the numbers, and the rest explains how she got them.
example2_zh: 她报告的最后一段给出数字，其余部分解释这些数字怎么来的。
collocations: a paragraph｜一段 ; the opening paragraph｜开头一段
tip_zh: paragraph 是文章的段。缩进或空行用来分开。

meanings_zh: num. 一；一个 | pron. 一个人；一个事物
definition_en: the number 1, or a single person or thing | a single person or thing
example1_en: I need one more pencil for the test.
example1_zh: 我考试还需要一支铅笔。
example2_en: One reason cities plant trees along roads is that shade can lower the temperature in summer.
example2_zh: 城市沿路种树的一个原因是，树荫能降低夏天的气温。
collocations: one another｜互相 ; one by one｜一个一个地
tip_zh: one of 后面接复数名词，谓语常用单数。

definition_en: the act or result of cutting someone's hair
example1_en: His new haircut looks much shorter.
example1_zh: 他的新发型看起来短了不少。
example2_en: I need a haircut before the photo morning, so I booked the shop beside the school gate.
example2_zh: 拍照那天早上之前我得理个发，所以预约了校门口旁边的店。
collocations: get a haircut｜去理发 ; a short haircut｜短发
word_family: hair (n. 头发) ; hairdresser (n. 理发师)
tip_zh: haircut 是一次理发或理完的样子。动词用 cut one's hair 或 have one's hair cut。

meanings_zh: v. 有；吃，进行 | aux. 构成完成时
definition_en: to own, or to experience something | used with a past participle
example1_en: We have a maths test tomorrow.
example1_zh: 我们明天有一场数学测验。
example2_en: Students who have a regular place to study at home usually find it easier to start homework on time.
example2_zh: 家里有固定学习角落的学生，通常更容易按时开始写作业。
collocations: have to｜不得不 ; have breakfast｜吃早饭 ; have a look｜看一看
tip_zh: have to do 表示客观上不得不；must 更强调主观认为必须。

definition_en: in this place
example1_en: Please wait here until your name is called.
example1_zh: 请在这里等到叫你的名字。
example2_en: Communities that plant trees here, along the hottest streets, can make walking to school safer.
example2_zh: 在最热的街道旁种树的社区，可以让步行上学更安全。
collocations: here and there｜各处 ; come here｜过来
tip_zh: Here is / Here are 后面的主语决定动词单复数。

definition_en: a strong thick cord
example1_en: Hold the rope with both hands on the way down.
example1_zh: 下去的时候用两只手抓住绳子。
example2_en: The rope around the tent pegs was loose, and one corner lifted in the wind.
example2_zh: 围着帐篷桩的绳子松了，一个角被风掀了起来。
collocations: a piece of rope｜一根绳子 ; jump rope｜跳绳
tip_zh: rope 比 string 粗。跳绳可以说 jump rope 或 skip。

definition_en: to make a liquid flow from a container
example1_en: Pour the tea slowly so it doesn't spill.
example1_zh: 茶要慢慢倒，免得洒出来。
example2_en: Rain poured down the gym roof and the match moved inside after ten minutes.
example2_zh: 雨从体育馆屋顶倾泻下来，比赛十分钟后改到室内。
collocations: pour sth into｜把……倒进 ; pouring rain｜倾盆大雨
tip_zh: pour 是倒液体。人多时用 crowd，不用 pour 形容人除非是涌入。

definition_en: used to stress something surprising
example1_en: Even a short walk can clear your head.
example1_zh: 即使是短短的散步也能让头脑清醒。
example2_en: Even a rich city can have neighbourhoods where children have no safe park nearby.
example2_zh: 即使是富裕的城市，也可能有孩子附近没有安全公园的社区。
collocations: even if｜即使 ; even though｜尽管
tip_zh: even 放在所强调的词前；even if 后面接让步从句。

definition_en: a figure of a person or animal made of stone or metal
example1_en: A stone statue stands in the middle of the square.
example1_zh: 广场中央立着一尊石像。
example2_en: Pigeons sat on the head of the statue until the cleaners came with a ladder.
example2_zh: 鸽子停在雕像头上，直到清洁工扛着梯子来了。
collocations: a bronze statue｜铜像 ; a statue of a poet｜诗人雕像
tip_zh: 参考表这一行的中文写成了「法令，法规」，那是 statute。statue 是雕像。音标 /ˈstætjuː/ 对得上雕像，本卡保留。

meanings_zh: v. 设计 | n. 设计；设计方案 | n. 装饰图案
definition_en: to plan how something looks or works | the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan | a decorative pattern on an object or surface
example1_en: They will design a new school logo.
example1_zh: 他们将设计一个新的校徽。
example2_en: Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.
example2_zh: 城市应设计既能促进社交互动、又方便残障人士使用的公共空间。
collocations: design a building｜设计建筑 ; be designed to do something｜旨在做某事 ; graphic design｜平面设计 ; interior design｜室内设计
tip_zh: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

definition_en: to order that something must not be done
example1_en: House rules forbid shoes on the mat.
example1_zh: 家规禁止把鞋踩上垫子。
example2_en: Teachers forbid students to run in the lab, and a broken rule can mean leaving the room.
example2_zh: 老师禁止学生在实验室里跑，违反规定可能就要离开房间。
collocations: forbid sb to do｜禁止某人做 ; strictly forbidden｜严格禁止
word_family: forbade (v. 禁止，过去式) ; forbidden (adj. 被禁止的) ; forbidding (adj. 令人生畏的)
tip_zh: forbid sb to do sth。过去式 forbade，过去分词 forbidden。prohibit 更正式，结构是 prohibit sb from doing。

definition_en: a wooden musical instrument held under the chin
example1_en: The violin needs a new string.
example1_zh: 这把小提琴需要一根新弦。
example2_en: She practised the violin in a storage room so the dormitory could stay quiet.
example2_zh: 她在储藏室练小提琴，好让宿舍保持安静。
collocations: play the violin｜拉小提琴 ; a violin case｜小提琴盒
tip_zh: 演奏乐器通常加 the：play the violin。拉小提琴的人是 violinist。

definition_en: a covering for the hand with separate parts for the fingers
example1_en: One glove is missing from the pair.
example1_zh: 这双手套少了一只。
example2_en: Wear a glove on the hand that holds the hot tray, and use a cloth on the other.
example2_zh: 拿热托盘的那只手戴手套，另一只手用布。
collocations: a pair of gloves｜一副手套 ; rubber gloves｜橡胶手套
tip_zh: 手套常用复数 gloves。一副是 a pair of gloves。无指的连指手套是 mittens。

definition_en: wanting more than one's fair share
example1_en: A greedy bite left nothing for the others.
example1_zh: 一大口吃下去，别人就没了。
example2_en: The story punishes the greedy king, who keeps every coin and loses his friends.
example2_zh: 故事惩罚了贪婪的国王：他留下每一枚硬币，也失去了朋友。
collocations: be greedy for｜贪图 ; a greedy person｜贪婪的人
word_family: greed (n. 贪婪) ; greedily (adv. 贪婪地)
tip_zh: be greedy for money / food。名词 greed。反义是 generous。

meanings_zh: v. 发音 | v. 宣布
definition_en: to make the sounds of a word | to state a decision officially
example1_en: Pronounce the last consonant clearly.
example1_zh: 把最后一个辅音发清楚。
example2_en: The principal will pronounce the holiday dates on Friday, once the office has checked the calendar.
example2_zh: 校长将在周五宣布放假日期，等办公室先把日历核对完。
collocations: pronounce a word｜读出一个词 ; pronounce a decision｜宣布决定
word_family: pronunciation (n. 发音) ; pronounced (adj. 明显的)
tip_zh: pronounce 在课堂上多是「发音」，也可以是正式的「宣布」。名词 pronunciation 重音不同，本批另有一条。

definition_en: skill or power to do something
example1_en: Language ability grows with practice.
example1_zh: 语言能力随练习而增长。
example2_en: Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.
example2_zh: 经常阅读可以增强儿童理解复杂概念和清晰表达自身观点的能力。
collocations: the ability to learn｜学习能力 ; develop an ability｜培养一种能力 ; academic ability｜学业能力 ; natural ability｜天赋
tip_zh: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

definition_en: in fact, or very
example1_en: I really want to understand this poem.
example1_zh: 我真的想读懂这首诗。
example2_en: A programme is not really successful if only the students who already read a lot take part.
example2_zh: 如果只有本来就读得很多的学生参加，一个项目并不能算真正成功。
collocations: really want｜真的想
tip_zh: really 修饰形容词或动词，强调程度或真实性。

definition_en: to cook food in an oven or over a fire | cooked in that way
example1_en: We roast potatoes with the chicken.
example1_zh: 我们把土豆和鸡一起烤。
example2_en: Roast chicken smells wonderful, but you still have to check that the centre is hot.
example2_zh: 烤鸡很香，但你仍要确认里面是热的。
collocations: roast chicken｜烤鸡 ; roast potatoes｜烤土豆
tip_zh: roast 多指烤箱或明火烤大块食物。薄片快煎更常用 fry。

definition_en: used for polite requests, habits, or imagined results
example1_en: Would you help me carry these books?
example1_zh: 你愿意帮我搬这些书吗？
example2_en: Many students would revise more calmly if tests were spread across the term instead of piled into one week.
example2_zh: 如果考试分散在整个学期，而不是堆在一周里，许多学生会复习得更从容。
collocations: would like｜想要 ; would rather｜宁愿
tip_zh: would like to do 是礼貌的“想要”；would rather do 表示宁愿。

definition_en: in addition
example1_en: She plays the piano and also sings in the choir.
example1_zh: 她弹钢琴，还在合唱团唱歌。
example2_en: Parks also reduce noise, which matters for schools built beside busy roads.
example2_zh: 公园还能降低噪音，这对建在繁忙道路旁的学校很重要。
collocations: not only...but also｜不仅……而且
tip_zh: also 多放在句中；too 和 as well 多放在句末。

definition_en: a taxi
example1_en: A cab waited outside the station in the rain.
example1_zh: 雨中，一辆出租车等在车站外面。
example2_en: The cab driver knew a shorter road, so we reached the hall before the speech began.
example2_zh: 出租车司机认得一条近路，我们在演讲开始前到了礼堂。
collocations: call a cab｜叫出租车 ; cab fare｜出租车费
tip_zh: cab 就是 taxi，口语里很常见。车费是 fare，不是 fee 专指这一项时也常说 fare。

definition_en: the way a word is spoken
example1_en: That vowel pronunciation still varies.
example1_zh: 那个元音的读音仍然不统一。
example2_en: Check the pronunciation in a dictionary when the spelling does not show which syllable is strong.
example2_zh: 拼写看不出哪个音节重读时，就到词典里核对发音。
collocations: correct pronunciation｜正确发音 ; pronunciation guide｜发音指南
tip_zh: pronunciation 是名词，重音在 -nun- 前的音节附近，和动词 pronounce 不同。本批两条都有，不要合成一个词。

meanings_zh: n. 片 | v. 切成片
definition_en: a thin flat piece cut from something | to cut into slices
example1_en: He ate one slice of bread and left the rest.
example1_zh: 他吃了一片面包，剩下的没动。
example2_en: Slice the lemon thinly so each cup of tea gets a piece.
example2_zh: 把柠檬切薄，这样每杯茶都能分到一片。
collocations: a slice of bread｜一片面包 ; slice sth thinly｜把某物切薄
tip_zh: 参考表音标是 sleeve（袖子）的，本卡不用。sleeve 还在考纲里。a slice of bread 是真能吃到的一片，不是空搭配。

definition_en: a very large animal with a trunk
example1_en: The elephant in the zoo sprayed water with its trunk.
example1_zh: 动物园里的象用鼻子喷水。
example2_en: An elephant needs more space than our city zoo can give, the guide said.
example2_zh: 导游说，一头象需要的空间比我们城市动物园能给的更大。
collocations: an elephant｜一头象 ; elephant trunk｜象鼻
tip_zh: 象鼻是 trunk，耳朵是 ears。不定冠词用 an。

definition_en: in what way, or to what degree
example1_en: How do you spell your family name?
example1_zh: 你的姓怎么拼？
example2_en: How a city treats its rivers often shows how seriously it takes public health.
example2_zh: 一座城市如何对待河流，常常说明它有多重视公共健康。
collocations: how about｜……怎么样 ; how long｜多久 ; how far｜多远
tip_zh: How 加形容词或副词构成感叹句；What 加名词。

definition_en: minced meat packed in a tube
example1_en: Grill one sausage for each person.
example1_zh: 每人烤一根香肠。
example2_en: The sausage in the bun was too salty, so she added cucumber from the side plate.
example2_zh: 面包里的香肠太咸，她就加了配菜碟里的黄瓜。
collocations: a sausage roll｜香肠卷 ; pork sausage｜猪肉香肠
tip_zh: 一根香肠是 a sausage。英式早餐里常有 sausages，用复数。

definition_en: to plan and arrange something
example1_en: We organize the book sale every May.
example1_zh: 我们每年五月组织售书。
example2_en: The class will organize a museum visit if enough students sign the list this week.
example2_zh: 要是这周有足够的学生签名，全班会组织一次博物馆参观。
collocations: organize a meeting｜组织会议 ; organize your notes｜整理笔记
tip_zh: 美式拼作 organize。英式常作 organise，意思相同。

definition_en: full of energy
example1_en: The energetic puppy woke the house.
example1_zh: 精力旺盛的小狗把全家吵醒了。
example2_en: An energetic warm-up is useful, but stop if your knee hurts.
example2_zh: 热身做得起劲有好处，可是膝盖疼就要停。
collocations: an energetic child｜精力充沛的孩子 ; energetic exercise｜剧烈的运动
word_family: energy (n. 能量；精力) ; energetically (adv. 精力充沛地)
tip_zh: energetic 形容人或活动。名词是 energy，不是 energeticness。

meanings_zh: n. 距离 | n. 疏远；隔阂 | v. 使疏远；撇清关系
definition_en: space between two points | A lack of emotional closeness between people | To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views
example1_en: Keep a safe distance from the fire.
example1_zh: 与火保持安全距离。
example2_en: Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.
example2_zh: 缩短住宅区与工作地点之间的距离，可以减少交通排放并改善城市生活质量。
collocations: walking distance｜步行可达的距离 ; in the distance｜在远处 ; keep your distance｜保持距离 ; distance yourself from｜与……划清界限
tip_zh: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。

definition_en: for what reason
example1_en: Why is the lab closed this afternoon?
example1_zh: 实验室今天下午为什么关门？
example2_en: Understanding why a species disappears is the first step toward protecting the habitat it needs.
example2_zh: 弄清一个物种为何消失，是保护它所需栖息地的第一步。
collocations: why not｜为什么不 ; that is why｜那就是为什么
tip_zh: Why not do...? 用来提出建议，后面接动词原形。

definition_en: a son of one's son or daughter
example1_en: Her grandson visits every Spring Festival.
example1_zh: 她的孙子每年春节都来。
example2_en: The old sailor showed his grandson how to fold the flag before they left the harbour wall.
example2_zh: 老水手教孙子在离开防波堤之前把旗子叠好。
collocations: one's grandson｜某人的孙子 ; a grandson of hers｜她的一个孙子
word_family: granddaughter (n. 孙女；外孙女) ; grandchild (n. 孙辈) ; grandfather (n. 祖父；外祖父) ; grandmother (n. 祖母；外祖母)
tip_zh: 孙子、外孙都是 grandson。孙女、外孙女是 granddaughter。

meanings_zh: n. 钻头；反复训练 | v. 钻孔；反复操练
definition_en: a tool for making holes, or repeated practice | to make a hole or to train by repetition
example1_en: The fire drill emptied the building in four minutes.
example1_zh: 消防演习四分钟内把楼清空了。
example2_en: He drilled a small hole for the hook, then we practiced the same step ten times.
example2_zh: 他为挂钩钻了一个小孔，然后我们把同一步骤练了十遍。
collocations: a fire drill｜消防演习 ; drill a hole｜钻一个孔
tip_zh: drill 既可以是操练，也可以是钻头。消防演习是 fire drill。

definition_en: to put a body or an object under the ground
example1_en: They bury the seeds two centimetres deep.
example1_zh: 他们把种子埋两厘米深。
example2_en: Snow may bury the path overnight, so the caretaker clears it before the first class.
example2_zh: 雪一夜之间可能盖住小路，所以管理员在第一节课前把它清开。
collocations: bury sth in｜把某物埋进 ; bury one's face｜捂住脸
tip_zh: bury 的过去式是 buried。不要和 berry（浆果）看混。

definition_en: a piece of paper showing that you paid
example1_en: Keep the receipt in case you return it.
example1_zh: 把收据留着，以便退货。
example2_en: The receipt shows the date and the price, which the office needs for the club account.
example2_zh: 收据上有日期和价格，社团报账时办公室要看。
collocations: keep the receipt｜保留收据 ; ask for a receipt｜索要收据
tip_zh: receipt 里的 p 不发音，重音在第二音节。收到是 receive。

definition_en: one of the large land masses of the earth
example1_en: We colored one continent on the blank map.
example1_zh: 我们在空白地图上给一个大洲上了色。
example2_en: Africa is a continent, and the quiz asks which ocean lies on its eastern side.
example2_zh: 非洲是一个大洲，测验问它东边是哪片海。
collocations: the African continent｜非洲大陆 ; across the continent｜横跨大陆
tip_zh: continent 是大洲。country 是国家，island 是岛。

definition_en: also, or more than enough
example1_en: This box is too heavy for one person.
example1_zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重了。
example2_en: If tickets are too expensive, a museum built with public money will not serve the public.
example2_zh: 如果门票太贵，用公共资金建造的博物馆就服务不了公众。
collocations: too...to｜太……而不能 ; me too｜我也是
tip_zh: too...to do 表示太……而不能；also 不能放在这个结构里。

definition_en: behaving in a way that shows respect
example1_en: A polite request works better than a shout.
example1_zh: 有礼貌的请求比喊叫有用。
example2_en: It is polite to wait until the speaker finishes, even if you disagree with the point.
example2_zh: 即使不同意，等发言的人说完也是礼貌。
collocations: polite request｜礼貌的请求 ; polite to sb｜对某人有礼貌
tip_zh: It is polite to do sth。反义 rude。副词 politely。

definition_en: the basic unit of length, 100 centimetres
example1_en: The desk is about one meter wide.
example1_zh: 这张桌子大约一米宽。
example2_en: They measured the hall again and found it was two meters shorter than the plan.
example2_zh: 他们又量了一遍礼堂，发现比图纸短两米。
collocations: one meter long｜一米长 ; a square meter｜一平方米
tip_zh: 考纲另有 metre。参考表把 meter 标成 metre 的美式拼写，意思是长度单位。仪表是另一个常见义，本卡按表先记「米」。

definition_en: a male member of the police
example1_en: A policeman directed traffic at the gate.
example1_zh: 一名警察在大门口指挥交通。
example2_en: The policeman asked us to stand on the pavement until the ambulance had passed.
example2_zh: 警察让我们站在人行道上，直到救护车过去。
collocations: a traffic policeman｜交警 ; a policeman on duty｜值班警察
word_family: policewoman (n. 女警察) ; police (n. 警察，集体) ; policemen (n. 复数)
tip_zh: policeman 传统上指男警察。女警察是 policewoman。中性说法是 police officer。police 是集体名词。

meanings_zh: n. 精力；能源 | n. 能量；能源
definition_en: power to work; power source | Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity
example1_en: Young people have lots of energy.
example1_zh: 年轻人有很多精力。
example2_en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。
collocations: full of energy｜精力充沛 ; renewable energy｜可再生能源 ; energy consumption｜能源消耗 ; save energy｜节约能源
tip_zh: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

definition_en: to arrange people or things so they work well
example1_en: Who will organise the book sale?
example1_zh: 谁来组织这次售书？
example2_en: They organise the files by date, which makes last March easy to find during the review.
example2_zh: 他们按日期整理文件，复习时去年三月就很容易找到。
collocations: organise a meeting｜组织会议 ; organise one's notes｜整理笔记
word_family: organisation (n. 组织) ; organiser (n. 组织者)
tip_zh: organise 是英式动词。美式 organize 已在库里。名词 organisation，美式 organization。

definition_en: a soft covering for the foot, worn inside a shoe
example1_en: One sock is still on the line.
example1_zh: 还有一只短袜在绳子上。
example2_en: Bring a spare sock if the field is muddy, because a wet foot makes the afternoon hike miserable.
example2_zh: 场地要是泥泞，就多带一只短袜，脚湿了下午的徒步会很难受。
collocations: a pair of socks｜一双短袜 ; ankle socks｜船袜
tip_zh: 通常说 a pair of socks。一只是 a sock。长筒袜是 stocking，本批后面另有一条。

definition_en: a person who is on a journey; the American spelling
example1_en: A tired traveler asked for water.
example1_zh: 一个疲倦的旅行者要了水。
example2_en: One traveler missed the morning train and used the delay to rewrite field notes in the station cafe.
example2_zh: 有一位旅行者误了早班火车，便利用等候时间在车站咖啡馆里改野外笔记。
collocations: a lone traveler｜独自的旅行者 ; traveler's check｜旅行支票
word_family: travel (v. 旅行) ; traveling (n. 旅行)
tip_zh: traveler 是美式拼写。英式 traveller 在本批另有一条，例句和意思都分开写。

meanings_zh: adv. 在楼上 | adj. 楼上的
definition_en: on or to a higher floor | on a higher floor
example1_en: The lab is upstairs, next to the art room.
example1_zh: 实验室在楼上，美术室旁边。
example2_en: An upstairs window was open all night, so the books on that desk felt damp.
example2_zh: 楼上的一扇窗开了一夜，那张桌上的书摸着有些潮。
collocations: go upstairs｜上楼 ; upstairs room｜楼上的房间
tip_zh: upstairs 可作副词或形容词。上楼是 go upstairs，不要说 go to upstairs。

definition_en: the joint between the foot and the leg
example1_en: She twisted her ankle on the wet stair.
example1_zh: 她在湿台阶上扭了脚踝。
example2_en: The nurse wrapped his ankle and told him to skip football for a week.
example2_zh: 护士包好他的脚踝，让他一周别踢足球。
collocations: twist an ankle｜扭伤脚踝 ; ankle sock｜短袜
tip_zh: 脚踝是 ankle。手腕是 wrist。不要对调。

definition_en: a small animal with six legs and usually wings
example1_en: An insect with six legs landed on the leaf.
example1_zh: 一只六条腿的昆虫落在叶子上。
example2_en: Not every small creature is an insect: a spider has eight legs, and the chart shows that.
example2_zh: 不是每种小动物都是昆虫：蜘蛛有八条腿，图上标着呢。
collocations: an insect bite｜虫咬 ; beneficial insect｜益虫
tip_zh: 昆虫六条腿。蜘蛛不是 insect。口语 bug 更宽，不完全等同。

meanings_zh: n. 比赛；竞争 | n. 比赛；竞赛
definition_en: a contest | An organised event in which people try to win.
example1_en: She won first prize in the competition.
example1_zh: 她在比赛中获得一等奖。
example2_en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
example2_zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。
collocations: fierce competition｜激烈竞争 ; competition for jobs｜求职竞争 ; enter a competition｜参加比赛 ; win a competition｜赢得比赛
tip_zh: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

definition_en: something that makes success more difficult
example1_en: Height is not a disadvantage in this role.
example1_zh: 这个角色里身高不是劣势。
example2_en: The disadvantage of a late start is real, and a clear plan can still reduce it.
example2_zh: 起步晚的不利是真的，一份清楚的计划仍然能把它缩小。
collocations: at a disadvantage｜处于不利地位 ; advantages and disadvantages｜利与弊
word_family: advantage (n. 有利条件) ; disadvantaged (adj. 处于困境的)
tip_zh: at a disadvantage 处于不利地位。讨论题常把 advantages and disadvantages 放在一起。

meanings_zh: v. 讨论 | v. 论述
definition_en: to talk about | to examine a subject in speech or writing
example1_en: Let's discuss the plan after lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭后我们讨论一下计划。
example2_en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
example2_zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。
collocations: discuss a problem｜讨论问题 ; discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事 ; discuss in detail｜详细讨论
tip_zh: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

definition_en: a long piece of music for an orchestra
example1_en: The symphony has four movements.
example1_zh: 这部交响乐有四个乐章。
example2_en: We heard the symphony on the radio and followed the slow movement with the score.
example2_zh: 我们从收音机里听这部交响乐，并照着总谱听慢乐章。
collocations: a symphony orchestra｜交响乐团 ; symphony No. 5｜第五交响曲
tip_zh: 一部交响曲是 a symphony。乐团是 a symphony orchestra。形容词 symphonic。

definition_en: to tell someone what you think they should do
example1_en: I advise you to sleep before the listening test.
example1_zh: 我建议你听力考试前先睡觉。
example2_en: The coach advised the runners not to start fast just because the crowd was loud.
example2_zh: 教练劝跑步的人不要因为观众吵就起跑太快。
collocations: advise sb to do｜建议某人做 ; advise against｜劝某人不要
tip_zh: 动词 advise，名词 advice 不可数，已在词库。advise doing 和 advise sb to do 都可以。

definition_en: to create something that did not exist before
example1_en: She did not invent the machine alone.
example1_zh: 这台机器不是她一个人发明的。
example2_en: People invent tools to solve a problem, whereas they discover a star that was already there.
example2_zh: 人们发明工具是为了解决问题，而发现一颗星星时，那颗星本来就在。
collocations: invent a device｜发明一种装置 ; invent an excuse｜编造借口
word_family: invention (n. 发明) ; inventor (n. 发明家) ; inventive (adj. 有发明才能的)
tip_zh: invent 是发明原来没有的东西。discover 已在库里，是发现已存在的东西。invention 也已在库里。invent an excuse 是编借口。

definition_en: to measure how heavy something is
example1_en: Weigh the salt on the digital scale.
example1_zh: 用电子秤称一下盐。
example2_en: Weigh yourself before the race and write the number next to your name.
example2_zh: 赛前称一下体重，把数字写在你的名字旁边。
collocations: weigh sth｜称某物 ; weigh 50 kilos｜重50公斤
tip_zh: 动词 weigh。名词重量是 weight，已在词库。

definition_en: to find for the first time
example1_en: Scientists discover new planets every year.
example1_zh: 科学家每年都发现新行星。
example2_en: Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.
example2_zh: 科学家可能通过研究热带森林中的植物，发现治疗疾病的新方法。
collocations: discover a cure｜发现疗法 ; discover a new species｜发现新物种 ; discover the truth｜发现真相
tip_zh: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

definition_en: to move or travel to a place
example1_en: We go to the stadium on Friday afternoons.
example1_zh: 我们周五下午去体育馆。
example2_en: If food prices go up too quickly, families may buy less fresh fruit for their children.
example2_zh: 如果食品价格涨得太快，家庭可能会给孩子少买新鲜水果。
collocations: go on｜继续 ; go over｜复习 ; go to school｜上学
tip_zh: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone。

definition_en: the light that comes from the sun
example1_en: Sunlight filled the art room by ten.
example1_zh: 十点时阳光铺满了美术教室。
example2_en: Keep the seedlings in sunlight, but move them under the desk if the glass gets too hot.
example2_zh: 让幼苗照到阳光，玻璃太烫时就把它们挪到桌下。
collocations: in the sunlight｜在阳光下 ; bright sunlight｜明亮的阳光
word_family: sun (n. 太阳) ; sunny (adj. 晴朗的) ; sunshine (n. 日光)
tip_zh: sunlight 多作不可数名词。晒太阳是 in the sunlight，不要说 under the sunlight。

definition_en: towards the front
example1_en: Take one step forwards, then stop.
example1_zh: 向前走一步，然后停下。
example2_en: The queue moved forwards only when the door opened, so nobody pushed from the back.
example2_zh: 门开了队伍才向前移，所以没有人从后面推。
collocations: step forwards｜向前跨步 ; backwards and forwards｜来回
word_family: forward (adv. 向前) ; backward (adv. 向后)
tip_zh: 英式副词常用 forwards。没有 s 的 forward 已在库里，意思相近。向后是 backwards。

definition_en: a person who catches fish for a job or as a sport
example1_en: The fisherman mended a net.
example1_zh: 渔民补了一张网。
example2_en: A fisherman on the lake sets out before dawn, and the geography photo shows the lamps on the boats.
example2_zh: 湖上的渔民黎明前就出发，地理照片拍下了船上的灯。
collocations: a local fisherman｜当地渔民 ; fisherman's boat｜渔船
tip_zh: 复数是 fishermen，不是 fishermans。fish 已在库里。性别不明时有人用 fisher。

definition_en: the words a person or a language uses
example1_en: Keep a vocabulary notebook by subject.
example1_zh: 按话题记一本词汇笔记本。
example2_en: A wide vocabulary helps you read the article, but you still need grammar to build the sentence.
example2_zh: 词汇量大有助于读这篇文章，造句仍然需要语法。
collocations: build one's vocabulary｜扩大词汇量 ; vocabulary list｜词汇表
tip_zh: vocabulary 集合名词，一般不加复数。扩大词汇是 build / enlarge your vocabulary。

definition_en: a thin tube of tobacco that people smoke
example1_en: The gate sign says cigarettes are not allowed on campus.
example1_zh: 门口的牌子写着校园内不许吸烟。
example2_en: He dropped a cigarette by the gym, and the guard made him pick it up.
example2_zh: 他把一支烟扔在体育馆旁边，保安让他捡起来。
collocations: a pack of cigarettes｜一包烟 ; light a cigarette｜点烟
tip_zh: cigarette 是纸烟。校园规定里常直接禁止。

meanings_zh: adj. 电的 | adj. 令人激动的
definition_en: using electricity | Full of excitement and energy.
example1_en: electric cars produce less smoke.
example1_zh: 电动汽车产生更少烟雾。
example2_en: Electric buses can reduce urban air pollution, especially when their power comes from renewable sources.
example2_zh: 电动公交车可以减少城市空气污染，尤其是在使用可再生能源供电时。
collocations: electric car｜电动汽车 ; electric current｜电流 ; electric shock｜电击 ; electric atmosphere｜热烈的气氛
tip_zh: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

meanings_zh: adj. 方便的 | adj. 附近的；便于到达的
definition_en: easy to use or reach | Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.
example1_en: Online payment is convenient.
example1_zh: 在线支付很方便。
example2_en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
example2_zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。
collocations: a convenient time｜合适的时间 ; convenient for someone｜对某人方便 ; a convenient location｜便利的位置 ; a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip_zh: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

definition_en: a box, bottle, or jar used to hold something
example1_en: Write the date on the container before you store the powder.
example1_zh: 存放粉末前先在容器上写日期。
example2_en: The container cracked in the freezer, and the soup leaked onto the other food.
example2_zh: 容器在冰箱里裂了，汤漏到了别的食物上。
collocations: a plastic container｜塑料容器 ; a sealed container｜密封容器
tip_zh: container 是装东西的器皿，也可以指货运集装箱。

meanings_zh: n. 遗憾；同情 | v. 同情
definition_en: a feeling that something is unfortunate, or sympathy | to feel sorry for someone
example1_en: It is a pity that the match was cancelled.
example1_zh: 比赛取消了，真可惜。
example2_en: She felt pity for the wet dog and brought a dry towel from the gym office.
example2_zh: 她可怜那只湿淋淋的狗，从体育馆办公室拿来一条干毛巾。
collocations: what a pity｜真可惜 ; feel pity for｜同情
tip_zh: It's a pity that... 表遗憾。同情某人是 feel pity for sb。

meanings_zh: n. 收获；收成 | v. 收割
definition_en: the time or the crop when farmers gather food | to gather a crop
example1_en: Students helped with the grape harvest on Saturday.
example1_zh: 星期六学生们去帮忙收葡萄。
example2_en: They harvest the rice in October, when most of our exams are already over.
example2_zh: 他们十月收稻，那时我们大部分考试已经结束。
collocations: the harvest｜收成 ; harvest rice｜收稻
tip_zh: harvest 可作名词或动词。参考表是收割、收获物。

definition_en: a strong-smelling plant used in cooking
example1_en: Add one clove of garlic to the soup.
example1_zh: 往汤里加一瓣蒜。
example2_en: She fried the garlic first, because the rest of the dish would taste flat without it.
example2_zh: 她先把蒜炒香，不然这道菜其余的味道会发闷。
collocations: a clove of garlic｜一瓣蒜 ; garlic bread｜蒜香面包
tip_zh: 一瓣蒜是 a clove of garlic。garlic 作材料时多不可数。

definition_en: the last meal of the day, or a light evening meal
example1_en: Supper is noodles and fruit tonight.
example1_zh: 今晚晚饭是面条和水果。
example2_en: We ate supper late because the rehearsal did not end until the hall lights dimmed.
example2_zh: 彩排直到礼堂灯光暗下来才结束，我们晚饭吃得很晚。
collocations: have supper｜吃晚饭 ; after supper｜晚饭后
tip_zh: supper 多指晚上较随便的一餐。正式的晚饭也可以说 dinner，各地习惯不同。

meanings_zh: adj. 积极的；活跃的 | adj. 运作中的；起作用的 | adj. 主动语态的
definition_en: busy doing things | currently working or producing an effect | describing a verb whose subject performs the action
example1_en: Stay active after school.
example1_zh: 放学后保持活跃。
example2_en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
example2_zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。
collocations: stay active｜保持活力 ; an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式 ; play an active role｜发挥积极作用 ; active ingredient｜有效成分
tip_zh: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

meanings_zh: n. 烤面包片 | v. 烤；为…干杯
definition_en: bread made hot and brown | to brown bread, or to drink in someone's honour
example1_en: She spread honey on a piece of toast.
example1_zh: 她在一片烤面包上抹了蜂蜜。
example2_en: At the end of dinner they toast the retiring coach and thank him for ten quiet years.
example2_zh: 晚饭末了，他们向即将退休的教练敬酒，感谢他安安静静的十年。
collocations: a slice of toast｜一片烤面包 ; toast bread｜烤面包
tip_zh: 一片烤面包常用 a piece of toast，toast 作食物时多不可数。干杯也是 toast。

definition_en: at what time, or at the time that
example1_en: When does the library close tonight?
example1_zh: 图书馆今晚什么时候关门？
example2_en: When young people only meet friends online, they may lose practice in reading faces and tones.
example2_zh: 当年轻人只在网上见朋友时，他们可能缺少辨认表情和语气的练习。
collocations: when it comes to｜当涉及 ; since when｜从什么时候起
tip_zh: when 引导时间状语从句时，从句常用一般现在时表将来。

definition_en: a person trained to travel in a spacecraft
example1_en: The astronaut waved from the screen.
example1_zh: 宇航员在屏幕里挥了挥手。
example2_en: An astronaut trains for months before a flight, and the science page lists sleep, food, and exercise in orbit.
example2_zh: 宇航员飞行前要训练好几个月，科学专页列出了轨道上的睡眠、饮食和锻炼。
collocations: an astronaut suit｜宇航服 ; train as an astronaut｜接受宇航员训练
tip_zh: astronaut 是航天员。俄国传统说法 cosmonaut 不必写进这条。太空舱见 capsule。

definition_en: a person who paints pictures, or who paints walls
example1_en: The painter left brushes in a jar of water.
example1_zh: 画家把画笔留在一罐水里。
example2_en: A house painter covered the floor before he started on the classroom walls.
example2_zh: 油漆工先把地板罩上，再刷教室的墙。
collocations: portrait painter｜肖像画家 ; house painter｜油漆工
tip_zh: painter 既是画家，也是刷墙的油漆工。看句子里的 brushes 或 walls。

definition_en: to walk without a fixed plan, or for the mind to drift
example1_en: We wander through the old market.
example1_zh: 我们在旧市场里随便走走。
example2_en: Minds wander when a lecture runs long, so the speaker paused and asked a short question.
example2_zh: 讲座一长，心思就会飘走，于是讲的人停下来问了一个很短的问题。
collocations: wander around｜四处走走 ; one's mind wanders｜走神
word_family: wanderer (n. 漫游者) ; wandering (n. 闲逛)
tip_zh: wander 既是没有目的地走，也是走神。不要和 wonder（想知道）弄混。

definition_en: a small rubber bag filled with air or gas
example1_en: A red balloon escaped over the wall.
example1_zh: 一只红气球飞过了墙。
example2_en: The science balloon carried a small box that recorded the temperature high above the field.
example2_zh: 科学气球带了一只小盒子，记录田野高空的温度。
collocations: blow up a balloon｜吹气球 ; hot-air balloon｜热气球
tip_zh: 气球是 balloon。球是 ball。热气球是 hot-air balloon。

meanings_zh: v. 依靠；取决于 | v. 依赖；信赖
definition_en: to need support; to be decided by | to need or trust someone or something for support
example1_en: Success may depend on hard work.
example1_zh: 成功可能取决于努力。
example2_en: Many rural communities depend on reliable public transport to access healthcare, education, and employment opportunities.
example2_zh: 许多农村社区依靠可靠的公共交通来获得医疗、教育和就业机会。
collocations: depend on｜取决于；依赖 ; depend heavily on｜严重依赖 ; depend on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip_zh: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。

definition_en: to disagree with something and try to stop it
example1_en: Many parents oppose the late practice.
example1_zh: 许多家长反对这么晚的训练。
example2_en: I oppose the plan only because the cost is higher than the club can pay.
example2_zh: 我反对这个计划，只是因为费用高于社团付得起的数目。
collocations: oppose a plan｜反对一项计划 ; strongly oppose｜强烈反对
tip_zh: oppose 后面直接加宾语，不说 oppose to。be opposed to 才要 to。

definition_en: a box that slides out of a desk or cupboard
example1_en: Look in the top drawer for the spare key.
example1_zh: 备用钥匙在最上面的抽屉里找。
example2_en: She emptied the drawer onto the desk and found the stamp under a stack of forms.
example2_zh: 她把抽屉倒在桌上，在一叠表格底下找到了邮票。
collocations: the top drawer｜最上层抽屉 ; open a drawer｜打开抽屉
tip_zh: drawer 是抽屉，来自 draw「拉出」。重音在第一个音节。不要把它理解成画画的人。

meanings_zh: n. 刹车 | v. 刹车
definition_en: the device that slows or stops a vehicle | to slow or stop with the brake
example1_en: The back brake on this bike is loose.
example1_zh: 这辆车的后刹车松了。
example2_en: She had to brake hard when a dog ran across the empty street at dusk.
example2_zh: 黄昏时一条狗冲过空街，她只好猛地刹车。
collocations: put on the brake｜踩刹车 ; brake suddenly｜急刹车
tip_zh: 刹车是 brake。打断是 break。两词同音，拼写不同。

definition_en: the natural view of a place, or the painted scene on a stage
example1_en: The lake scenery stopped the bus.
example1_zh: 湖景让车子停了下来。
example2_en: Mountain scenery fills the first chapter, while the play later uses painted scenery for the same valley.
example2_zh: 第一章写满了山景，后面的戏剧又用绘出的布景表现同一条山谷。
collocations: natural scenery｜自然风景 ; stage scenery｜舞台布景
word_family: scene (n. 场景) ; scenic (adj. 风景优美的)
tip_zh: scenery 不可数，不说 a scenery 或 sceneries。舞台布景也用这个词。scene 可以数。

definition_en: a machine that keeps food cold
example1_en: Put the milk back in the fridge.
example1_zh: 把牛奶放回冰箱。
example2_en: The samples stay in the fridge overnight, on the top shelf, away from the fruit.
example2_zh: 样本在冰箱里放一夜，放在顶层，离水果远一点。
collocations: in the fridge｜在冰箱里 ; a fridge magnet｜冰箱磁贴
tip_zh: fridge 是 refrigerator 的口语说法，考纲里两个词都有。参考表这一行的音标是 refrigerator 的，本卡不用。

definition_en: powder made from grain, used for bread
example1_en: Dust the board with flour before you roll the dough.
example1_zh: 擀面团之前先在板上撒一点面粉。
example2_en: The flour was damp, so the bread did not rise and we started another bowl.
example2_zh: 面粉受潮了，面包没发起来，我们又重新和了一盆。
collocations: wheat flour｜小麦粉 ; a bag of flour｜一袋面粉
tip_zh: flour 是面粉。flower 是花，已在词库。读音接近，拼写不同。

definition_en: to notice with the eyes, or to understand
example1_en: I can see the playground from this window.
example1_zh: 我从这扇窗户能看见操场。
example2_en: When people see the cost of wasted food, they are more willing to change what they buy.
example2_zh: 当人们看到浪费食物的代价时，他们更愿意改变购买习惯。
collocations: see sb off｜送行 ; see to｜处理 ; I see｜我明白了
tip_zh: see 强调看见的结果；look 强调看的动作；watch 强调持续观看。

definition_en: a man who works in business, especially as an owner
example1_en: A local businessman paid for the new books.
example1_zh: 一位本地商人付了新书的钱。
example2_en: The businessman visited the workshop and asked how many desks the students still needed.
example2_zh: 那位商人参观了工坊，问学生还缺多少张桌子。
collocations: a successful businessman｜成功的商人 ; local businessman｜本地商人
tip_zh: 考纲这一条是 businessman。女性商人常说 businesswoman。复数 businessmen 别写错。

definition_en: a sweet fruit that is narrow at the top and wider at the bottom
example1_en: This pear is still hard.
example1_zh: 这个梨还是硬的。
example2_en: She sliced a pear into the salad, then saved the second one for the ride home.
example2_zh: 她把一个梨切片加进沙拉，把第二个留到回家的路上吃。
collocations: a ripe pear｜熟梨 ; pear juice｜梨汁
tip_zh: pear 和 pair（一对）同音。写的时候看上下文。复数 pears。

definition_en: a tool with points for lifting food
example1_en: There is a fork beside the plate, and a spoon on the right.
example1_zh: 盘子旁边有一把叉，右边有一把勺。
example2_en: He dropped his fork under the table and had to borrow one from the next tray.
example2_zh: 他把叉子掉到桌下，只好从旁边的托盘借了一把。
collocations: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉 ; a fork｜一把叉
tip_zh: 参考表是餐叉。路的分岔也可以叫 a fork in the road，本卡先记餐具。

definition_en: a person whose job is cutting men's hair
example1_en: The barber opens at nine on Saturday.
example1_zh: 理发师星期六九点开门。
example2_en: A barber in the old street still uses scissors more often than electric clippers.
example2_zh: 老街上的理发师用剪刀仍比电推子多。
collocations: a barber's shop｜理发店 ; go to the barber｜去理发
tip_zh: barber 传统上给男士理发。hairdresser 男女都可以。理发店是 a barber's。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之后 | conj. 在……以后
definition_en: later than a time or event | at a later time than
example1_en: We clean the lab after each experiment.
example1_zh: 每次实验后我们都打扫实验室。
example2_en: After a major flood, schools may have to share buildings until their own classrooms are safe again.
example2_zh: 大洪水之后，学校可能不得不共用校舍，直到自己的教室再次安全。
collocations: after all｜毕竟 ; look after｜照顾 ; one after another｜一个接一个
tip_zh: after 是介词或连词；副词“后来”常用 afterwards 或 later。

meanings_zh: v. 发展；培养 | v. 开发；研制 | v. 逐渐出现；患上
definition_en: to grow or improve | to create a new product, method, or idea | to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling
example1_en: Reading helps develop your vocabulary.
example1_zh: 阅读有助于培养词汇量。
example2_en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
example2_zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。
collocations: develop skills｜培养技能 ; develop a habit｜养成习惯 ; develop new technology｜开发新技术 ; develop symptoms｜出现症状
tip_zh: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

definition_en: a book in which you write what happens each day
example1_en: She writes in her diary after lights-out.
example1_zh: 熄灯后她写日记。
example2_en: He left his diary on the lab bench, and three pages of private notes were open.
example2_zh: 他把日记落在实验台上，三页私人笔记摊开着。
collocations: keep a diary｜写日记 ; a diary entry｜一篇日记
tip_zh: diary 是日记。dairy 是乳品，只差一个字母。

definition_en: with a lot of wind
example1_en: It is too windy for the kite.
example1_zh: 风太大，风筝放不了。
example2_en: A windy platform makes loose papers fly, so the group clips every sheet before the train arrives.
example2_zh: 有风的站台会把散页吹走，所以小组在火车进站前把每张纸都夹住。
collocations: a windy day｜有风的一天 ; windy weather｜大风天气
tip_zh: windy 形容天气。wind 已在库里，作名词是风，作动词是缠绕或蜿蜒，读音不同。比较级 windier。

definition_en: in or to what place
example1_en: Where did you leave your sports shoes?
example1_zh: 你把运动鞋放在哪儿了？
example2_en: Cities need places where teenagers can meet without having to spend money.
example2_zh: 城市需要一些地方，让青少年不必花钱也能见面。
collocations: where there is｜在有……的地方
tip_zh: where 引导地点状语或定语从句，先行词是地点。

definition_en: fuel used in car engines, in British English
example1_en: The generator runs on petrol.
example1_zh: 发电机烧汽油。
example2_en: Never store petrol near the heater, and keep the cap closed in the school shed.
example2_zh: 汽油不要放在暖气旁边，在学校棚屋里也要把盖子拧上。
collocations: a petrol station｜加油站 ; unleaded petrol｜无铅汽油
word_family: petroleum (n. 石油) ; gasoline (n. 汽油，美式)
tip_zh: 英式汽油是 petrol。美式是 gasoline 或 gas。加油站是 a petrol station。本卡只讲安全存放，不写其他用途。

meanings_zh: n. 差异 | n. 分歧；意见不合 | n. 差额；差值
definition_en: the way things are not the same | A disagreement between people or groups | The amount by which one quantity exceeds another
example1_en: Age makes little difference in friendship.
example1_zh: 年龄在友谊中几乎没有差异。
example2_en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
example2_zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。
collocations: the difference between｜……之间的区别 ; make a difference｜产生影响 ; a significant difference｜显著差异 ; settle differences｜解决分歧
tip_zh: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

definition_en: in that place
example1_en: There is a new poster on the back wall.
example1_zh: 后墙上有一张新海报。
example2_en: There are still towns where the nearest hospital is more than an hour away by bus.
example2_zh: 仍有一些城镇，乘公交到最近的医院要一个多小时。
collocations: over there｜在那边 ; here and there｜到处
tip_zh: There be 句中，be 的单复数跟后面真正的主语走。

definition_en: full of energy and interest
example1_en: The discussion stayed lively until the bell.
example1_zh: 讨论一直很活跃，直到铃声响。
example2_en: A lively market filled the square, with fruit, tools, and people calling out prices.
example2_zh: 热闹的市场占满了广场，有水果、工具，还有人喊价。
collocations: a lively discussion｜活跃的讨论 ; lively atmosphere｜活跃的气氛
tip_zh: lively 是形容词，不是副词。活泼地做某事常用 in a lively way。

meanings_zh: adj. 有帮助的 | adj. 乐于助人的
definition_en: useful | Willing to help other people.
example1_en: Your notes were very helpful.
example1_zh: 你的笔记很有帮助。
example2_en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
example2_zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。
collocations: helpful advice｜有用的建议 ; helpful information｜有用的信息 ; helpful staff｜乐于助人的员工 ; find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip_zh: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

definition_en: an illness
example1_en: Clean water helps prevent disease.
example1_zh: 干净的水有助于预防疾病。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
example2_zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。
collocations: heart disease｜心脏病 ; infectious diseases｜传染病 ; prevent disease｜预防疾病 ; the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip_zh: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

definition_en: a person who visits a place or a person
example1_en: Every visitor signs the book at the lab door.
example1_zh: 每位来访者都在实验室门口的本子上签名。
example2_en: A visitor from the partner school sat in on our class and asked about the timetable.
example2_zh: 伙伴学校的一位来访者旁听了我们的课，并问起课表。
collocations: a visitor｜一位来访者 ; visitor center｜游客中心
tip_zh: visitor 是来的人。主人是 host。动词 visit。

definition_en: an informal word for a grandmother
example1_en: Granny knits socks every winter.
example1_zh: 奶奶每年冬天都织袜子。
example2_en: My granny tells the same ferry story each visit, and the details grow kinder, not louder.
example2_zh: 我外婆每次来都讲同一个渡船故事，细节变得更温和，而不是更夸张。
collocations: granny's house｜奶奶家 ; granny flat｜给老人住的小套间
word_family: grandmother (n. 祖母；外祖母) ; grandpa (n. 爷爷；外公)
tip_zh: granny 是口语。作文里更正式的说法是 grandmother。grandpa 已在库里。

meanings_zh: v. 取消 | v. 抵消
definition_en: to stop a planned event | To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.
example1_en: They had to cancel the trip because of rain.
example1_zh: 因为下雨他们不得不取消旅行。
example2_en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
example2_zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。
collocations: cancel a booking｜取消预订 ; cancel a flight｜取消航班 ; cancel out｜抵消
tip_zh: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

definition_en: a period of twelve months
example1_en: This is my second year at this school.
example1_zh: 这是我在这所学校的第二年。
example2_en: A dry year can raise food prices, which hits families who already spend most of their income on meals.
example2_zh: 干旱的一年会推高食品价格，打击那些收入大部分已用于吃饭的家庭。
collocations: year after year｜年复一年 ; all the year round｜一年到头
tip_zh: 在哪一年用 in：in 2024。

meanings_zh: adj. 国际的 | n. 国际比赛；国家队选手
definition_en: between countries | A match between countries, or a player representing a country.
example1_en: English is an international language.
example1_zh: 英语是一门国际语言。
example2_en: International cooperation is essential for tackling environmental problems that extend beyond the borders of individual countries.
example2_zh: 国际合作对于解决超越单个国家边界的环境问题至关重要。
collocations: international trade｜国际贸易 ; international cooperation｜国际合作 ; an international flight｜国际航班 ; international students｜国际学生
tip_zh: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

definition_en: a warm knitted piece of clothing for the top of the body
example1_en: This sweater is too thick for May.
example1_zh: 这件毛衣五月穿太厚了。
example2_en: She folded the sweater with the sleeves inside so it would fit in the small drawer.
example2_zh: 她把袖子塞进毛衣里叠好，这样就能放进小抽屉。
collocations: a wool sweater｜羊毛衫 ; put on a sweater｜穿上毛衣
word_family: sweat (v. 出汗) ; sweatshirt (n. 运动衫)
synonyms: jumper（套头毛衣，英式）, pullover（套头衫）
tip_zh: 英式也说 jumper。sweater 不是 sweat 的人。运动长袖常说 sweatshirt。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……之前 | conj. 在……以前
definition_en: earlier than | earlier than the time when
example1_en: Please wash your hands before lunch.
example1_zh: 午饭前请洗手。
example2_en: Cities should test their flood plans before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
example2_zh: 城市应该在雨季之前检验防汛方案，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。
collocations: before long｜不久 ; the day before｜前一天
tip_zh: before 可作介词、连词或副词。

definition_en: to say what will happen
example1_en: Nobody could predict the final score.
example1_zh: 谁也预测不了最后的比分。
example2_en: The model predicted rain at three, and the first drops came during the break.
example2_zh: 模型预报三点下雨，第一滴雨果然在课间落下来了。
collocations: predict that｜预言…… ; predict the result｜预测结果
tip_zh: predict 后面接名词或 that 从句。prediction 是名词。

definition_en: to carry, to need time, or to do an exam or trip
example1_en: It takes me twenty minutes to walk to school.
example1_zh: 我步行上学要二十分钟。
example2_en: It can take a generation to repair a forest that was cut down in a single decade.
example2_zh: 修复一片十年内被砍光的森林，可能需要一代人的时间。
collocations: take part in｜参加 ; take care of｜照顾 ; take place｜发生
tip_zh: It takes sb time to do 表示花时间；spend 的主语是人。

definition_en: causing damage or injury
example1_en: Too much sugar is harmful to your teeth.
example1_zh: 糖吃太多对牙齿有害。
example2_en: The article explains why smoke is harmful and what the school does to keep the air clean.
example2_zh: 文章说明烟为什么有害，以及学校怎样保持空气干净。
collocations: harmful to｜对…有害 ; harmful effect｜有害影响
tip_zh: harmful to sth。反义是 harmless。名词是 harm。

definition_en: the daughter of one's son or daughter
example1_en: His granddaughter visits on Sundays.
example1_zh: 他的孙女每周日来看他。
example2_en: The letter is for his granddaughter in another city, so he checked the postcode twice.
example2_zh: 这封信是写给住在另一座城市的孙女的，所以他把邮编核对了两遍。
collocations: a granddaughter's visit｜孙女的来访 ; eldest granddaughter｜长孙女
word_family: grandson (n. 孙子；外孙) ; grandfather (n. 祖父) ; grandmother (n. 祖母)
tip_zh: granddaughter 既是孙女也是外孙女，英语不区分父系母系。孙子是 grandson。

definition_en: a person between 13 and 19
example1_en: The course is written for a teenager, not for a child.
example1_zh: 这门课是写给十几岁青少年的，不是给小孩的。
example2_en: Every teenager in the dorm has a different bedtime, which makes the hall noisy.
example2_zh: 宿舍里每个青少年的睡觉时间都不一样，走廊就吵。
collocations: a teenager｜一名青少年 ; teenage years｜青少年时期
tip_zh: thirteen 到 nineteen 都以 -teen 结尾，所以叫 teenager。

meanings_zh: n. 方向；指导 | n. 路线指引；使用说明 | n. 指导；管理
definition_en: the way to go; guidance | instructions explaining how to reach somewhere or do something | the control or guidance of an activity or group
example1_en: Ask for direction if you get lost.
example1_zh: 迷路了就问路。
example2_en: Government investment can influence the direction of technological development by supporting research into cleaner energy sources.
example2_zh: 政府投资可以通过支持清洁能源研究来影响技术发展的方向。
collocations: in the opposite direction｜朝相反方向 ; ask for directions｜问路 ; follow the directions｜遵照说明 ; under the direction of｜在……的指导下
tip_zh: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。

definition_en: very surprising
example1_en: What an amazing view from the hill!
example1_zh: 山顶的景色多么令人惊奇！
example2_en: Recent medical research has produced amazing results, offering new hope to patients with previously untreatable conditions.
example2_zh: 近期医学研究取得了惊人的成果，为患有过去无法治疗的疾病的患者带来了新希望。
collocations: absolutely amazing｜极其精彩的 ; amazing results｜惊人的成果 ; an amazing experience｜一次奇妙的经历
tip_zh: amazing形容令人惊叹的事物；amazed形容人的感受。

definition_en: to create, or to cause something to happen
example1_en: We make posters for the book fair.
example1_zh: 我们为书展制作海报。
example2_en: Noise from a busy road can make it difficult for children to concentrate in class.
