example2_zh: 如果一位老师没有助手，四十人的班很难教好。
collocations: in class｜在课堂上 ; after class｜课后 ; class teacher｜班主任
tip_zh: class 表示课堂时 in class 不加 the。

definition_en: a part in a play, or a function
example1_en: She played the role of the teacher in the play.
example1_zh: 她在剧里扮演老师。
example2_en: Buses play a role in school life that a wider road cannot replace.
example2_zh: 公交在学校生活中的作用，是更宽的马路替代不了的。
collocations: play a role in｜在……中起作用
tip_zh: play a role in 后接名词或 doing。

definition_en: to continue to live or exist
example1_en: The plant survived the frost.
example1_zh: 这棵植物在霜冻后活了下来。
example2_en: A small shop survives when the rent stays possible, not only when the poster is bright.
example2_zh: 小店能留下来，是因为租金仍然付得起，而不只是因为海报鲜亮。
collocations: survive on｜靠……生存
tip_zh: survive 可及物：survive a flood。也可不及物。

definition_en: not many
example1_en: Few students finished the last question.
example1_zh: 很少有学生做完最后一题。
example2_en: A few trees on a hot street help, but they cannot replace a park.
example2_zh: 炎热街道上的几棵树有帮助，但替代不了一座公园。
collocations: a few｜一些 ; quite a few｜不少 ; few of｜……中很少
tip_zh: few 偏否定，几乎没有；a few 表示有一些。都用于可数名词。

meanings_zh: n. 平衡 | v. 使平衡；权衡
definition_en: a state in which weight or importance is equal | to keep something steady, or to weigh options
example1_en: Try to keep a balance between study and sleep.
example1_zh: 尽量在学习和睡眠之间保持平衡。
example2_en: A city budget is a balance between a new road and the clinic that already needs repairs.
example2_zh: 城市预算是在新路和已经需要维修的诊所之间做平衡。
collocations: keep a balance｜保持平衡 ; balance between｜……之间的平衡
tip_zh: balance 作动词是权衡或使平衡。

definition_en: a nation, or land outside towns
example1_en: Students from five countries joined the online class.
example1_zh: 来自五个国家的学生参加了网课。
example2_en: People leave the country for the city when schools and clinics there are too far apart.
example2_zh: 当乡村的学校和诊所彼此离得太远时，人们会离开乡村去城市。
collocations: in the country｜在乡下 ; developing country｜发展中国家
tip_zh: country 表示国家时可数；the country 常指乡村。

definition_en: to know the meaning of something
example1_en: I understand the question now.
example1_zh: 我现在明白这道题了。
example2_en: Planners understand a neighbourhood better when they walk it at the hour children leave school.
example2_zh: 规划者如果在孩子放学的时刻走过一个社区，会理解得更好。
collocations: make oneself understood｜让别人听懂
tip_zh: understand 的过去式仍是 understand，不是 understanded。

definition_en: a title used before a man's surname
example1_en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
example1_zh: 李老师八点开始上课。
example2_en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
example2_zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。
collocations: Mr. Smith｜史密斯先生
tip_zh: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

definition_en: the act of leaving
example1_en: The departure is at four.
example1_zh: 出发时间是四点。
example2_en: The departure time should be on the same sheet as the return time.
example2_zh: 出发时间应当和返回时间写在同一张纸上。
collocations: departure from｜从……出发
tip_zh: 名词 arrival 已在本库。departure 可数。

definition_en: pleasing, or able to draw interest
example1_en: The poster is attractive, but the time is wrong.
example1_zh: 海报好看，但时间写错了。
example2_en: An attractive fare is useless if the last bus does not stop here.
example2_zh: 如果末班车不在这里停，好看的票价也没用。
collocations: attractive to｜对……有吸引力
tip_zh: attract 已在本库。attractive 不要只用在外貌上。

meanings_zh: adj. 高尚的；贵族的 | n. 贵族
definition_en: morally good, or belonging to a high social rank | a person of high social rank
example1_en: A noble aim still needs a written time.
example1_zh: 高尚的目标仍然需要一个写下来的时间。
example2_en: The history text uses noble for a rank, not for a compliment.
example2_zh: 历史课文里的 noble 是一种等级，不是一句夸奖。
collocations: a noble aim｜高尚的目标
tip_zh: noble 作名词是贵族。

definition_en: safety, or the people who guard a place
example1_en: The school improved security at the gate.
example1_zh: 学校加强了校门的安保。
example2_en: Food security means a town can still eat when one road is closed by a flood.
example2_zh: 粮食安全意味着一条路被洪水封闭时，城镇仍然吃得上饭。
collocations: security check｜安全检查 ; a sense of security｜安全感
tip_zh: security 通常不可数。

definition_en: unfair treatment of a person or group
example1_en: Discrimination by race is not a school rule.
example1_zh: 按种族歧视不是校规。
example2_en: A form should not be a tool for discrimination.
example2_zh: 表格不应当成为歧视的工具。
collocations: discrimination against｜对……的歧视
tip_zh: discrimination 通常不可数。说话时要尊重。

meanings_zh: n. 文化 | n. 文化艺术活动 | n. 培养物
definition_en: shared customs and arts | activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work | cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions
example1_en: Food is part of local culture.
example1_zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。
example2_en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
example2_zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。
collocations: local culture｜本土文化 ; cultural exchange｜文化交流 ; popular culture｜流行文化 ; bacterial culture｜细菌培养物
tip_zh: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

meanings_zh: n. 看法；景色 | v. 观看；视为
definition_en: an opinion, or what can be seen | to look at, or to consider
example1_en: What is your view on the new timetable?
example1_zh: 你对新课表有什么看法？
example2_en: A fine view of the river does not show whether the water is safe to drink.
example2_zh: 好看的河景并不能说明水是否可以安全饮用。
collocations: point of view｜观点 ; in view of｜鉴于
tip_zh: view 作动词是“观看”或“视为”。

definition_en: to stop living
example1_en: The flowers die if nobody waters them.
example1_zh: 如果没人浇水，花就会死。
example2_en: Fish die in a river long before the colour of the water warns the town.
example2_zh: 鱼会在水色警告城镇之前很久就死在河里。
collocations: die of｜死于 ; die out｜灭绝
tip_zh: die 是不及物动词，不能说 die sb。过去式是 died。

meanings_zh: v. 击败 | n. 失败
definition_en: to win against someone | a loss
example1_en: The team did not defeat anyone; the match was cancelled.
example1_zh: 队伍没有击败任何人，比赛取消了。
example2_en: A defeat on the field should not decide who may use the library.
example2_zh: 场上的失败不应当决定谁可以使用图书馆。
collocations: defeat sb｜击败某人 ; suffer a defeat｜遭遇失败
tip_zh: defeat 作名词是失败。比 fail 更常用于比赛或战争。

definition_en: a photograph, a kick or throw at a goal, or an injection
example1_en: She took a shot of the old bridge.
example1_zh: 她给那座旧桥拍了一张照片。
example2_en: A last-minute shot can win a match, but a team still needs a plan for the whole game.
example2_zh: 最后一秒的投篮可以赢得比赛，但球队仍需要整场比赛的计划。
collocations: take a shot｜拍摄；尝试 ; a shot at｜一次尝试
tip_zh: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

meanings_zh: n. 借口 | v. 原谅
definition_en: a reason you give to explain a fault | to forgive
example1_en: Tiredness is not an excuse for a locked fire door.
example1_zh: 疲劳不是锁上防火门的借口。
example2_en: Please excuse the delay; the bus was late and the notice said so.
example2_zh: 请原谅这次耽误；公交晚了，通知里也写了。
collocations: an excuse for｜……的借口 ; excuse sb for｜原谅某人
tip_zh: 名词借口常读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词原谅常读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/。表里给的是动词读音。

definition_en: not thin, or not flowing easily
example1_en: The coat is thick enough for this wind.
example1_zh: 这件外套够厚，能挡这种风。
example2_en: Thick smoke in a hallway is a reason to leave, not to look for a bag.
example2_zh: 走廊里的浓烟是离开的理由，不是找包的理由。
collocations: thick coat｜厚外套
tip_zh: thick 可形容物体、液体或烟雾。

definition_en: to look at something carefully
example1_en: The nurse will examine the cut.
example1_zh: 护士会检查这处伤口。
example2_en: Students examine a chart better when the source is on the page.
example2_zh: 来源写在页面上时，学生能更好地查看图表。
collocations: examine sth｜检查某物
tip_zh: exam 和 examination 已在本库。本条不写检查步骤。

definition_en: acceptable
example1_en: Is it okay if I borrow your ruler?
example1_zh: 我借你的尺子可以吗？
example2_en: An okay-looking timetable still fails students if the last bus leaves before school ends.
example2_zh: 看起来没问题的时刻表，如果末班车在放学前离开，仍然会让学生失望。
collocations: be okay｜没问题
tip_zh: okay 与 O.K. 是同一个词。本库只保留 okay。正式写作可用 all right。

definition_en: a disease or a period of being ill
example1_en: The illness kept her at home for three days.
example1_zh: 这场病让她在家待了三天。
example2_en: An illness reported early is easier to treat than one hidden until Friday.
example2_zh: 早报告的病比拖到周五才说的更容易处理。
collocations: a serious illness｜重病
tip_zh: ill 已在本库。illness 可数也可不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 较年幼的；初级的 | adj. 青少年的；年少的 | n. 低年级学生；较年幼者
definition_en: younger or lower in rank | Intended for younger people or involving them | A younger person, or a student below the final year
example1_en: He is a junior member of the team.
example1_zh: 他是队里的初级成员。
example2_en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
example2_zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。
collocations: junior staff｜初级员工 ; junior position｜初级职位 ; junior championship｜青少年锦标赛
tip_zh: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

definition_en: in a true way, or sincerely
example1_en: I am truly sorry for the delay.
example1_zh: 这次耽误我真的很抱歉。
example2_en: A programme is truly open only when students without a laptop can still take part.
example2_zh: 只有没有笔记本电脑的学生也能参加时，一个项目才真正开放。
collocations: yours truly｜敬上
tip_zh: 信末 Yours truly 是客套结尾。truly 强调真实，不只是程度很高。

definition_en: a flat dish, or a flat piece
example1_en: Put the plate in the sink.
example1_zh: 把盘子放进水槽。
example2_en: A cracked plate in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
example2_zh: 食堂里裂了的盘子应当当天扔掉。
collocations: a plate of｜一盘
tip_zh: plate 也可指金属板或车牌。

definition_en: with each other
example1_en: We cleaned the classroom together.
example1_zh: 我们一起打扫了教室。
example2_en: Neighbours who cook together waste less food than families who each buy too much.
example2_zh: 一起做饭的邻居，比各自买得太多的家庭浪费的食物更少。
collocations: together with｜和……一起 ; get together｜聚会
tip_zh: together 是副词，不单独作动词。

definition_en: to make a hole by moving earth
example1_en: They dig a small bed for the tomatoes.
example1_zh: 他们挖一小块地种西红柿。
example2_en: A city that digs up the pavement should leave a safe path for wheelchairs.
example2_zh: 挖开路面的城市应当给轮椅留出安全的路。
collocations: dig a hole｜挖洞
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词都是 dug。

definition_en: the process of making things, or the amount made
example1_en: Food production fell after the dry month.
example1_zh: 干旱的一个月之后，食品产量下降了。
example2_en: Higher production of plastic does not help if the town has nowhere to put the waste.
example2_zh: 如果城镇没有地方放置废物，更高的塑料产量也没有帮助。
collocations: in production｜在生产中
tip_zh: production 通常不可数。

definition_en: to refuse to accept something
example1_en: Don't reject a draft before you read the notes.
example1_zh: 先读评语，再决定要不要否定这份草稿。
example2_en: The journal rejected the article because the dates in the table did not match the text.
example2_zh: 期刊退回了这篇文章，因为表里的日期和正文对不上。
collocations: reject an offer｜拒绝一项提议 ; reject a plan｜否决一项计划
tip_zh: reject 比 refuse 更正式，常用于方案、稿件、申请。

definition_en: a place, a job, or an opinion
example1_en: Write your position in the team on the form.
example1_zh: 在表格上写你在队里的位置。
example2_en: A city's position on housing decides who can live near work and who must travel for hours.
example2_zh: 一座城市在住房上的立场，决定谁能住在工作附近，谁必须赶几小时的路。
collocations: in a position to｜能够 ; take a position｜采取立场
tip_zh: in a position to do 表示有条件做某事。

definition_en: something you own, or the state of owning it
example1_en: The bag is her possession.
example1_zh: 这个包是她的东西。
example2_en: A list of possessions helps a lost bag return.
example2_zh: 一份物品清单能帮助遗失的包回到主人手里。
collocations: in possession of｜拥有 ; personal possessions｜个人物品
tip_zh: possessions 复数常指财物。

definition_en: not in any place
example1_en: The key was nowhere in the lab.
example1_zh: 钥匙在实验室里哪儿都没有。
example2_en: A plan that leads nowhere should be rewritten before the trip.
example2_zh: 哪儿也到不了的计划，应当在出行前改写。
collocations: nowhere else｜没有别的地方
tip_zh: nowhere 已含否定。放在句首时句子常倒装。

meanings_zh: adj. 棕色的 | n. 棕色
definition_en: of the colour of earth or coffee | the colour brown
example1_en: He carried a brown bag.
example1_zh: 他拿着一个棕色的包。
example2_en: Brown flood water in a street is a warning, not a picture to share without context.
example2_zh: 街上的棕色洪水是警报，不是可以不说明背景就转发的照片。
collocations: brown eyes｜棕色眼睛
tip_zh: brown 也可作名词表示棕色。

definition_en: of the Olympic Games
example1_en: The Olympic story is on the wall.
example1_zh: 奥林匹克的故事在墙上。
example2_en: An Olympic poster does not replace a field the school can actually use.
example2_zh: 一张奥林匹克海报代替不了学校真正能用的场地。
collocations: the Olympic Games｜奥林匹克运动会
tip_zh: Olympic 要大写。Olympics 是本批的另一词，指奥运会。

definition_en: to use money or time
example1_en: I spend twenty minutes on new words.
example1_zh: 我花二十分钟学生词。
example2_en: Families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
example2_zh: 物价上涨时，家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。
collocations: spend time doing｜花时间做 ; spend money on｜在……上花钱
tip_zh: spend 的主语是人。It takes time 的主语是事物。过去式是 spent。

definition_en: a repeated design, or a regular way something happens
example1_en: The pattern on the cloth is simple.
example1_zh: 布上的图案很简单。
example2_en: A pattern of late buses is a fact, not one unlucky day.
example2_zh: 公交一再晚点是一个事实，不是倒霉的一天。
collocations: a pattern of｜……的模式
tip_zh: pattern 可数。作动词是仿造。

meanings_zh: n. 液体 | adj. 液体的
definition_en: a substance that flows, like water | in the form of a liquid
example1_en: Do not mix the two liquids.
example1_zh: 不要把这两种液体混在一起。
example2_en: A liquid without a label in the lab should not be used.
example2_zh: 实验室里没有标签的液体不应当使用。
collocations: liquid food｜流质食物
tip_zh: liquid 也可作形容词。本条不写如何混合危险液体。

definition_en: the season between summer and winter; British
example1_en: School starts in autumn.
example1_zh: 学校在秋天开学。
example2_en: An autumn storm still needs the ordinary plan: who calls parents.
example2_zh: 一场秋日暴风雨仍然需要普通的方案：谁给家长打电话。
collocations: in autumn｜在秋天
tip_zh: autumn 是英式。美式秋季常用 fall。本库已有 fall，含义更多。

meanings_zh: v. 帮助 | n. 帮助
definition_en: to make it easier for someone to do something | the act of helping
example1_en: Could you help me move this desk?
example1_zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？
example2_en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
example2_zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。
collocations: help sb with｜在某方面帮助 ; with the help of｜在……帮助下 ; can't help doing｜忍不住
tip_zh: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

meanings_zh: n. 曲调 | v. 调音
definition_en: a series of musical notes | to adjust a musical instrument
example1_en: The tune is simple.
example1_zh: 这个曲调很简单。
example2_en: A tune without words still needs a time if the concert has a bus.
example2_zh: 如果音乐会要坐公交，没有歌词的曲子仍然需要一个时间。
collocations: in tune｜合调 ; a tune of｜一首……曲子
tip_zh: tune 作动词是调音。

definition_en: the one belonging to you
example1_en: This seat is yours if you want it.
example1_zh: 如果你要，这个座位是你的。
example2_en: Yours sincerely is a safe ending when you know the name but not the person well.
example2_zh: 知道对方姓名但并不熟时，Yours sincerely 是稳妥的信末用语。
collocations: yours sincerely｜谨上
tip_zh: 名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。your 是限定词，本库未单列。

definition_en: tall, or great in amount or level
example1_en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
example1_zh: 架子太高，我够不着。
example2_en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
example2_zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。
collocations: high school｜中学 ; at a high speed｜高速
tip_zh: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。

definition_en: a request to come, or the card that carries it
example1_en: The invitation says four o'clock.
example1_zh: 请帖上写着四点。
example2_en: The invitation arrived three days before the concert.
example2_zh: 请帖在音乐会的三天前送到。
collocations: an invitation to｜去……的邀请
tip_zh: 动词 invite 已在本库。

definition_en: a person who does office work or keeps records
example1_en: The club secretary wrote the minutes.
example1_zh: 社团秘书写了会议记录。
example2_en: A school secretary often knows which families cannot be reached by phone.
example2_zh: 学校秘书常常知道哪些家庭用电话联系不上。
collocations: secretary of｜……的秘书
tip_zh: secretary 的复数是 secretaries。

definition_en: to a position on
example1_en: The cat jumped onto the desk.
example1_zh: 猫跳到了书桌上。
example2_en: A ramp onto the platform lets a student with a wheelchair board the same train.
example2_zh: 通向站台的坡道，让坐轮椅的学生能上同一列火车。
collocations: onto the bus｜到公交车上
tip_zh: onto 强调移动到表面之上。已经在上面用 on。

meanings_zh: n. 肉商；屠夫 | v. 屠宰
definition_en: a person who sells or cuts meat | to kill animals for meat
example1_en: The butcher weighs the chicken twice.
example1_zh: 肉商把鸡称了两遍。
example2_en: Buy meat at the butcher only if the counter is clean and the price is written up.
example2_zh: 肉案干净、价格写明了，才在肉铺买肉。
collocations: a butcher's shop｜肉铺 ; the butcher's｜肉铺
tip_zh: the butcher's 是肉铺。第一义是卖肉、切肉的人。动词「屠宰」知道即可，不必描写过程。

definition_en: the small part from which a plant grows
example1_en: The seed is in the soil.
example1_zh: 种子在土里。
example2_en: A seed in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
example2_zh: 学校园子里的种子在八月需要水，而那时大多数学生不在。
collocations: a seed of｜一粒种子；……的萌芽
tip_zh: seed 可数。

meanings_zh: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
definition_en: despite what was just said; in a careless way
example1_en: Anyhow, we still made the bus.
example1_zh: 不管怎样，我们还是赶上了那辆车。
example2_en: The paint was thin; anyhow, the title stayed readable from the back row.
example2_zh: 颜料涂得很薄；不管怎样，后排仍然看得清标题。
collocations: anyhow, ...｜不管怎样 ; do it anyhow｜随便做
tip_zh: anyhow 和 anyway 意思接近。anyway 已在库里，口语里更常见。anyhow 还可以表示「随随便便地」。

definition_en: a date remembered each year
example1_en: The school anniversary is in October.
example1_zh: 校庆在十月。
example2_en: An anniversary speech should name who keeps the building open, not only who founded it.
example2_zh: 周年讲话应当点出是谁让这栋楼一直开着，而不只是谁创办了它。
collocations: the anniversary of｜……的周年
tip_zh: anniversary 可数。

definition_en: something given to a winner
example1_en: The prize was a book, not money.
example1_zh: 奖品是一本书，不是钱。
example2_en: A prize for attendance can hide the student who was ill and still caught up.
example2_zh: 出勤奖可能掩盖那个生过病却仍然补上进度的学生。
collocations: win a prize｜获奖 ; first prize｜一等奖
tip_zh: prize 是奖品。award 已在本库，更常指正式授予的奖。

definition_en: corn that has been heated until it bursts
example1_en: Popcorn spilled under the cinema seat.
example1_zh: 爆米花洒在电影院座位底下。
example2_en: They made popcorn in a pot with a lid, and shook it so it would not burn.
example2_zh: 他们用有盖的锅做爆米花，并且摇一摇，免得烤焦。
collocations: a bag of popcorn｜一袋爆米花 ; popcorn machine｜爆米花机
word_family: corn (n. 玉米) ; pop (v. 爆开)
tip_zh: popcorn 一般不可数。一袋说 a bag of popcorn。

definition_en: how fast something moves
example1_en: The car was travelling at a high speed.
example1_zh: 汽车在高速行驶。
example2_en: Lower speed near a school protects children more than a wider road does.
example2_zh: 学校附近降低速度，比把路修得更宽更能保护孩子。
collocations: at a speed of｜以……的速度 ; speed up｜加速
tip_zh: speed 作动词是“加速”，过去式可以是 sped。

definition_en: a formal public event
example1_en: The ceremony starts at ten.
example1_zh: 典礼十点开始。
example2_en: A ceremony still needs a seat for the parent who comes from work.
example2_zh: 典礼仍然要给下班赶来的家长留一个座位。
collocations: opening ceremony｜开幕式 ; graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼
tip_zh: ceremony 可数。

definition_en: not useful
example1_en: A clock without hands is useless.
example1_zh: 没有指针的钟没有用。
example2_en: Calling a classmate useless ignores the work they already do at home.
example2_zh: 说同学没用，会忽略他们已经在家里做的事。
collocations: useless for｜对……无用
tip_zh: useless 可以形容工具。用在人身上会伤人。

meanings_zh: n. 平均数；一般水平 | n. 平均数；平均水平 | v. 平均为
definition_en: the usual level or mean | A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count. | Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.
example1_en: His scores are above the average.
example1_zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。
example2_en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
example2_zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。
collocations: on average｜平均而言 ; above average｜高于平均水平 ; average income｜平均收入 ; average temperature｜平均气温
tip_zh: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

definition_en: a liquid food
example1_en: The soup is mostly beans.
example1_zh: 这汤主要是豆子。
example2_en: Soup left in the sun is not safe for lunch.
example2_zh: 放在太阳下的汤用来做午饭不安全。
collocations: a bowl of soup｜一碗汤
tip_zh: soup 通常不可数。

definition_en: a person who works in a library
example1_en: The librarian renewed the book.
example1_zh: 图书管理员给这本书续了借。
example2_en: Ask the librarian which shelf holds the atlases, instead of pulling out every large volume.
example2_zh: 问管理员地图册在哪一架，不要把每一本大书都抽出来。
collocations: a school librarian｜学校图书管理员 ; librarian's desk｜管理员服务台
tip_zh: library 已在库里。librarian 是在那里工作的人。读音里 library 的 -rar- 不要吞掉。

definition_en: to put something where it cannot be seen, or to go where you cannot be seen
example1_en: Do not hide the broken step behind a sign.
example1_zh: 不要用一块牌子把坏台阶遮住。
example2_en: Students who hide a worry until the exam give the school no time to help.
example2_zh: 把担心藏到考试的学生，没给学校留下帮忙的时间。
collocations: hide sth from sb｜对某人隐瞒
tip_zh: hide 的过去式是 hid，过去分词是 hidden。

definition_en: not asleep
example1_en: She was awake at six.
example1_zh: 她六点时已经醒着。
example2_en: A student awake all night still needs sleep, not a punishment.
example2_zh: 整夜醒着的学生需要的是睡眠，不是惩罚。
collocations: wide awake｜完全醒着
tip_zh: awake 只作表语。asleep 已在本库。

definition_en: a living thing, especially an animal
example1_en: The story has a small creature, not a monster.
example1_zh: 故事里有一只小生物，不是怪物。
example2_en: Every creature in the pond needs clean water.
example2_zh: 池塘里的每种生物都需要干净的水。
collocations: a sea creature｜海洋生物
tip_zh: creature 可数。本条不写如何伤害动物。

definition_en: a sound, especially a loud or unpleasant one
example1_en: The noise from the road enters the classroom.
example1_zh: 路上的噪声进了教室。
example2_en: Noise at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
example2_zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的噪声就是设计问题。
collocations: make a noise｜发出声音
tip_zh: noise 可数也可不可数。a noise 是一阵声音。

meanings_zh: n. 棍；枝条 | v. 粘住；坚持
definition_en: a thin piece of wood | to attach, or to continue with
example1_en: The dog brought back a stick.
example1_zh: 狗把一根棍子叼了回来。
example2_en: A walking stick at the school gate is a tool, not something to joke about.
example2_zh: 校门口的拐杖是工具，不是拿来开玩笑的东西。
collocations: stick to｜坚持 ; walking stick｜拐杖
tip_zh: 动词 stick 的过去式和过去分词是 stuck。stick to 表示坚持。

definition_en: to decide which one you want
example1_en: Choose a question you can explain.
example1_zh: 选一道你能解释的题。
example2_en: Families choose a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
example2_zh: 家庭选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。
collocations: choose to do｜选择做 ; choose between｜在……之间选择
tip_zh: choose 的过去式是 chose，过去分词是 chosen。

definition_en: to remove something written or stored
example1_en: Delete the old time before you write the new one.
example1_zh: 写下新时间之前，先删掉旧时间。
example2_en: Do not delete the only copy of the class list.
example2_zh: 不要删掉班级名单的唯一副本。
collocations: delete sth from｜从……删除
tip_zh: delete 比 remove 更常用于文字和文件。

meanings_zh: prep. 除……以外（还有） | adv. 而且
definition_en: in addition to | in addition
example1_en: Besides English, she studies history.
example1_zh: 除了英语，她还学历史。
example2_en: Besides the fare, the later bus matters because students can stay for the club.
example2_zh: 除了票价，晚班车重要是因为学生可以留下参加社团。
collocations: besides that｜除此之外
tip_zh: besides 表示包括在内的“还有”。except 是排除。作副词是“而且”。

definition_en: a film
example1_en: We saw a movie about a small town.
example1_zh: 我们看了一部关于小镇的电影。
example2_en: A movie can show a problem, but the town still has to decide what to do on Monday.
example2_zh: 电影可以展示一个问题，但城镇仍要决定星期一做什么。
collocations: go to the movies｜去看电影 ; movie star｜电影明星
tip_zh: movie 是美式常用词；英式更常说 film。

meanings_zh: n. 泵 | v. 用泵抽
definition_en: a machine that moves liquid or air | to move liquid or air with a pump
example1_en: The pump is off.
example1_zh: 泵关着。
example2_en: A pump that fails in August leaves the garden dry.
example2_zh: 八月坏掉的泵会让园子变干。
collocations: water pump｜水泵
tip_zh: pump 作动词是用泵抽。本条不写危险操作。

definition_en: happening often, or shared
example1_en: Colds are common in winter.
example1_zh: 冬天感冒很常见。
example2_en: A common timetable for buses and schools would stop students waiting in the dark.
example2_zh: 公交和学校共用的时刻表，能避免学生在黑暗中等候。
collocations: in common｜共同的 ; common sense｜常识
tip_zh: common 强调经常发生或共有；ordinary 强调平凡、不特别。

definition_en: not clear or exact
example1_en: His answer was vague and hard to mark.
example1_zh: 他的回答含糊，很难打分。
example2_en: A vague memory of the street was not enough, so we checked the map again.
example2_zh: 对那条街只有模糊的记忆不够，我们又核对了地图。
collocations: a vague idea｜模糊的想法 ; vague about｜对…说不清
tip_zh: vague 是说不清、不具体。反义可以是 explicit 或 clear。

definition_en: to divide into parts
example1_en: Split the class into two groups.
example1_zh: 把班级分成两组。
example2_en: Cities that split one bus into two short routes can help students who live past the old stop.
example2_zh: 把一路公交拆成两条短线的城市，能帮助住在旧站以外的学生。
collocations: split up｜分手；分开 ; split into｜分成
tip_zh: split 的过去式和过去分词仍是 split。

definition_en: to think that something is true
example1_en: I believe we can finish the project tonight.
example1_zh: 我相信我们今晚能做完这个项目。
example2_en: Students should not believe a chart until they know who collected the numbers and why.
example2_zh: 学生在弄清数字是谁收集的、为什么收集之前，不该轻信一张图表。
collocations: believe in｜信任；信仰 ; believe it or not｜信不信由你
tip_zh: believe 后接 that 从句或 sb；believe in 表示信任或信仰。

meanings_zh: n. 火车 | v. 训练
definition_en: a railway vehicle | to teach a skill
example1_en: The train leaves at seven.
example1_zh: 火车七点开。
example2_en: A late train can make a student miss the first lesson even when the school itself starts on time.
example2_zh: 晚点的火车会让学生错过第一节课，即使学校本身准时开始。
collocations: by train｜乘火车 ; train station｜火车站
tip_zh: train 作动词是“训练”。

definition_en: thin material for writing, or a newspaper
example1_en: Write your name on the paper.
example1_zh: 把名字写在纸上。
example2_en: A paper exam in a hot room measures heat as well as knowledge.
example2_zh: 炎热房间里的纸笔考试，测量的不只是知识，还有热。
collocations: a piece of paper｜一张纸 ; on paper｜在纸面上
tip_zh: paper 表示纸张时不可数。a paper 可以是一份报纸或一篇论文。

definition_en: a container used to boil water
example1_en: The kettle switched itself off.
example1_zh: 水壶自己跳闸了。
example2_en: Fill the kettle before the meeting, and keep the cord away from the sink.
example2_zh: 开会前把水壶灌上水，电线不要靠近水槽。
collocations: boil the kettle｜烧水 ; an electric kettle｜电热水壶
tip_zh: 英式 kettle 就是烧水的壶。美式有时说 tea kettle。a different kettle of fish 是「另一码事」。

definition_en: a book or film with an exciting, frightening plot
example1_en: That thriller kept me awake too late.
example1_zh: 那部惊险片让我看得太晚。
example2_en: The thriller ends on a train, and the class argued about who had taken the case.
example2_zh: 这部惊险故事在火车上收尾，全班争论是谁拿走了箱子。
collocations: a crime thriller｜犯罪惊悚作品 ; thriller writer｜惊险小说作家
tip_zh: thriller 可以是小说或电影。惊险本身不是 horror 那种纯粹吓人。

meanings_zh: adj. 对面的；相反的 | n. 对立面 | prep. 在……对面
definition_en: facing, or completely different | a person or thing that is completely different | across from
example1_en: The shop is opposite the school.
example1_zh: 商店在学校对面。
example2_en: The opposite choice, a later bus, helps the students who stay for sport.
example2_zh: 相反的选择，也就是晚一班车，能帮助留下来运动的学生。
collocations: opposite to｜与……相反 ; the opposite of｜……的反面
tip_zh: opposite 作介词也可表示在对面。名词是“相反的事物”。

definition_en: large in size or importance
example1_en: We need a bigger table for the group work.
example1_zh: 小组活动我们需要一张更大的桌子。
example2_en: A big sports event can fill hotels while leaving ordinary residents with higher rents.
example2_zh: 一场大型体育赛事可以住满酒店，同时让普通居民面对更高的房租。
collocations: a big deal｜一件大事
tip_zh: big 多用于口语；large 更中性，great 强调程度或情感。

definition_en: dried stems of grain plants
example1_en: The model house is made of straw and glue.
example1_zh: 这个模型房子是用稻草和胶水做的。
example2_en: Straw covered the floor of the shed, and we shook it off our shoes before the bus.
example2_zh: 棚子地上铺着稻草，上车前我们把它从鞋上抖掉。
collocations: a straw hat｜草帽 ; a bale of straw｜一捆稻草
tip_zh: 参考表只写稻草。喝饮料的吸管也叫 straw，本卡按表先记稻草。

definition_en: not able
example1_en: She was unable to attend the first class.
example1_zh: 她没能上第一节课。
example2_en: A student unable to climb the stairs still needs a way into the lab.
example2_zh: 上不了楼梯的学生，仍然需要一条进实验室的路。
collocations: unable to do｜不能做
tip_zh: unable 后接 to do。able 已在本库。表里这一行的音标不对，本库用 espeak-ng。

definition_en: the part of the body at the end of the arm | to pass something to someone
example1_en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
example1_zh: 发言前请举手。
example2_en: A helping hand from an older student can matter more than another printed worksheet.
example2_zh: 高年级学生伸来的一只援手，可能比又一张打印的练习纸更重要。
collocations: by hand｜用手 ; on the one hand｜一方面 ; give sb a hand｜帮忙
tip_zh: hand in 是上交。hand 作动词是“递”。

definition_en: a period of ten years
example1_en: The school is a decade old.
example1_zh: 这所学校有十年了。
example2_en: A decade of the same broken step is a choice, not an accident.
example2_zh: 同一个坏台阶过了十年，是一种选择，不是意外。
collocations: for a decade｜十年之久 ; the last decade｜过去十年
tip_zh: decade 可数。

definition_en: a tool with a sharp blade used for shaving
example1_en: Keep the razor in its case.
example1_zh: 剃须刀放在盒子里。
example2_en: A blunt razor pulls the skin, so he replaced the blade before the photo day.
example2_zh: 钝的剃须刀会拉扯皮肤，所以他在拍照日前换了刀片。
collocations: a safety razor｜安全剃须刀 ; a razor blade｜刀片
word_family: shave (v. 刮) ; razor-sharp (adj. 极锋利的)
tip_zh: razor 是剃须工具。刀片是 a razor blade。用完收好，不要当玩具。

meanings_zh: adj. 女的；雌的 | n. 女性；雌性
definition_en: of the sex that can produce young | a female person or animal
example1_en: The form has a box for male or female.
example1_zh: 表格上有男或女的一栏。
example2_en: A female engineer visiting the class shows a possible job, not only a word in a textbook.
example2_zh: 一位女工程师来到班上，展示的是一种可能的工作，而不只是课本里的一个词。
collocations: female student｜女学生
tip_zh: female 可作形容词或名词。填写表格时表示性别。

definition_en: farming
example1_en: Agriculture still feeds the town.
example1_zh: 农业仍然养活这座城镇。
example2_en: A lesson on agriculture should name who does the work.
example2_zh: 农业课应当写出是谁在干活。
collocations: agriculture of｜……的农业
tip_zh: 形容词 agricultural 是本批的另一词。agriculture 通常不可数。

definition_en: a large amount, or ordinary people as a group
example1_en: A mass of leaves blocked the drain.
example1_zh: 一大堆叶子堵住了排水口。
example2_en: The masses use the early bus, so a fare rise hits them before it hits anyone with a car.
example2_zh: 普通大众坐早班车，所以票价上涨先打击他们，而不是有车的人。
collocations: a mass of｜大量 ; the masses｜群众
tip_zh: a mass of 后可接可数或不可数名词。the masses 指广大民众。

meanings_zh: adj. 黄色的 | n. 黄色
definition_en: of the colour of a lemon or the sun | the colour yellow
example1_en: The yellow bus is ours.
example1_zh: 那辆黄色的车是我们的。
example2_en: Yellow lines on the road mean more when students know why they are there.
example2_zh: 当学生知道黄线为什么在那里时，路上的黄线才更有意义。
collocations: yellow line｜黄线
tip_zh: yellow 也可作名词“黄色”。

definition_en: to form a picture in the mind
example1_en: Imagine a street where children can walk safely.
example1_zh: 想象一条孩子可以安全走路的街。
example2_en: It is hard to imagine a later school start unless the buses change too.
example2_zh: 除非公交也改时间，否则很难想象推迟上学。
collocations: imagine doing｜想象做
tip_zh: imagine 后接名词、doing 或 that 从句。

definition_en: a set of papers or computer data about one subject
example1_en: Please save the file before you close it.
example1_zh: 关闭前请保存文件。
example2_en: A paper file and a computer file of the same student should not disagree.
example2_zh: 同一名学生的纸质档案和电脑档案不应当互相矛盾。
collocations: a file of｜一份……档案 ; on file｜存档
tip_zh: file 也可作动词“把……归档”。计算机里的文档也叫 file。

definition_en: a company that carries passengers by plane
example1_en: Which airline is the class taking to Shanghai?
example1_zh: 班级去上海坐哪家航空公司？
example2_en: The airline moved the flight to the afternoon, so the hotel booking had to change too.
example2_zh: 航空公司把航班改到下午，旅馆预订也得改。
collocations: an airline｜一家航空公司 ; the national airline｜国家航空公司
tip_zh: 参考表没有 airline。它是运营航班的公司，不是飞机本身。

definition_en: having a lot of money, or full of something
example1_en: The soil here is rich and good for vegetables.
example1_zh: 这里的土壤肥沃，适合种菜。
example2_en: A rich city can still have neighbourhoods where children share one small room.
example2_zh: 富裕的城市里，仍可能有孩子合住一间小屋的社区。
collocations: rich in｜富含 ; the rich｜富人
tip_zh: the rich 表示一类人。rich in 后接所富含的东西。

definition_en: belonging to an early stage, or very simple
example1_en: Primitive tools were made of stone.
example1_zh: 原始工具是石头做的。
example2_en: The hut was primitive, with one bench and a hole in the roof for smoke.
example2_zh: 棚屋很简陋，只有一条长凳，屋顶留了个出烟的洞。
collocations: primitive society｜原始社会 ; primitive conditions｜简陋的条件
tip_zh: primitive 可以是历史早期的，也可以是条件简陋的。不要用它嘲笑别人。

meanings_zh: n. 影响 | v. 影响
definition_en: the power to change someone or something | to change how someone thinks or acts
example1_en: His teacher had a strong influence on him.
example1_zh: 老师对他影响很大。
example2_en: Peer influence can push a student toward a club or away from one.
example2_zh: 同伴的影响可以把学生推向一个社团，也可以把他们推开。
collocations: have an influence on｜对……有影响 ; under the influence of｜在……影响下
tip_zh: influence 后接 on。作动词时直接接宾语：influence somebody。

definition_en: what something is made of, or information for a piece of work
example1_en: The bag is made of recycled material.
example1_zh: 这个包是用回收材料做的。
example2_en: Teaching material about floods should include the streets children actually use.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的教材应该包括孩子真正走的那些街。
collocations: raw material｜原材料 ; reading material｜阅读材料
tip_zh: material 作“材料”时可数或不可数。作形容词是“物质的”。

definition_en: a student with a class duty, or a screen
example1_en: The monitor locked the lab.
example1_zh: 班长锁了实验室。
example2_en: A monitor on the wall does not replace a person who knows the students.
example2_zh: 墙上的监视器代替不了认识学生的人。
collocations: class monitor｜班长
tip_zh: monitor 也可作动词“监视”。班长是中国课堂里的常用义。

definition_en: an idea that someone offers
example1_en: The suggestion is on the board.
example1_zh: 建议写在黑板上。
example2_en: A suggestion about the bus should include the return time.
example2_zh: 关于公交的建议应当包括返回时间。
collocations: a suggestion for｜对……的建议
tip_zh: 动词 suggest 已在本库。suggestion 可数。

meanings_zh: n. 堂（表）兄弟；堂（表）姐妹
definition_en: the child of your aunt or uncle
example1_en: Her cousin will share the book.
example1_zh: 她的表姐会和她合用这本书。
example2_en: A form that says cousin should still leave space for another name.
example2_zh: 写着表亲的表格，仍然应当给另一个名字留出位置。
collocations: a cousin of｜……的表亲
tip_zh: cousin 可指表兄弟或表姐妹，不标明性别。

definition_en: the reflexive form of we
example1_en: We cleaned the lab ourselves.
example1_zh: 实验室是我们自己打扫的。
example2_en: We cannot blame the timetable if we wrote it ourselves and left out the last bus.
example2_zh: 如果课表是我们自己写的，又漏了末班车，就不能怪课表。
collocations: by ourselves｜我们独自
tip_zh: ourselves 是反身代词。by ourselves 表示独自。

meanings_zh: v. 提供；出价 | n. 提供；出价
definition_en: to say you will give or do something | a proposal to give or pay
example1_en: The library offers a quiet room after school.
example1_zh: 图书馆放学后提供一间安静的房间。
example2_en: Towns that offer night buses help workers who finish after the regular service stops.
example2_zh: 提供夜班公交的城镇，帮助那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人。
collocations: offer to do｜主动提出做 ; offer sb sth｜向某人提供
tip_zh: offer 后可接 to do 或双宾语。

definition_en: a flat green part of a plant
example1_en: A yellow leaf fell on the path.
example1_zh: 一片黄叶落在小路上。
example2_en: One leaf in a textbook does not show how the whole tree lives.
example2_zh: 课本里的一片叶子说明不了整棵树怎样生活。
collocations: a fallen leaf｜一片落叶
tip_zh: 复数是 leaves。

meanings_zh: v. 居住；生活 | adj. 现场的；活的
definition_en: to have one's home, or to be alive | happening now, or alive
example1_en: We live near the old market.
example1_zh: 我们住在旧市场附近。
example2_en: People who live beside a busy road pay a health cost that does not appear on the rent receipt.
example2_zh: 住在繁忙道路旁的人承担着健康代价，而这不会出现在房租收据上。
collocations: live on｜以……为生 ; live up to｜不辜负
tip_zh: live 作动词读 /lɪv/；作形容词“现场的”读 /laɪv/。

definition_en: fitting closely, or firmly fixed
example1_en: The lid is too tight.
example1_zh: 盖子太紧了。
example2_en: A tight budget can still buy the lock if the lab door does not close.
example2_zh: 如果实验室的门关不上，紧的预算也仍然应当先买锁。
collocations: tight schedule｜紧凑的日程
tip_zh: tight 可形容衣服、时间或预算。

meanings_zh: n. 种类 | v. 分类
definition_en: a type | to arrange into groups
example1_en: What sort of book do you want?
example1_zh: 你想要哪一种书？
example2_en: The sort of food sold at the gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
example2_zh: 门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。
collocations: sort of｜有点儿；某种 ; all sorts of｜各种各样
tip_zh: sort 作动词是“分类”。

definition_en: a planned piece of work
example1_en: Our project is about the river behind the school.
example1_zh: 我们的课题是关于学校后面的河。
example2_en: A project that never asks local people can solve the wrong problem.
example2_zh: 从不询问当地人的项目，可能会解决一个错误的问题。
collocations: project work｜课题作业
tip_zh: project 作名词重音常在前；作动词“投射、预计”时重音常在后。

definition_en: kindness shown when you could punish
example1_en: The story ends with mercy, not with shame.
example1_zh: 故事以怜悯结束，不是以羞辱结束。
example2_en: Mercy for a late form is fair when the bus never came.
example2_zh: 公交根本没来时，原谅迟交的表格是公平的。
collocations: show mercy｜表示怜悯 ; at the mercy of｜受……支配
tip_zh: mercy 通常不可数。

definition_en: a woman who acts in plays or films
example1_en: The actress visited the drama club.
example1_zh: 这位女演员来了戏剧社。
example2_en: An actress who only reads the lines still needs the crew that built the set.
example2_zh: 只念台词的女演员，仍然需要搭景的那组人。
collocations: an actress in｜……里的女演员
tip_zh: actor 已在本库，现在也可泛指演员。actress 专指女演员。

definition_en: useful and easy to use or reach
example1_en: A small dictionary is handy on the desk.
example1_zh: 桌上放一本小词典很方便。
example2_en: The pocket map is handy when the station has no clear signs overhead.
example2_zh: 车站头顶没有清楚的牌子时，袖珍地图就派上用场。
collocations: come in handy｜派上用场 ; handy tool｜好用的工具
tip_zh: come in handy 表示日后用得上。不要写成 handly。

definition_en: liked by many people
example1_en: The reading club is popular this term.
example1_zh: 读书社团这学期很受欢迎。
example2_en: A popular beach can damage the very coast people come to see.
example2_zh: 受欢迎的海滩可能破坏人们前来观看的那片海岸。
collocations: be popular with｜受……欢迎
tip_zh: popular 后接 with 表示受某类人欢迎。

definition_en: to repair, or to decide
example1_en: Can you fix the clock in the hall?
example1_zh: 你能修大厅里的钟吗？
example2_en: Cities should fix the crossing before they fix the paint on the school wall.
example2_zh: 城市应当先修好路口，再去刷学校墙上的漆。
collocations: fix a time｜确定时间 ; fix up｜安排；修理
tip_zh: fix 在美式口语里常指修理。确定日期也用 fix。

definition_en: a room for art, music, or broadcasting
example1_en: The art studio is on the top floor.
example1_zh: 美术工作室在顶楼。
example2_en: A studio with one door still needs a window that opens.
example2_zh: 只有一扇门的工作室，仍然需要一扇能开的窗。
collocations: art studio｜美术工作室 ; recording studio｜录音室
tip_zh: studio 可数。复数是 studios。

definition_en: done in a short time
example1_en: We had a quick review before the test.
example1_zh: 测验前我们快速复习了一下。
example2_en: A quick warning is useless if the path to higher ground is not marked.
example2_zh: 如果通往高地的路没有标出，快速的警报也没有用。
collocations: be quick｜快点
tip_zh: quick 的副词是 quickly。fast 本身可作副词。

meanings_zh: prep. 穿过；在对面 | adv. 横过
definition_en: from one side to the other | from one side to the other
example1_en: There is a bookshop across the street.
example1_zh: 街对面有一家书店。
example2_en: A bridge across the river can cut a student's journey from an hour to ten minutes.
example2_zh: 河上的一座桥可以把学生的路程从一小时缩短到十分钟。
collocations: come across｜偶然遇见 ; across from｜在……对面
tip_zh: across 强调从表面一边到另一边；through 强调从内部穿过。

definition_en: the back part of the foot, or of a shoe
example1_en: A blister formed on her left heel.
example1_zh: 她左脚后跟起了一个水泡。
example2_en: The shoe heel came loose on the stairs, so she walked the rest of the way in gym shoes.
example2_zh: 鞋跟在楼梯上松了，剩下的路她换了运动鞋走。
collocations: high heels｜高跟鞋 ; the heel of a shoe｜鞋跟
tip_zh: 脚后跟和鞋跟都是 heel。治愈是 heal，拼写差一个字母，意思完全不同。

definition_en: to act in a particular way
example1_en: Please behave during the ceremony.
example1_zh: 典礼期间请守规矩。
example2_en: The class behaved quietly in the museum, even in the room with the drums.
example2_zh: 班级在博物馆里很安静，连有鼓的那间也是。
collocations: behave oneself｜守规矩 ; behave well｜表现好
tip_zh: 参考表写「守规矩，行为」。行为作名词时本库用 behavior。behave well / badly 描述表现。

meanings_zh: n. 邮件；岗位；柱 | v. 邮寄；张贴
definition_en: mail, a job, or a pole | to send by mail, or to put up a notice
example1_en: I will send the form by post.
example1_zh: 我会把表格寄出。
example2_en: A post in a village school is hard to fill if the teacher must travel two hours each way.
example2_zh: 如果老师每天要单程走两小时，乡村学校的岗位就很难有人来。
collocations: post office｜邮局 ; by post｜邮寄
tip_zh: post 作动词是“邮寄”或“张贴”。美式邮件多用 mail。

definition_en: a container of soft material
example1_en: My bag is under the desk.
example1_zh: 我的包在桌子下面。
example2_en: A clear bag rule at the gate should still leave room for a student's medicine.
example2_zh: 门口的透明包规定，仍应当给学生的药留出位置。
collocations: school bag｜书包 ; a bag of｜一袋
tip_zh: bag 可数。a bag of 后接所装的东西。

definition_en: a stick used in some ball games, or a flying animal
example1_en: The bat is in the sports room.
example1_zh: 球棒在体育室。
example2_en: A bat in the school roof is a reason to call an adult, not to chase it.
example2_zh: 屋顶上的蝙蝠是叫成年人的理由，不是去追它。
collocations: a baseball bat｜棒球棒
tip_zh: 球棒和蝙蝠是同一个词。本条不写如何伤害动物。

definition_en: British spelling of organization
example1_en: The organisation runs the late bus.
example1_zh: 这个组织运营晚班车。
example2_en: An organisation that hides its fees is harder for families to trust.
example2_zh: 隐瞒费用的组织更难让家庭信任。
collocations: an organisation of｜一个……组织
tip_zh: organisation 是英式，organization 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

definition_en: money paid for a service
example1_en: The fee is on the notice.
example1_zh: 费用写在通知上。
example2_en: A fee that is not written down is not a choice a family can make.
example2_zh: 没写下来的费用，不是家庭能够作出的选择。
collocations: a fee for｜……的费用 ; school fees｜学费
tip_zh: fee 可数。学费常用复数 fees。

meanings_zh: v. 适合；合身 | adj. 健康的；适合的
definition_en: to be the right size or kind | healthy, or suitable
example1_en: These shoes do not fit.
example1_zh: 这双鞋不合脚。
example2_en: A school timetable should fit the buses, or students will arrive after the lesson has started.
example2_zh: 课表应该配合公交，否则学生会在课开始后才到。
collocations: fit in｜适应 ; keep fit｜保持健康
tip_zh: fit 作形容词是“健康的”或“适合的”。过去式可以是 fitted。

definition_en: usual and expected
example1_en: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.
example1_zh: 考试前紧张是正常的。
example2_en: A normal school day becomes unsafe when the road outside has no pavement.
example2_zh: 当外面的路没有人行道时，普通的上学日会变得不安全。
collocations: normal temperature｜正常体温 ; return to normal｜恢复正常
tip_zh: normal 是形容词；normally 是副词。

definition_en: the wish to eat
example1_en: A long walk gave me an appetite.
example1_zh: 走了很久，我有了食欲。
example2_en: She had no appetite after the flu, so lunch was only soup and a piece of bread.
example2_zh: 流感之后她没有胃口，午饭只有汤和一片面包。
collocations: lose one's appetite｜没了食欲 ; a good appetite｜好胃口
tip_zh: appetite 是想吃东西的欲望。胃口好是 a good appetite。

definition_en: a game played with a racket and a ball
example1_en: Tennis practice is at four.
example1_zh: 网球训练在四点。
example2_en: A tennis court that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
example2_zh: 黄昏就锁上的网球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。
collocations: play tennis｜打网球
tip_zh: play tennis 不加 the。

definition_en: the title of a newspaper story in large print
example1_en: The headline used the wrong date.
example1_zh: 大标题上的日期写错了。
example2_en: A headline across the school paper said the gym roof would be repaired in May.
example2_zh: 校报通栏大标题说体育馆屋顶将在五月修好。
collocations: a newspaper headline｜报纸标题 ; hit the headlines｜成为头条新闻
tip_zh: headline 是标题，不是头一行正文。

definition_en: a person who takes photographs
example1_en: The photographer asked before taking the picture.
example1_zh: 摄影师拍照前先问过。
example2_en: A photographer at a school event should not post a face without permission.
example2_zh: 学校活动的摄影师不应当未经允许发布人脸。
collocations: a photographer for｜……的摄影师
tip_zh: 名词 photograph 是本批的另一词。

meanings_zh: v. 考虑；认为 | v. 认为；视为 | v. 顾及；考虑到
definition_en: to think about carefully | to have a particular opinion about someone or something | to take someone or something into account
example1_en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
example1_zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。
example2_en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
example2_zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。
collocations: consider doing something｜考虑做某事 ; consider the consequences｜考虑后果 ; consider all options｜考虑所有选择 ; be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip_zh: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

definition_en: trust in paying later, a school unit, or praise
example1_en: She got extra credit for the project.
example1_zh: 她因这个课题得到了额外学分。
example2_en: Credit for a cleaner river belongs to the people who stopped the waste, not only to the speech.
example2_zh: 把河变干净的功劳属于制止排污的人，而不只属于那篇讲话。
collocations: credit card｜信用卡 ; to one's credit｜值得表扬
tip_zh: credit 的几个义要靠搭配区分。

definition_en: connected with a god, or treated with great respect
example1_en: The visit included a sacred place for those who wanted it.
example1_zh: 参观包括一处圣地，给想去的人。
example2_en: A school can explain a sacred object without telling every student to believe.
example2_zh: 学校可以讲解一件圣物，而不要求每个学生去信。
collocations: sacred to｜对……神圣
tip_zh: 表里的中文写成了 scared（害怕）。音标是 sacred，本库按“神圣的”写。本条不是劝人信教。

meanings_zh: n. 口罩；面具 | v. 掩饰
definition_en: a cover for the face | to hide something
example1_en: The mask is by the clinic door.
example1_zh: 口罩在医务室门边。
example2_en: A mask in a health lesson is a tool, and the lesson should say when to change it.
example2_zh: 健康课里的口罩是工具，课上应当说明何时更换。
collocations: wear a mask｜戴口罩
tip_zh: mask 作动词是掩饰。本条不写如何伤害。

meanings_zh: v. 通过；传递；经过 | n. 通行证；及格
definition_en: to succeed, hand over, or go by | a permit, or a successful result
example1_en: I hope to pass the listening test.
example1_zh: 我希望通过听力测验。
example2_en: Students who pass a crowded junction every morning need a light, not only a higher test score.
example2_zh: 每天早晨经过拥挤路口的学生需要一盏灯，而不只是更高的考分。
collocations: pass on｜传递 ; pass by｜经过
tip_zh: pass 的过去式是 passed。past 是介词或名词，不要拼混。

definition_en: belonging to a king or queen
example1_en: The royal garden is open on Sunday.
example1_zh: 皇家花园周日开放。
example2_en: A royal visit fills the news, while the town's ordinary market still has to open on Monday.
example2_zh: 王室来访会占满新闻，而镇上的普通集市周一仍然得开。
collocations: the royal family｜王室
tip_zh: royal 是形容词。国王或女王用 king、queen。

definition_en: a sweet food made by bees
example1_en: There is honey in the tea.
example1_zh: 茶里有蜂蜜。
example2_en: Honey that hides nuts should say so on the label.
example2_zh: 藏着坚果的蜂蜜应当在标签上写明。
collocations: a spoon of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
tip_zh: honey 通常不可数。表里这一行的音标是 honest，本库不用。

meanings_zh: n. 气候 | n. 社会环境；风气；氛围
definition_en: usual weather of a place | The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.
example1_en: The climate here is warm and wet.
example1_zh: 这里的气候温暖潮湿。
example2_en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
example2_zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。
collocations: climate change｜气候变化 ; mild climate｜温和的气候 ; political climate｜政治环境
tip_zh: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

definition_en: not comfortable
example1_en: The chair is uncomfortable.
example1_zh: 这把椅子不舒服。
example2_en: An uncomfortable question about home should be asked in private.
example2_zh: 关于家庭的令人不适的问题，应当私下问。
collocations: uncomfortable with｜对……不自在
tip_zh: comfortable 已在本库。

definition_en: a senior official who represents a country abroad
example1_en: The ambassador visited the school.
example1_zh: 大使参观了学校。
example2_en: A speech by an ambassador does not replace the bus the town was promised.
example2_zh: 大使的讲话代替不了城镇被承诺的那路公交。
collocations: an ambassador to｜驻……的大使
tip_zh: ambassador 可数。

definition_en: a small animal often kept as a pet
example1_en: The cat sleeps in the sunny window.
example1_zh: 猫睡在有阳光的窗台上。
example2_en: A school rule about the office cat should say who feeds it on holiday.
example2_zh: 关于办公室那只猫的规定，应当写明假期谁喂它。
collocations: pet cat｜宠物猫
tip_zh: cat 可数。雄猫是 tomcat，小猫是 kitten。

definition_en: a location, or a position
example1_en: This is a good place to wait for the bus.
example1_zh: 这是等公交的好地方。
example2_en: Every child needs a place to study that is safe, even if that place is a shared table.
example2_zh: 每个孩子都需要一个安全的学习地方，哪怕那只是一张共用的桌子。
collocations: take place｜发生 ; in place of｜代替 ; from place to place｜到处
tip_zh: take place 表示发生，没有被动语态。

definition_en: a large hole in the side of a hill or under the ground
example1_en: The map marks a cave near the river.
example1_zh: 地图标出河边有一个洞。
example2_en: A school visit to a cave needs a guide and a light, not only a photograph.
example2_zh: 学校参观洞穴需要向导和灯，而不只是一张照片。
collocations: a cave in｜……里的洞
tip_zh: cave 可数。本条不写危险探险的做法。

meanings_zh: n. 连衣裙；服装 | v. 穿衣
definition_en: a piece of clothing, or clothes in general | to put clothes on
example1_en: She wore a blue dress to the concert.
example1_zh: 她穿着蓝裙子去听音乐会。
example2_en: A dress code that costs too much keeps some students out of the photo.
example2_zh: 花费过高的着装要求，会让一些学生进不了合影。
collocations: dress up｜装扮 ; evening dress｜晚礼服
tip_zh: dress 作动词是穿衣。给某人穿上用 dress sb。

definition_en: to travel through a place to learn about it, or to examine an idea
example1_en: Explore the map before the trip.
example1_zh: 出行前先研究地图。
example2_en: Students explore a question better when the source is named.
example2_zh: 写明来源时，学生能更好地探究一个问题。
collocations: explore a place｜探索一个地方
tip_zh: explore 不用于“探索危险操作”。

definition_en: a small animal, or a device that moves a pointer
example1_en: The mouse is beside the keyboard.
example1_zh: 鼠标在键盘旁边。
example2_en: A mouse in the lab cupboard is a reason to close the food, not a joke.
example2_zh: 实验室柜子里的老鼠是把食物收起来的理由，不是笑话。
collocations: a computer mouse｜鼠标
tip_zh: 复数是 mice。动物和鼠标是同一个词。

definition_en: a show, or a plan of events; British spelling
example1_en: The programme starts at seven.
example1_zh: 节目七点开始。
example2_en: A reading programme fails if the books never reach the classroom.
example2_zh: 如果书从来到不了教室，阅读计划就会失败。
collocations: a programme of｜一系列 ; TV programme｜电视节目
tip_zh: programme 是英式，常指节目或计划。计算机程序英美都常用 program，已在本库。两条都保留。

definition_en: a road vehicle with an engine
example1_en: My uncle drives a small car to work.
example1_zh: 我叔叔开一辆小汽车上班。
example2_en: Fewer car trips to school would clear the air on the narrow street outside the gate.
example2_zh: 减少开车上学的次数，能改善校门外窄街上的空气。
collocations: by car｜乘汽车 ; car park｜停车场
tip_zh: by car 不加冠词。

definition_en: the first meal of the day
example1_en: Breakfast is at seven in the hall.
example1_zh: 早饭七点在食堂。
example2_en: A student who skips breakfast often loses the first lesson, not only the meal.
example2_zh: 不吃早饭的学生常常丢掉的是第一节课，而不只是那一餐。
collocations: have breakfast｜吃早饭 ; at breakfast｜早餐时
tip_zh: breakfast 前通常不用 a。have breakfast 不加 the。

definition_en: help
example1_en: The office offers assistance with the form.
example1_zh: 办公室帮助填写表格。
example2_en: Financial assistance for the trip should be quiet, so no student is named in public.
example2_zh: 出行的经济帮助应当安静地进行，这样就不会在公开场合点学生的名。
collocations: come to one's assistance｜来帮助某人 ; assistance with｜在……方面的帮助
tip_zh: assistance 通常不可数。assistant 已在本库。

definition_en: stories that are imagined, not fact
example1_en: The library keeps fiction on the left.
example1_zh: 图书馆把小说放在左边。
example2_en: Fiction about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
example2_zh: 关于洪水的小说可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。
collocations: science fiction｜科幻小说
tip_zh: fiction 通常不可数。a work of fiction 是一部虚构作品。

definition_en: to write or say the letters of a word
example1_en: Spell your name on the form.
example1_zh: 在表格上拼写你的名字。
example2_en: Students who can spell the stop can also find it on the map.
example2_zh: 能拼出站名的学生，也能在地图上找到它。
collocations: spell out｜逐字母拼出；讲清楚
tip_zh: spell 的过去式是 spelt 或 spelled。表里这一行的音标是 speed，本库不用。

definition_en: a flat piece of wood, or a group that directs an organisation
example1_en: The teacher wrote the date on the board.
example1_zh: 老师把日期写在黑板上。
example2_en: A school board that never visits classrooms may not see why a class of forty is hard to teach.
example2_zh: 从不进教室的校董会，可能看不到四十人的班为什么难教。
collocations: on board｜在船/车上 ; notice board｜布告栏
tip_zh: board 作动词是“上船、上车”。

definition_en: a person who makes sure a game follows the rules
example1_en: The referee stopped the match for a minute.
example1_zh: 裁判让比赛停了一分钟。
example2_en: Players may not argue with the referee, even when they think the call was wrong.
example2_zh: 即使觉得判罚不对，队员也不能和裁判争辩。
collocations: the referee's decision｜裁判的决定 ; assistant referee｜助理裁判
tip_zh: 球场上的裁判是 referee。推荐信的证明人也可以是 referee，那是另一义。

definition_en: to stop and hold, to be in time, or to get an illness
example1_en: Catch the ball with both hands.
example1_zh: 用双手接球。
example2_en: Students who catch the early bus avoid the crowd that builds up outside the gate.
example2_zh: 赶上早班车的学生，可以避开校门口越聚越多的人。
collocations: catch a cold｜感冒 ; catch up with｜赶上
tip_zh: catch 的过去式和过去分词是 caught。catch up with 表示追上。

definition_en: a person who speaks, or a device for sound
example1_en: The speaker asked for questions.
example1_zh: 演讲者请大家提问。
example2_en: A speaker at the back of the hall helps the student who cannot move forward.
example2_zh: 大厅后面的扬声器能帮助不能往前走的学生。
collocations: a native speaker｜母语使用者 ; guest speaker｜嘉宾
tip_zh: 动词 speak 已在本库。speaker 也可指说某种语言的人。

definition_en: a plan of action by a government or organisation
example1_en: The new policy limits cars near the school.
example1_zh: 新政策限制学校附近的汽车。
example2_en: A housing policy that ignores bus routes pushes workers farther from their jobs.
example2_zh: 忽视公交线路的住房政策，会把工人推得离工作更远。
collocations: foreign policy｜外交政策
tip_zh: policy 是可数名词：a policy。politics 是“政治”。

definition_en: a position in an organization or a list
example1_en: She rose to the rank of monitor.
example1_zh: 她升到了班长这个职位。
example2_en: Rank in a class should not decide who may use the library.
example2_zh: 班里的名次不应当决定谁可以用图书馆。
collocations: the rank of｜……的职衔
tip_zh: rank 作动词是排列或位列。

definition_en: to be unable to breathe because the throat is blocked
example1_en: Chew the grape so you do not choke.
example1_zh: 葡萄要嚼碎，免得噎住。
example2_en: He choked on a sweet, coughed it up, and then sat quietly until his breath was steady.
example2_zh: 他被一颗糖噎住，咳了出来，然后安静坐着，直到呼吸平稳。
collocations: choke on｜被……噎住 ; choke back tears｜忍住眼泪
tip_zh: choke on sth 是被某物噎住。choke back 是忍住（眼泪、怒气）。噎住了要呼救，本卡不写伤人的做法。

meanings_zh: v. 爱；喜爱 | n. 爱
definition_en: to feel deep affection, or to like very much | a strong feeling of affection
example1_en: I love the smell of the library in the morning.
example1_zh: 我喜欢早晨图书馆的气味。
example2_en: People who love a place are often the first to notice when its river or dialect is disappearing.
example2_zh: 热爱一个地方的人，往往最先注意到它的河流或方言正在消失。
collocations: love doing｜喜欢做 ; fall in love｜爱上
tip_zh: love 后可接 doing 或 to do，口语里 doing 更常见。

definition_en: a place, or a small mark
example1_en: This spot by the window is good for reading.
example1_zh: 窗边这个位置适合读书。
example2_en: A quiet spot in a noisy city can matter as much as a large park that is hard to reach.
example2_zh: 喧闹城市里一个安静的角落，可能和一座难以到达的大公园一样重要。
collocations: on the spot｜当场 ; a spot of｜少量
tip_zh: spot 作动词是“发现”或“弄上污点”。

definition_en: a daughter of one's brother or sister
example1_en: His niece reads the menu for him.
example1_zh: 他的侄女给他读菜单。
example2_en: My niece arrives on Saturday and will sleep in the room beside the stairs.
example2_zh: 我的外甥女星期六到，睡在楼梯旁边的房间。
collocations: one's niece｜某人的侄女或外甥女 ; a niece of mine｜我的一个侄女
word_family: nephew (n. 侄子；外甥) ; aunt (n. 姑；姨；婶) ; uncle (n. 叔；舅；伯)
tip_zh: 侄女和外甥女都是 niece。对应的男孩是 nephew。

definition_en: used to say what is right or expected
example1_en: You ought to lock the lab.
example1_zh: 你应该锁上实验室。
example2_en: A city ought to write the bus time before it asks families to trust the plan.
example2_zh: 城市在要求家庭信任计划之前，应该先写下公交时间。
collocations: ought to do｜应该做
tip_zh: ought 后接 to。否定是 ought not to。没有过去式变化。

meanings_zh: n. 改革 | v. 改革
definition_en: a change meant to improve a system | to improve a system by changing it
example1_en: The reform of the bus route is on the notice.
example1_zh: 公交线路的改革写在通知上。
example2_en: A reform that ignores the last bus will look modern and still fail.
example2_zh: 不考虑末班车的改革看起来现代，仍然会失败。
collocations: reform of｜对……的改革
tip_zh: reform 作动词是改革。

meanings_zh: v. 展示；表明 | n. 演出；展览
definition_en: to let someone see, or to prove | a public performance or display
example1_en: Show me your ticket, please.
example1_zh: 请出示你的票。
example2_en: The data show that night markets bring noise as well as income to the streets around them.
example2_zh: 数据表明，夜市给周围街道带来收入的同时，也带来噪音。
collocations: show up｜出现 ; show sb around｜带某人参观 ; on show｜在展出
tip_zh: show sb sth 双宾语；过去分词是 shown。

meanings_zh: prep. 在……上方；超过 | adv. 在上面
definition_en: higher than, or more than | in a higher place
example1_en: The clock is above the door.
example1_zh: 钟在门的上方。
example2_en: Temperatures above forty degrees make outdoor sports unsafe for younger students.
example2_zh: 超过四十度的气温会让低龄学生的户外运动不安全。
collocations: above all｜尤其 ; above sea level｜海拔
tip_zh: above 强调位置更高，不一定垂直；over 常有“正上方”或“越过”的意思。

definition_en: ready to face danger or difficulty
example1_en: She was brave enough to report the broken step.
example1_zh: 她有勇气报告那级坏台阶。
example2_en: A brave reply still needs a fact, not only a loud voice.
example2_zh: 勇敢的回答仍然需要事实，而不只是大嗓门。
collocations: brave enough to｜勇敢得足以
tip_zh: brave 也可作动词“勇敢面对”。

definition_en: a doctor's written order for medicine
example1_en: You need a prescription for that medicine.
example1_zh: 那种药需要处方。
example2_en: The clinic wrote a prescription for the cough and told her to rest for two days.
example2_zh: 诊所开了治咳嗽的药方，并让她休息两天。
collocations: a prescription for｜……的处方 ; on prescription｜凭处方
tip_zh: prescription 是医生开的药方。动词 prescribe。

definition_en: the fact of owning something
example1_en: Ownership of the lab books is the school.
example1_zh: 这些实验书的所有权属于学校。
example2_en: Clear ownership of a lost bag helps it return.
example2_zh: 遗失包的所有权写清楚，它才容易回到主人手里。
collocations: ownership of｜对……的所有权
tip_zh: owner 已在本库。ownership 通常不可数。

definition_en: a public performance of music
example1_en: The concert is in the hall on Friday.
example1_zh: 音乐会周五在礼堂。
example2_en: A free concert still needs a seat for the parent who comes straight from work.
example2_zh: 免费音乐会仍然要给刚下班赶来的家长留一个座位。
collocations: go to a concert｜去听音乐会 ; a concert of｜一场……音乐会
tip_zh: concert 可数。in concert 也可表示一致行动。

meanings_zh: v. 哭；喊 | n. 哭声；呼喊
definition_en: to produce tears, or to shout | a shout or a period of crying
example1_en: The child did not cry; he asked for help.
example1_zh: 孩子没有哭，他求了助。
example2_en: A cry for help in a crowded hall needs a person, not only a camera.
example2_zh: 拥挤大厅里的呼救需要一个人，而不只是一台摄像机。
collocations: cry for｜哭着要；呼吁 ; cry out｜大声喊
tip_zh: cry 作名词是哭声或呼喊。

definition_en: a train car, or a vehicle pulled by a horse
example1_en: We sat in the last carriage.
example1_zh: 我们坐在最后一节车厢。
example2_en: The old carriage in the museum still has leather seats, though the wheels no longer turn.
example2_zh: 博物馆里的旧马车还有皮座，只是轮子已经转不动了。
collocations: a railway carriage｜火车车厢 ; a horse-drawn carriage｜马车
word_family: carry (v. 运送) ; carrier (n. 承运人；运输工具)
tip_zh: 英式火车车厢常用 carriage，美式多用 car。动词是 carry，不是 carriage。

definition_en: to get something by paying money
example1_en: I will buy a notebook after class.
example1_zh: 课后我去买一本笔记本。
example2_en: Families buy less fresh food when the nearest market is an hour away by bus.
example2_zh: 当最近的市场要坐一小时公交时，家庭会少买新鲜食物。
collocations: buy sb sth｜给某人买 ; buy from｜从……购买
tip_zh: buy 的过去式和过去分词是 bought。

definition_en: a flat device for storing computer data
example1_en: The disk in the lab computer is almost full.
example1_zh: 实验室电脑里的磁盘快满了。
example2_en: Copy the photos onto a disk before you delete them from the camera.
example2_zh: 从相机里删除照片之前，先把它们复制到磁盘上。
collocations: a hard disk｜硬盘 ; save to disk｜存到磁盘
tip_zh: 参考表写 disk＝disc，中文是磁盘。光盘也常叫 disk，本卡按表先记磁盘。

definition_en: producing clear pictures in the mind, or very bright
example1_en: She gave a vivid account of the storm.
example1_zh: 她把暴风雨讲得很生动。
example2_en: Vivid red on the map marks the cities, while pale blue marks the lakes.
example2_zh: 地图上鲜艳的红色标城市，淡蓝标湖泊。
collocations: a vivid description｜生动的描写 ; vivid colours｜鲜艳的颜色
tip_zh: vivid 形容描写是「生动」，形容颜色是「鲜艳」。副词 vividly。

definition_en: a small flying insect that bites
example1_en: A mosquito buzzed by my ear.
example1_zh: 一只蚊子在我耳边嗡嗡叫。
example2_en: Close the screen if a mosquito is in the dorm, and do not scratch a bite until you have washed your hands.
example2_zh: 宿舍里有蚊子就把纱窗关上，手洗干净之前不要抓咬过的地方。
collocations: a mosquito bite｜蚊子包 ; mosquito net｜蚊帐
tip_zh: 复数是 mosquitoes。蚊帐是 mosquito net。不要和 mosque（清真寺）弄混。

definition_en: the outside limit of something
example1_en: Stand back from the edge of the platform.
example1_zh: 站在站台边缘后面。
example2_en: Houses on the edge of town are the first to lose the bus when a route is cut.
example2_zh: 城镇边缘的房子，在线路被削减时最先失去公交。
collocations: on the edge of｜在……边缘 ; edge of｜……的边
tip_zh: on edge 表示紧张。at the edge 是在边上。

definition_en: not long, or not tall
example1_en: It is a short walk from here to the gate.
example1_zh: 从这里到门口走路不远。
example2_en: Short breaks between lessons help attention more than one long break at the end of the day.
example2_zh: 课间的短休息比一天结束时一次长休息更有助于注意力。
collocations: in short｜简言之 ; be short of｜缺少 ; short of｜缺乏
tip_zh: short 可指时间、长度或身材。shortly 是“不久”，不是“短地”。

definition_en: words or a gesture used when people meet
example1_en: A warm greeting opened the meeting.
example1_zh: 一声亲切的问候开始了这次会面。
example2_en: Learn a simple greeting before the exchange visit, and use the guest's language for the first hello.
example2_zh: 交流访问前先学一句简单问候，第一声招呼用客人的语言。
collocations: a friendly greeting｜友好的问候 ; exchange greetings｜互相问好
word_family: greet (v. 问候) ; greetings (n. 问候语)
tip_zh: greeting 是问候。问候卡片上常写 greetings。动词是 greet sb。

meanings_zh: n. 句子 | v. 判决
definition_en: a group of words that expresses a complete idea | to state a punishment in court
example1_en: Write one sentence to explain the chart.
example1_zh: 写一句话解释这张图。
example2_en: A long sentence that hides the number is less honest than a short one.
example2_zh: 把数字藏起来的长句，不如短句诚实。
collocations: sentence structure｜句子结构
tip_zh: sentence 也可指判决。本条以语法义为主，法律义在第二个义项。

definition_en: by way of
example1_en: We came via the old bridge.
example1_zh: 我们经由旧桥过来。
example2_en: News via a phone app is fast, but a named source is still necessary.
example2_zh: 通过手机应用传来的新闻很快，但署名的来源仍然必要。
collocations: via the Internet｜通过互联网
tip_zh: via 是介词，后接名词，多用于书面。

definition_en: to have clothes or glasses on the body
example1_en: Wear glasses in the lab.
example1_zh: 在实验室里戴眼镜。
example2_en: Students wear the same uniform, but their journeys to school are not the same length.
example2_zh: 学生穿同样的校服，但他们上学的路程并不一样长。
collocations: wear out｜穿破 ; wear glasses｜戴眼镜
tip_zh: wear 表示穿着的状态；put on 表示穿上的动作。过去式是 wore。

meanings_zh: adj. 腐败的 | v. 使腐化
definition_en: dishonest, especially about public money | to make someone dishonest
example1_en: The report calls the contract corrupt.
example1_zh: 报告称这份合同是腐败的。
example2_en: A corrupt practice is harder to hide when the number is public.
example2_zh: 数字公开时，腐败的做法更难藏。
collocations: corrupt official｜贪官
tip_zh: corrupt 作动词是使腐化。本条是阅读词汇，不写做法。

definition_en: money, or the management of money
example1_en: The club has no finance for a second trip.
example1_zh: 社团没有再出行一次的经费。
example2_en: School finance should be public enough for parents to see where the lunch money goes.
example2_zh: 学校财务应当公开到家长能看见午餐钱去了哪里。
collocations: finance a project｜为项目出资
tip_zh: finance 作动词是提供资金。形容词是 financial。

definition_en: gradual change over time
example1_en: The chapter explains evolution in simple words.
example1_zh: 这一章用简单的话解释进化。
example2_en: The evolution of the bus route is written on one sheet.
example2_zh: 公交线路的演变写在一张纸上。
collocations: the evolution of｜……的演变
tip_zh: evolution 通常不可数。

definition_en: a bar, or the railway
example1_en: Hold the rail on the stairs.
example1_zh: 在楼梯上抓住栏杆。
example2_en: Travel by rail fails if the station has no late train.
example2_zh: 如果车站没有晚班火车，乘铁路出行就会失败。
collocations: by rail｜乘火车 ; rail station｜火车站
tip_zh: railway 已在本库。by rail 不加冠词。

meanings_zh: v. 说；评论 | n. 言论
definition_en: to say what you notice | a short comment
example1_en: She remarked that the gate was shut.
example1_zh: 她说大门是关着的。
example2_en: One careless remark about the opening line upset him, so the chair asked everyone to keep criticism kind.
example2_zh: 一句对开头那行不经意的话让他难过了，主持人便请大家批评时客气些。
collocations: remark on｜评论 ; a rude remark｜无礼的话
tip_zh: remark that 从句是「说」。名词 make a remark。remarkable 是「出色的」，不是「被评论的」。

definition_en: school work done at home
example1_en: The homework is on page two.
example1_zh: 家庭作业在第二页。
example2_en: Homework that needs a quiet room is harder for the student who shares one.
example2_zh: 需要安静房间的作业，对合住一间的学生更难。
collocations: do homework｜做作业
tip_zh: homework 不可数。

meanings_zh: n. 报告；报道 | v. 报告；报道
definition_en: a spoken or written account | to give an account of
example1_en: Please hand in the lab report tomorrow.
example1_zh: 请明天交实验报告。
example2_en: A news report should show what is certain and what is still only a claim.
example2_zh: 新闻报道应该标明哪些是确定的，哪些仍只是说法。
collocations: weather report｜天气预报 ; report on｜关于……的报告
tip_zh: report 作动词是“报告”或“举报”：report sth to sb。

meanings_zh: n. 人行横道；十字路口
definition_en: a place where people cross a road
example1_en: The crossing needs a light.
example1_zh: 这个人行横道需要一盏灯。
example2_en: A crossing without a light pushes students into the road.
example2_zh: 没有灯的人行横道把学生挤到路上。
collocations: a pedestrian crossing｜人行横道
tip_zh: 动词 cross 已在本库。crossing 是名词。

meanings_zh: v. 覆盖；包括；报道 | n. 封面；盖子
definition_en: to put over, include, or report | the outside of a book, or a lid
example1_en: The map covers the whole town.
example1_zh: 这张地图覆盖整个城镇。
example2_en: News that covers only the city centre misses the villages where the flood starts.
example2_zh: 只报道市中心的新闻，会漏掉洪水开始的那些村子。
collocations: cover with｜用……覆盖 ; be covered with｜被……覆盖
tip_zh: cover 作名词是“封面”或“覆盖物”。

definition_en: a game played with a bat and a ball
example1_en: Baseball practice is after school.
example1_zh: 棒球训练在放学后。
example2_en: A baseball field that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
example2_zh: 黄昏就锁上的棒球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。
collocations: play baseball｜打棒球
tip_zh: 球类前通常不加 the：play baseball。

definition_en: bravery
example1_en: It takes courage to speak in public.
example1_zh: 公开演讲需要勇气。
example2_en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
example2_zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。
collocations: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事 ; show courage｜表现出勇气 ; take courage｜鼓起勇气
tip_zh: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

meanings_zh: v. 处理 | n. 把手
definition_en: to deal with a situation | the part you hold
example1_en: She can handle the tickets for the trip.
example1_zh: 她能处理这次出行的票。
example2_en: Teachers handle a sudden illness better when the clinic number is on the wall.
example2_zh: 当医务室电话写在墙上时，老师能更好地处理突发疾病。
collocations: handle a problem｜处理问题
tip_zh: handle 作名词是“把手”。作动词是处理或用手操作。

definition_en: a compound with two atoms of oxygen joined to another element
example1_en: Carbon dioxide turns the limewater cloudy.
example1_zh: 二氧化碳使石灰水变浑。
example2_en: Plants take in carbon dioxide and release oxygen, which the textbook shows with two arrows.
example2_zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳并放出氧气，课本用两个箭头表示。
collocations: carbon dioxide｜二氧化碳 ; sulphur dioxide｜二氧化硫
word_family: oxide (n. 氧化物) ; carbon (n. 碳) ; oxygen (n. 氧)
tip_zh: 高考里最常见的是 carbon dioxide，化学式 CO₂。这是课堂气体，实验只看老师做。

definition_en: quick at learning or thinking
example1_en: That was a clever way to label the map.
example1_zh: 那样给地图贴标签很巧妙。
example2_en: A clever answer that hides the source is still a weak answer.
example2_zh: 藏起来源的聪明答案，仍然是站不住的答案。
collocations: clever at｜擅长
tip_zh: clever 可以形容方法。不要只用它给同学排队。

definition_en: in all places
example1_en: There were books everywhere after the fair.
example1_zh: 书展之后到处都是书。
example2_en: Signs that appear everywhere and say nothing clear do not help a new student.
example2_zh: 到处都是却什么也没说清的牌子，帮不了新生。
collocations: everywhere else｜其他所有地方
tip_zh: everywhere 是副词，前面不加 in。

definition_en: an official document for travel abroad
example1_en: She checked her passport before the exchange trip.
example1_zh: 交流出行前她核对了护照。
example2_en: The passport was still in the hotel safe when the bus was already at the door.
example2_zh: 公共汽车已经到门口了，护照还在旅馆的保险箱里。
collocations: a passport｜一本护照 ; passport control｜护照检查
tip_zh: passport 是出国证件。国内常用的身份证不是 passport。

meanings_zh: n. 交换；交流 | v. 交换
definition_en: the act of giving one thing and receiving another | to give something and receive something else
example1_en: The language exchange meets on Thursday.
example1_zh: 语言交流活动周四举行。
example2_en: A fair exchange of ideas needs time for the quieter student to answer.
example2_zh: 公平的思想交流需要时间，让较安静的学生也能回答。
collocations: in exchange for｜作为对……的交换 ; exchange student｜交换生
tip_zh: exchange 作动词时，说 exchange A for B。

definition_en: money in coins or notes
example1_en: I paid in cash.
example1_zh: 我用现金付了款。
example2_en: A market that only takes cash still serves people who have no bank card.
example2_zh: 只收现金的市场，仍然服务没有银行卡的人。
collocations: in cash｜用现金 ; cash desk｜收银台
tip_zh: cash 不可数。

definition_en: the work a group does together
example1_en: Teamwork saved the relay.
example1_zh: 团队合作挽救了接力。
example2_en: Good teamwork means listening as well as scoring, which the coach repeated before every game.
example2_zh: 好的团队合作既要得分也要倾听，教练每场比赛前都重复这句话。
collocations: teamwork skills｜合作技能 ; good teamwork｜良好的团队合作
tip_zh: team 已在库里。teamwork 不可数，不说 a teamwork。队友是 teammate 或 team-mate。

meanings_zh: n. 恩惠；帮助 | v. 赞成；偏爱
definition_en: a kind act; American spelling of favour | to support or prefer
example1_en: Could you do me a favor and hold the door?
example1_zh: 请帮个忙，扶一下门好吗？
example2_en: A favor that must be repaid in public is not a favor.
example2_zh: 必须当众偿还的忙，就不是帮忙。
collocations: do sb a favor｜帮某人一个忙 ; in favor of｜赞成；有利于
tip_zh: favor 是美式，favour 是英式。它不是 favourite。favourite 是“最喜爱的”，美式 favorite 已在本库。

definition_en: a gas that people need to live
example1_en: The textbook names oxygen as a gas.
example1_zh: 课本把氧气作为一种气体来讲。
example2_en: A lesson on oxygen should stay with the word and the warning, not a method.
example2_zh: 氧气课应当停在这个词和警告上，而不是做法。
collocations: oxygen of｜……的氧
tip_zh: oxygen 通常不可数。本条是科普词汇，不写实验步骤。

definition_en: a wild animal like a large dog
example1_en: The story has a wolf, not a pet.
example1_zh: 故事里有一只狼，不是宠物。
example2_en: A lesson about the wolf should say where it can live, not how to harm it.
example2_zh: 关于狼的课应当说它能住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。
collocations: a wolf in｜一只狼
tip_zh: 复数是 wolves。

definition_en: without a plan or pattern
example1_en: The names were chosen at random.
example1_zh: 名字是随机抽的。
example2_en: A random check of the lab list finds the bottle that nobody labelled.
example2_zh: 随机检查实验室清单，能发现没人贴标签的那瓶。
collocations: at random｜随机地
tip_zh: at random 表示任意地、随机地。

meanings_zh: v. 参观；拜访 | n. 参观；拜访
definition_en: to go to see a person or place | an act of visiting
example1_en: We will visit the museum on Friday.
example1_zh: 我们周五去参观博物馆。
example2_en: Leaders who visit a flooded street themselves ask better questions than those who only read a report.
example2_zh: 亲自走访积水街道的负责人，比只读报告的人问出更好的问题。
collocations: pay a visit｜拜访 ; visit to｜对……的访问
tip_zh: visit 可作动词或名词：a visit to。

meanings_zh: n. 报酬；奖赏 | v. 奖赏
definition_en: something given for good work | to give something for good work
example1_en: The reward is a book, not a speech.
example1_zh: 奖赏是一本书，不是一篇讲话。
example2_en: A reward that only the confident students can reach is not yet fair.
example2_zh: 只有自信的学生够得着的奖赏还不算公平。
collocations: a reward for｜对……的奖赏
tip_zh: reward 作动词是奖赏。

meanings_zh: n. 全体船员；一组工作人员
definition_en: a group of people working together on a ship, plane, or task
example1_en: The crew checked the doors before the trip.
example1_zh: 出发前工作人员检查了门。
example2_en: A film crew in the playground should not block the way to the clinic.
example2_zh: 操场上的摄制组不应当堵住去医务室的路。
collocations: a crew of｜一组
tip_zh: crew 是集体名词。谓语可用单数或复数。

meanings_zh: v. 防守；辩护 | v. 辩护；捍卫 | v. 防守
definition_en: to protect from attack | to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised | to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport
example1_en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
example1_zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。
example2_en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
example2_zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。
collocations: defend against attack｜抵御攻击 ; defend human rights｜捍卫人权 ; defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护 ; defend a title｜卫冕
tip_zh: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

definition_en: the part of the body where the arm joins
example1_en: She carried the bag on one shoulder.
example1_zh: 她把包扛在一个肩上。
example2_en: Pain in the shoulder after a long exam is a reason to stand up.
example2_zh: 长时间考试后肩膀疼，是站起来的理由。
collocations: shoulder to shoulder｜肩并肩
tip_zh: 路肩也叫 shoulder。

definition_en: to rule a country or control how something works
example1_en: Clear rules govern the election.
example1_zh: 明确的规则约束这次选举。
example2_en: Councils govern local schools together with the city, and parents can read the minutes online.
example2_zh: 地方议会和城市一起管理学校，家长可以在网上读会议记录。
collocations: govern a country｜治理国家 ; govern behaviour｜约束行为
word_family: government (n. 政府) ; governor (n. 州长；主管) ; governance (n. 治理)
tip_zh: government 已在库里，是名词。govern 是动词。领导人是 governor，不是 governer。

meanings_zh: n. 观众；听众 | n. 读者群；受众
definition_en: people watching or listening | People who read or receive particular content
example1_en: The audience clapped after the show.
example1_zh: 演出结束后观众鼓掌。
example2_en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
example2_zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。
collocations: a large audience｜众多观众 ; a target audience｜目标受众 ; reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众 ; audience participation｜观众参与
tip_zh: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

definition_en: every person
example1_en: Everyone in our class has a reading partner.
example1_zh: 我们班每个人都有阅读伙伴。
example2_en: A park that looks open to everyone may still be hard to reach for people who use wheelchairs.
example2_zh: 一座看起来对所有人开放的公园，对使用轮椅的人仍可能很难到达。
collocations: everyone else｜其他所有人
tip_zh: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数。

definition_en: not correct
example1_en: I put the wrong date on the form.
example1_zh: 我在表格上写错了日期。
example2_en: It is wrong to judge a school only by one test if many students arrive already behind.
example2_zh: 如果许多学生入学时已经落后，只用一次考试评价学校是不对的。
collocations: go wrong｜出毛病 ; be wrong with｜……有毛病
tip_zh: wrong 作副词较少；做错事常用 do wrong 或副词 wrongly。

definition_en: a sudden dangerous situation
example1_en: The number for an emergency is on the wall.
example1_zh: 紧急电话写在墙上。
example2_en: An emergency plan that nobody has practised is only a piece of paper.
example2_zh: 没人演练过的应急方案只是一张纸。
collocations: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下 ; emergency exit｜紧急出口
tip_zh: emergency 可数。in case of emergency 是常见告示。

definition_en: to pull something along the ground
example1_en: Drag the chair; do not lift it alone.
example1_zh: 把椅子拖过去，不要一个人抬。
example2_en: Do not drag a bag across the wet lab floor.
example2_zh: 不要在湿的实验室地板上拖包。
collocations: drag sth away｜把某物拖走
tip_zh: drag 是普通动词。本条用搬东西的意思。

definition_en: the physical world, or a person's character
example1_en: We walked in nature after the rain.
example1_zh: 雨后我们在大自然里走了走。
example2_en: Protecting nature along a river also protects the drinking water of the next town.
example2_zh: 保护河边的自然，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。
collocations: by nature｜本性上 ; in nature｜在自然界
tip_zh: nature 通常不可数。

definition_en: the finish of a course, or the ceremony
example1_en: Graduation is in the stadium this June.
example1_zh: 今年六月毕业典礼在体育场举行。
example2_en: After graduation she wants a year of work before she applies to university.
example2_zh: 毕业后她想先工作一年，再申请大学。
collocations: graduation ceremony｜毕业典礼 ; after graduation｜毕业之后
tip_zh: graduation 是毕业这件事或典礼。人用 graduate。

definition_en: a tree with wide leaves that turn red in autumn
example1_en: Red leaves from the maple covered the bench.
example1_zh: 枫树的红叶盖住了长椅。
example2_en: Maple leaves turn red in October, and the art class collects them for prints.
example2_zh: 枫叶在十月变红，美术课收集它们来做拓印。
collocations: maple leaf｜枫叶 ; maple tree｜枫树
tip_zh: 枫树是 maple。枫叶是 maple leaf。糖浆是 maple syrup。

definition_en: something difficult that needs to be dealt with
example1_en: The main problem is the noise from the road.
example1_zh: 主要问题是路上的噪音。
example2_en: A traffic problem will not disappear if a city only widens the same road again.
example2_zh: 如果一座城市只是再次拓宽同一条路，交通问题不会消失。
collocations: no problem｜没问题 ; solve a problem｜解决问题
tip_zh: problem 是可数名词。question 是提出的问题；problem 是需要解决的困难。

definition_en: wanting very much to do something
example1_en: The new students were eager to see the labs.
example1_zh: 新生渴望看看实验室。
example2_en: She was so eager to answer that she stood up before the teacher finished the question.
example2_zh: 她急着回答，老师的问题还没说完就站了起来。
collocations: eager to do｜渴望做 ; eager for｜渴望得到
tip_zh: eager to do sth。eager for 后面接名词。

definition_en: a formal word for one piece of clothing
example1_en: This garment needs a cooler wash.
example1_zh: 这件衣服需要用更凉的水洗。
example2_en: Each garment in the play has a label, so the crew can return it to the right rail after the show.
example2_zh: 戏里的每件服装都有标签，演完后工作人员能把它放回正确的衣架。
collocations: a winter garment｜冬衣 ; outer garment｜外衣
tip_zh: garment 比 clothes 正式，而且可以指一件。日常口语仍说 clothes。

definition_en: the brother of a parent, or the husband of a parent's sister
example1_en: Her uncle will meet the bus.
example1_zh: 她的叔叔会去接公交。
example2_en: A form that says uncle should also leave space for another adult.
example2_zh: 写着叔叔的表格，也应当给另一位成年人留出位置。
collocations: uncle and aunt｜叔婶
tip_zh: uncle 可数。具体是叔、伯、舅还是姑父，要看家庭。

meanings_zh: v. 答复 | n. 答复
definition_en: to answer | an answer
example1_en: Please reply to the e-mail today.
example1_zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。
example2_en: A reply that arrives after the bus has left is too late.
example2_zh: 公交已经开走之后才到的答复太晚了。
collocations: reply to｜回复 ; in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip_zh: reply to something。名词也是 reply。

definition_en: a thick liquid used for fuel or cooking
example1_en: The bus uses less oil after the new route.
example1_zh: 新线路之后这辆公交更省油。
example2_en: Dependence on oil makes a town's bus fares rise whenever the world price jumps.
example2_zh: 对石油的依赖会让城镇的公交票价在世界油价跳跃时上涨。
collocations: oil price｜油价
tip_zh: oil 通常不可数。

definition_en: not to succeed, or not to pass a test
example1_en: She did not fail the test.
example1_zh: 她测验没有不及格。
example2_en: A plan can fail and still teach the class what to change next time.
example2_zh: 一个计划可以失败，同时仍然教会班级下次改什么。
collocations: fail to do｜未能做 ; fail an exam｜考试不及格
tip_zh: fail 后可接考试：fail the exam。未能做某事用 fail to do。名词 failure 已在本库。

definition_en: a digital versatile disc
example1_en: The DVD of the concert is in the library.
example1_zh: 音乐会的影碟在图书馆。
example2_en: A DVD still helps when the network cannot play the film.
example2_zh: 网络放不了这部影片时，影碟仍然有用。
collocations: a DVD of｜一张……影碟
tip_zh: DVD 是 digital versatile disc 的缩写。书写常用大写。

definition_en: a short part of a text, or a way through
example1_en: Read the passage, then name the source.
example1_zh: 读这段文字，然后写出来源。
example2_en: A passage to the clinic should not be blocked by furniture.
example2_zh: 去医务室的通道不应当被家具挡住。
collocations: a passage from｜选自……的一段
tip_zh: 阅读理解里的 passage 是文章节选。

definition_en: to teach someone, especially over a long time
example1_en: Schools educate children, families do too.
example1_zh: 学校教育孩子，家庭也一样。
example2_en: The talk tried to educate drivers about the new crossing, not to frighten them.
example2_zh: 这次谈话想让司机了解新的路口，而不是吓唬他们。
collocations: educate sb about｜使某人了解 ; well educated｜受过良好教育的
tip_zh: educate 比 teach 更强调长期培养。名词 education。

meanings_zh: n. 钥匙；关键 | adj. 关键的
definition_en: a metal piece for a lock, or the most important thing | most important
example1_en: I left my key in the classroom.
example1_zh: 我把钥匙落在教室了。
example2_en: The key to a later school start is a bus timetable that changes with it.
example2_zh: 推迟上学时间的关键，是一份随之改变的公交时刻表。
collocations: the key to｜……的关键 ; key word｜关键词
tip_zh: the key to 后接名词或 doing，介词是 to。

definition_en: to say words, or to talk a language
example1_en: She can speak English and Chinese.
example1_zh: 她会说英语和中文。
example2_en: Leaders who speak only to cameras miss the questions people ask at the bus stop.
example2_zh: 只对镜头说话的负责人，听不到人们在车站提出的问题。
collocations: speak to｜对……说 ; speak English｜说英语
