example2_en: Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.
example2_zh: 对于户外锻炼机会有限的城市居民来说，能够使用绿地尤其有益。
collocations: beneficial effect｜有益影响 ; beneficial to health｜有益健康 ; mutually beneficial｜互利的
tip_zh: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

definition_en: a short trip made for pleasure or study
example1_en: The outing ends before supper.
example1_zh: 这次郊游在晚饭前结束。
example2_en: Rain moved the outing from the lake to the museum, and the same worksheet still applied.
example2_zh: 雨把郊游从湖边改到了博物馆，原来的练习纸仍然适用。
collocations: a school outing｜学校郊游 ; a family outing｜家庭出游
tip_zh: outing 是短途外出，常带娱乐或参观。不要和 outgoing（外向的；即将卸任的）弄混，那是本批另一条。

definition_en: enough, or more than enough
example1_en: There is ample time to check the sum.
example1_zh: 有足够的时间核对总数。
example2_en: Ample seats remained after the first class sat down, so the visitors did not stand.
example2_zh: 第一个班坐下以后座位还很宽裕，来宾不用站着。
collocations: ample evidence｜充分的证据 ; ample space｜足够的空间
tip_zh: ample 比 enough 更强调充裕。abundant 本库另有一条，常形容自然供给。

definition_en: a tree with needles that stay green
example1_en: A pine stands behind the science building.
example1_zh: 科学楼后面有一棵松树。
example2_en: Needles from the pine covered the path, and they stuck to our wet shoes.
example2_zh: 松针铺满了小路，还粘在我们湿鞋子上。
collocations: pine tree｜松树 ; pine needles｜松针
tip_zh: 参考表这一行是名词「松树」。动词 pine for 表示苦苦思念，不是本卡的义项。

meanings_zh: n. 边界；界限 | n. 界限；限度
definition_en: a line that marks a limit | A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something
example1_en: Respect personal boundary at work.
example1_zh: 在工作中尊重个人界限。
example2_en: Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.
example2_zh: 明确工作与个人生活的界限，可以保护员工的心理健康并减轻长期压力。
collocations: a national boundary｜国界 ; set boundaries｜设定界限 ; cross a boundary｜越过边界 ; push the boundaries｜突破界限
tip_zh: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

definition_en: a measurement of length, width, or height, or an aspect
example1_en: Length is only one dimension of the box.
example1_zh: 长度只是这个盒子的一个尺寸。
example2_en: The drawing needs a third dimension, depth, or the cupboard will not fit against the wall.
example2_zh: 这张图需要第三个维度，也就是深度，否则柜子靠不上墙。
collocations: in three dimensions｜三维地 ; the dimensions of｜……的尺寸
tip_zh: 参考表写量度、尺寸、面积、程度、范围。画图和说方面都可以用 dimension。

definition_en: a person who turns written words into another language
example1_en: Our translator kept every joke.
example1_zh: 我们的译者把每个笑话都保留了。
example2_en: A translator works from a written page and can pause to check a name before the magazine is printed.
example2_zh: 译者依据书面文字工作，杂志付印前可以停下来核对一个名字。
collocations: a literary translator｜文学译者 ; translator's note｜译者注
word_family: translate (v. 翻译) ; translation (n. 翻译；译文)
tip_zh: translator 译书面文字。现场口译是 interpreter，本批另有一条。动词是 translate。

definition_en: to send people away, or to refuse to consider an idea
example1_en: The coach did not dismiss the error.
example1_zh: 教练没有把这个失误放过去。
example2_en: They will not dismiss anyone who missed the bus, but the office must record the late arrival.
example2_zh: 他们不会因为有人误了班车就解雇谁，办公室必须记下迟到。
collocations: dismiss a class｜下课 ; dismiss an idea｜对某想法不予考虑
word_family: dismissal (n. 解雇；解散) ; dismissive (adj. 不屑的)
tip_zh: class is dismissed 是下课。dismiss sb from a job 是解雇。形容词 dismissive 是不屑的。

definition_en: tasting of salt, or containing salt
example1_en: The soup is salty enough already.
example1_zh: 汤已经够咸了。
example2_en: Salty snacks make you thirsty, so the canteen puts water beside them.
example2_zh: 咸的零食会让人渴，食堂就在旁边放了水。
collocations: salty food｜咸食 ; a salty taste｜咸味
tip_zh: salty 是咸。淡而无味是 bland，甜是 sweet。盐本身是 salt。

definition_en: a situation in which you must choose between two difficult options
example1_en: The dilemma is time versus safety.
example1_zh: 这个两难是时间对安全。
example2_en: She faced a dilemma: tell the teacher now, or wait until she had the whole story.
example2_zh: 她面临两难：现在就告诉老师，还是等自己把事情弄完整再讲。
collocations: in a dilemma｜处于两难 ; a moral dilemma｜道德上的两难
tip_zh: dilemma 是两边都难的选择。只是一个难题不一定是 dilemma。复数 dilemmas。

definition_en: meant to be kept secret
example1_en: The report is confidential until Friday.
example1_zh: 这份报告在周五之前是机密的。
example2_en: Please keep the names confidential, and do not read them aloud in a full classroom.
example2_zh: 请把姓名保密，不要在坐满人的教室里念出来。
collocations: confidential information｜机密信息 ; strictly confidential｜绝密
tip_zh: confidential 比 secret 更常用于文件和公务。副词 confidentially。

definition_en: the quality of facing danger or pain without running away
example1_en: Her bravery calmed the younger children.
example1_zh: 她的勇敢让更小的孩子安静了下来。
example2_en: The story praises bravery that protects others, not a risk taken only to impress the crowd.
example2_zh: 这个故事赞扬的是保护别人的勇敢，不是只为了让人群喝彩而冒险。
collocations: an act of bravery｜勇敢的行为 ; show bravery｜表现出勇敢
word_family: brave (adj. 勇敢的) ; bravely (adv. 勇敢地)
tip_zh: bravery 是名词。形容词 brave 已在库里。它不可数，一次行为可以说 an act of bravery。

definition_en: a calm, serious quality that deserves respect
example1_en: Speak to the guest with dignity, even if you are nervous.
example1_zh: 即使紧张，也要有尊严地跟客人说话。
example2_en: The team lost, but they left the court with dignity and shook hands.
example2_zh: 队伍输了，但他们体面地离开球场，并握了手。
collocations: human dignity｜人的尊严 ; with dignity｜有尊严地
tip_zh: dignity 不可数时指尊严。a dignity 不常见。

definition_en: an instrument that makes very small things look larger
example1_en: Adjust the microscope, then sketch the cells.
example1_zh: 先调好显微镜，再把细胞画下来。
example2_en: Under the microscope, the leaf shows small openings, and the worksheet asks students to count a sample of them.
example2_zh: 显微镜下，叶子露出细小的气孔，练习纸让学生数其中的一部分。
collocations: under the microscope｜在显微镜下 ; a light microscope｜光学显微镜
tip_zh: microscope 是仪器。microscopic 是微小的，不一定真的在显微镜下。使用时按老师的操作要求，不要自己拆镜头。

meanings_zh: n. 污渍 | v. 沾污
definition_en: a mark that is hard to wash out | to leave a mark that is hard to remove
example1_en: A tea stain sits on the sleeve.
example1_zh: 袖子上有一块茶渍。
example2_en: Open ink will stain the chart if the pen rolls, so cap it before you close the folder.
example2_zh: 笔要是滚走，敞着的墨水会弄脏图表，合上文件夹前先把笔帽盖好。
collocations: a coffee stain｜咖啡渍 ; stain a shirt｜弄脏衬衫
word_family: stained (adj. 沾污的) ; stainless (adj. 无污渍的；不锈的)
tip_zh: stain 既是污渍，也是动词。stainless steel 是不锈钢，本库已有 stainless。

definition_en: to judge how good or useful something is
example1_en: We evaluate sources before we quote them.
example1_zh: 引用之前我们先评估资料。
example2_en: The teacher will evaluate the projects on Friday and return a short written note.
example2_zh: 老师星期五评估这些项目，并退回一则简短的书面意见。
collocations: evaluate sth｜评估某物 ; evaluate the results｜评估结果
tip_zh: evaluate 和 assess 接近。名词 evaluation。

definition_en: a violent storm with a circular wind
example1_en: The hurricane warning kept the boats in the harbor.
example1_zh: 飓风警报让船只留在港里。
example2_en: After the hurricane, students helped clear branches from the road to school.
example2_zh: 飓风过后，学生们帮忙清开通往学校的路上的树枝。
collocations: a hurricane warning｜飓风警报 ; hurricane season｜飓风季
tip_zh: 参考表写「飓风，十二级风」。英式也常读成带 /eɪ/ 的 hurricane，本卡采用表里的 /ˈhʌrɪkən/。

meanings_zh: v. 试图；尝试 | v. 尝试；试图
definition_en: to try | To try to do something, especially something difficult.
example1_en: She will attempt to climb the mountain.
example1_zh: 她将尝试爬山。
example2_en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
example2_zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。
collocations: make an attempt｜作出尝试 ; attempt to do something｜尝试做某事 ; a successful attempt｜成功的尝试 ; in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip_zh: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

definition_en: stiff, or not willing to bend rules or opinions
example1_en: The board is rigid and will not bend.
example1_zh: 这块板是硬的，弯不了。
example2_en: A rigid timetable helps some students, and it traps others who need a longer lab.
example2_zh: 死板的时间表帮得了部分学生，也会困住需要更长实验时间的人。
collocations: rigid rules｜死板的规定 ; a rigid material｜坚硬的材料
word_family: rigidly (adv. 僵硬地；严格地) ; rigidity (n. 刚性；死板)
tip_zh: rigid 可以是材料硬，也可以是规矩不肯通融。反义 flexible。

meanings_zh: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的 | adj. 渴望的；急切的
definition_en: worried; eager | Very eager to do something or for something to happen.
example1_en: She felt anxious before the test.
example1_zh: 考试前她感到焦虑。
example2_en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
example2_zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。
collocations: anxious about｜对……感到焦虑 ; anxious to please｜急于讨好 ; feel anxious｜感到焦虑
tip_zh: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

definition_en: a light silver metal
example1_en: Aluminium cans go into the blue bin.
example1_zh: 铝罐放进蓝色回收箱。
example2_en: The frame is aluminium, so it is light enough for one person to carry upstairs.
example2_zh: 框架是铝的，轻得一个人就能扛上楼。
collocations: aluminium foil｜铝箔 ; an aluminium can｜铝罐
tip_zh: 英式拼写 aluminium，五个音节。美式 aluminum 少一个 i，不在本库，不另开词头。

definition_en: a hand with the fingers closed tightly
example1_en: He knocked on the door with his fist.
example1_zh: 他用拳头敲门。
example2_en: She opened her fist and showed the key she had been holding through the whole speech.
example2_zh: 她张开拳头，露出演讲全程一直握着的那把钥匙。
collocations: clench one's fist｜握紧拳头 ; shake one's fist｜挥拳
tip_zh: 拳头是 fist。首先是 first。只差一个字母。

definition_en: to pay someone for a loss, or to balance a weakness
example1_en: The shop will compensate her for the broken lamp.
example1_zh: 商店会赔偿她打碎的灯。
example2_en: Extra practice can compensate for a slow start, if you keep the same plan every week.
example2_zh: 要是每周都按同一个计划练，额外练习能弥补起步慢。
collocations: compensate sb for｜因……赔偿某人 ; compensate for｜弥补
word_family: compensation (n. 补偿) ; compensatory (adj. 补偿的)
synonyms: make up for（弥补）, repay（偿还）
tip_zh: compensate sb for a loss 是赔偿。compensate for a weakness 是弥补。名词 compensation。

definition_en: to give time or energy to
example1_en: She will devote more time to study.
example1_zh: 她将把更多时间用于学习。
example2_en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
example2_zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。
collocations: devote time to｜投入时间于 ; devote resources to｜投入资源于 ; devote oneself to｜致力于
tip_zh: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 适应；改编 | v. 改编；改装
definition_en: to change to fit a new situation | to change something for a different use or audience
example1_en: Animals must adapt to climate change.
example1_zh: 动物必须适应气候变化。
example2_en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
example2_zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。
collocations: adapt to change｜适应变化 ; adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法 ; adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip_zh: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

definition_en: a border, or the edge of what is known
example1_en: The town sits on the frontier between two regions.
example1_zh: 小镇坐落在两个地区的边界上。
example2_en: The article calls medical research a new frontier, full of questions we cannot answer yet.
example2_zh: 文章把医学研究称为新的前沿，里面满是我们还答不上的问题。
collocations: the frontier｜边境；前沿 ; frontier town｜边境城镇
tip_zh: 地理上是边境。引申义是某领域的前沿，常用 a new frontier。

definition_en: to burst with force, or to increase suddenly
example1_en: A sealed can may explode in a fire.
example1_zh: 密封罐在火里可能爆炸。
example2_en: The number of applications did not explode until the school posted the scholarship date.
example2_zh: 学校公布奖学金日期之后，申请数量才一下子多起来。
collocations: explode with anger｜勃然大怒 ; an exploding population｜激增的人口
word_family: explosion (n. 爆炸；激增) ; explosive (adj. 爆炸性的) ; explosive (n. 炸药)
tip_zh: 动词 explode，名词 explosion。本卡只讲安全和「突然变多」，不写制造爆炸物的方法。

definition_en: easily broken or damaged
example1_en: These glasses are fragile, so pack them well.
example1_zh: 这些玻璃杯易碎，要包好。
example2_en: The fragile pages tore when we turned them, so the librarian brought cotton gloves.
example2_zh: 脆弱的书页一翻就裂，图书管理员便拿来了棉手套。
collocations: fragile glass｜易碎的玻璃 ; handle with care, fragile｜易碎，小心轻放
tip_zh: 英式 fragile 常读成和 mile 押韵；美式末尾更像 /dʒəl/。意思都是易碎。

meanings_zh: n. 目录 | v. 编目
definition_en: a list of items, American spelling | to make a list of items
example1_en: The library catalog lists three copies.
example1_zh: 图书馆目录里列着三本。
example2_en: Search the catalog by the writer's family name if you do not know the full title.
example2_zh: 如果不知道完整书名，就按作者的姓在目录里查。
collocations: library catalog｜图书馆目录 ; card catalog｜卡片目录
tip_zh: 美式拼作 catalog。本批另有英式 catalogue，两条都能搜到。

meanings_zh: n. 指挥；售票员 | n. 导体
definition_en: a person who directs musicians, or who sells tickets on a bus or train | a material that lets heat or electricity pass through
example1_en: The conductor raised the baton.
example1_zh: 指挥举起了指挥棒。
example2_en: Copper is a good conductor, so the lab uses it when the circuit will not close.
example2_zh: 铜是良导体，所以电路合不上时实验室用它。
collocations: an orchestra conductor｜乐队指挥 ; a bus conductor｜公共汽车售票员 ; a good conductor｜良导体
word_family: conduct (v. 指挥；传导) ; conduction (n. 传导)
tip_zh: conductor 可以是指挥、公共汽车售票员，也可以是物理里的导体。动词是 conduct。

definition_en: a small pack, or a block of data sent together
example1_en: Open one packet of seeds.
example1_zh: 打开一包种子。
example2_en: The lost packet of letters was under the bench, still tied with the red string.
example2_zh: 那包信落在长凳底下，红绳还系着。
collocations: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干 ; a packet of data｜一个数据包
tip_zh: 英式小包装常用 packet。美式常用 pack 或 package。数据包也是 packet。

meanings_zh: adj. 以前的 | adj. 前者的
definition_en: previous | being the first of two people or things just mentioned
example1_en: He is a former student of this school.
example1_zh: 他是这所学校以前的学生。
example2_en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
example2_zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。
collocations: former colleague｜以前的同事 ; former president｜前任总统 ; former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip_zh: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

definition_en: the scientific study of stars, planets, and space
example1_en: Astronomy club meets on Thursdays.
example1_zh: 天文社团每周四活动。
example2_en: Astronomy asks how stars form, while astrology claims to read character from them, and the two are not the same.
example2_zh: 天文学研究恒星如何形成，占星术声称能从星象看性格，两者不是一回事。
collocations: radio astronomy｜射电天文学 ; an astronomy club｜天文社团
word_family: astronomer (n. 天文学家) ; astronomical (adj. 天文学的；极大的)
tip_zh: astronomy 是科学。astrology 是占星。astronomical 还可以形容数字大得惊人。

definition_en: easy to see or understand
example1_en: It is evident that she studied hard.
example1_zh: 很明显她学习很努力。
example2_en: The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.
example2_zh: 在交通拥堵有所缓解的城市，改善公共交通的益处显而易见。
collocations: clearly evident｜十分明显的 ; become evident｜变得明显 ; evident from｜从……可明显看出
tip_zh: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

definition_en: a room or building where students live
example1_en: Lights-out in the dorm is ten.
example1_zh: 宿舍十点熄灯。
example2_en: The dorm has a quiet floor during exams, and visitors sign the book at the door.
example2_zh: 考试期间宿舍有一层是安静楼层，来访者要在门口登记。
collocations: a dorm room｜宿舍房间 ; in the dorm｜在宿舍
tip_zh: dorm 是 dormitory 的口语缩略。正式作文可以写 dormitory。

definition_en: the main stem of a tree, or a large box
example1_en: We sat on the fallen trunk and ate lunch.
example1_zh: 我们坐在倒下的树干上吃午饭。
example2_en: The old trunk in the attic holds letters, and the lock still works.
example2_zh: 阁楼上的旧箱子里放着信，锁还能用。
collocations: a tree trunk｜树干 ; a trunk｜一只大箱
tip_zh: 参考表是树干和大箱子。象鼻也叫 trunk，本卡按表先记这两项。

definition_en: enough
example1_en: Food supply is adequate.
example1_zh: 食物供应是足够的。
example2_en: Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
example2_zh: 学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。
collocations: adequate funding｜充足的资金 ; adequate preparation｜充分准备 ; adequate for the task｜足以胜任任务
tip_zh: 表示达到所需标准，不等于优秀；常接for或to。

definition_en: that you may choose, not required
example1_en: The afternoon club is optional.
example1_zh: 下午的社团是自愿参加的。
example2_en: Question six is optional, but a good answer there can still raise the final mark.
example2_zh: 第六题可选做，不过答得好仍然能提高最后的分数。
collocations: optional course｜选修课 ; optional question｜选做题
tip_zh: optional 是可以不选。必修是 compulsory 或 required。

meanings_zh: v. 叹气 | n. 叹息
definition_en: to breathe out loudly because you are tired or sad | the sound of that breath
example1_en: She sighed and closed the heavy book.
example1_zh: 她叹了口气，合上那本厚书。
example2_en: A sigh went round the room when the final whistle ended the match in a draw.
example2_zh: 终场哨响、比赛踢平时，屋子里响起一片叹息。
collocations: sigh with relief｜松一口气 ; give a sigh｜叹一口气
tip_zh: sigh 的 gh 不发音。with a sigh of relief 是松了口气。

meanings_zh: v. 低语 | n. 低语
definition_en: to speak very quietly | words spoken that way
example1_en: Whisper if the baby is asleep.
example1_zh: 宝宝睡了就小声说。
example2_en: A whisper at the back still reached the speaker, so he paused and asked for quiet.
example2_zh: 后排的低语还是传到了发言人那里，他停下来请大家安静。
collocations: in a whisper｜低声地 ; whisper to sb｜对某人耳语
tip_zh: whisper to sb，不是 whisper sb。大喊是 yell 或 shout。

definition_en: a large building where goods are stored
example1_en: The new chairs are still in the warehouse.
example1_zh: 新椅子还在仓库里。
example2_en: A warehouse by the river stores the school's old desks until the summer sale.
example2_zh: 河边的一座仓库存放着学校的旧课桌，直到暑期义卖。
collocations: a warehouse｜一座仓库 ; warehouse manager｜仓库管理员
tip_zh: warehouse 是存货的大房子。重音在前半，house 仍读 /haʊs/。

definition_en: tidy, or done in a clever simple way
example1_en: Keep the table neat so the next class can use it.
example1_zh: 把桌子保持整洁，下一班才能用。
example2_en: Her handwriting is neat, and the neat solution used only three lines.
example2_zh: 她的字迹整洁，那个巧妙的解法只用了三行。
collocations: neat handwriting｜工整的字迹 ; a neat solution｜巧妙的解法
tip_zh: 参考表是整洁的、灵巧的。房间整洁和办法干净利落都可以说 neat。

definition_en: too painful, loud, or unpleasant to accept
example1_en: The heat felt unbearable.
example1_zh: 热得让人受不了。
example2_en: An unbearable noise from the drill stopped the quiz, and the class moved to the library.
example2_zh: 钻机的噪音让人受不了，测验停了，全班改去图书馆。
collocations: unbearable heat｜难以忍受的炎热 ; unbearable pain｜难以忍受的疼痛
word_family: bear (v. 忍受) ; bearable (adj. 可忍受的) ; unbearably (adv. 难以忍受地)
tip_zh: unbearable 是无法忍受。反义 bearable。动词 bear 在这个意义上是忍受，过去分词 borne。

definition_en: a sudden event that causes great damage or suffering
example1_en: The flood was a catastrophe for the town.
example1_zh: 这场洪水对小镇是一场大灾难。
example2_en: Calling a missed bus a catastrophe wastes the word, which reporters keep for events that harm many people.
example2_zh: 把没赶上车叫大灾难是滥用这个词，记者把它留给伤害许多人的事件。
collocations: a natural catastrophe｜自然灾害 ; avoid a catastrophe｜避免一场大祸
word_family: catastrophic (adj. 灾难性的) ; catastrophically (adv. 灾难性地)
tip_zh: catastrophe 比普通的 problem 严重得多。形容词 catastrophic。写作时不要把小事说成灾难。

definition_en: a woman whose job is to clean and help in a house or hotel
example1_en: The maid folded towels in the hotel room.
example1_zh: 女仆在旅馆房间里叠毛巾。
example2_en: In the story the maid keeps the keys and knows which door sticks in wet weather.
example2_zh: 故事里女仆保管钥匙，并且知道哪扇门在潮湿天气会卡住。
collocations: hotel maid｜旅馆女仆 ; maid of honour｜女傧相
tip_zh: 这里是做家务的女仆。不要和 made（make 的过去式）看混。

definition_en: to pay to receive a magazine or service regularly
example1_en: You can subscribe on the library website.
example1_zh: 你可以在图书馆网站上订阅。
example2_en: The library subscribes to three science magazines and keeps them for one year.
example2_zh: 图书馆订阅三种科学杂志，保存一年。
collocations: subscribe to｜订阅 ; subscribe online｜在线订阅
tip_zh: 参考表是订阅报刊。subscribe to sth。

definition_en: to clean or dry by rubbing
example1_en: Wipe the whiteboard before the next class.
example1_zh: 下一节课前把白板擦干净。
example2_en: Wipe your shoes on the mat, or the mud will mark the lab floor.
example2_zh: 在垫子上擦擦鞋，不然泥会弄脏实验室的地面。
collocations: wipe sth clean｜把某物擦干净 ; wipe away｜擦掉
tip_zh: wipe 是擦。扫地用 sweep，拖地用 mop。

definition_en: a group of singers, or the repeated part of a song
example1_en: The chorus sang the last part together.
example1_zh: 合唱队一起唱了最后一部分。
example2_en: Everyone joined the chorus, even students who had only hummed during the verses.
example2_zh: 副歌一到大家都加入了，连主歌时只哼哼的学生也唱了。
collocations: in chorus｜齐声 ; chorus of a song｜歌曲的副歌
tip_zh: chorus 可以是合唱团，也可以是副歌。in chorus 是齐声。

definition_en: agreement among a group
example1_en: The class reached a consensus: no phones during the film.
example1_zh: 全班达成共识：看电影时不用手机。
example2_en: There is no consensus yet on whether the sports day should move to Friday.
example2_zh: 运动会要不要改到星期五，目前还没有一致意见。
collocations: reach a consensus｜达成共识 ; a consensus on｜关于……的共识
tip_zh: consensus 本身已含「共同」，不要再加 common 叠床架屋。前面常用 a。

definition_en: a woman in charge of a house, or a woman teacher
example1_en: The mistress of the house showed us the piano.
example1_zh: 女主人带我们看了那架钢琴。
example2_en: In the old novel the school mistress stayed late to help the younger class with reading.
example2_zh: 在那部旧小说里，女教师留到很晚，帮低年级练习阅读。
collocations: mistress of the house｜女主人 ; school mistress｜女教师
tip_zh: 考纲里通常指女主人或女教师。女教师现在更常说 teacher。

definition_en: a large water bird with a long neck
example1_en: A goose blocked the path by the pond.
example1_zh: 一只鹅挡在池塘边的小路上。
example2_en: One goose stayed near the reeds while the rest of the flock swam toward the far bank.
example2_zh: 一只鹅留在芦苇附近，其余的游向了对岸。
collocations: a wild goose｜大雁；野鹅 ; goose feathers｜鹅毛
word_family: geese (n. 鹅的复数) ; gosling (n. 小鹅)
tip_zh: 复数是 geese，不是 gooses。a goose 是一只。

definition_en: a large fish with sharp teeth
example1_en: The film starts with a shark near the pier.
example1_zh: 电影开头是码头附近的一条鲨鱼。
example2_en: Shark fins on the menu started an argument in the biology club.
example2_zh: 菜单上的鱼翅在生物社里引起了一场争论。
collocations: a shark attack｜鲨鱼袭击 ; whale shark｜鲸鲨
tip_zh: shark 是鲨鱼。口语里 shark 也可指骗子，参考表只写了鲨鱼。

definition_en: real
example1_en: The actual cost was higher.
example1_zh: 实际费用更高。
example2_en: Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
example2_zh: 政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。
collocations: actual cost｜实际成本 ; actual results｜实际结果 ; actual size｜实际大小
tip_zh: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

definition_en: to end a law, system, or custom officially
example1_en: The school will abolish that fine.
example1_zh: 学校将取消那项罚款。
example2_en: Historians compare how different countries abolish an old rule, and the essay must cite the dates.
example2_zh: 历史学者比较不同国家如何废除一项旧规定，文章必须注明日期。
collocations: abolish a law｜废除一项法律 ; abolish slavery｜废除奴隶制
word_family: abolition (n. 废除) ; abolitionist (n. 废除主义者)
tip_zh: abolish 的宾语是制度、法律或习俗，不是一个人。名词 abolition。

definition_en: a strong vehicle used on a farm for pulling
example1_en: The tractor left deep marks in the mud.
example1_zh: 拖拉机在泥里留下深深的痕迹。
example2_en: A red tractor pulled the cart of straw past the school gate just after lunch.
example2_zh: 午饭刚过，一辆红色拖拉机拉着一车稻草经过校门口。
collocations: drive a tractor｜开拖拉机 ; a farm tractor｜农用拖拉机
tip_zh: tractor 是农用牵引车。司机仍说 driver，动词是 drive。

meanings_zh: v. 大喊 | n. 喊声
definition_en: to shout very loudly | a loud shout
example1_en: Please do not yell across the hall.
example1_zh: 请不要隔着大厅大喊。
example2_en: A yell from the stairs told us the bus had arrived, so we grabbed the bags and ran.
example2_zh: 楼梯上传来一声喊，说校车到了，我们抓起包就跑。
collocations: yell at sb｜冲某人大喊 ; give a yell｜大叫一声
tip_zh: yell at sb 是冲着某人喊，常常带怒气。声音很轻是 whisper。

meanings_zh: n. 伤疤 | v. 留下伤痕
definition_en: a mark left on the skin after a wound heals | to leave that kind of mark
example1_en: The scar on his knee is fading.
example1_zh: 他膝盖上的疤正在变淡。
example2_en: A deep cut may scar the skin, so the nurse cleaned it before she closed the file.
example2_zh: 深的伤口可能留下疤，护士先清洗，再合上记录。
collocations: a scar on the face｜脸上的疤 ; leave a scar｜留下伤疤
tip_zh: scar 是伤好以后留下的印。正在流血的伤口是 wound 或 cut。

definition_en: the part of the body between the ribs and the hips
example1_en: The belt was loose around her waist.
example1_zh: 腰带在她腰上松松的。
example2_en: He tied the apron at the waist before he started washing the trays.
example2_zh: 他先把围裙系在腰上，再开始洗托盘。
collocations: waist deep｜齐腰深 ; around the waist｜在腰间
tip_zh: 腰是 waist。浪费是 waste，读音接近，拼写不同。

definition_en: a person who rides a bicycle
example1_en: A cyclist waited at the crossing.
example1_zh: 一个骑自行车的人在路口等着。
example2_en: Every cyclist on the school ride wears a helmet, and lights are required once the sky dims.
example2_zh: 学校骑行里的每个人都戴头盔，天色一暗还必须开车灯。
collocations: a racing cyclist｜自行车运动员 ; cyclist lane｜自行车道
word_family: cycle (v. 骑自行车) ; bicycle (n. 自行车)
tip_zh: cyclist 是骑车的人。自行车本身是 bicycle 或 bike。动词常用 cycle。

definition_en: the ability to do something well enough
example1_en: Language competence grows with use.
example1_zh: 语言能力随使用而增长。
example2_en: The test checks competence in reading and writing, not how fast a student can recite a list.
example2_zh: 这项测试看的是读写能力，不是学生背清单有多快。
collocations: language competence｜语言能力 ; competence in｜在……方面的能力
word_family: competent (adj. 能胜任的) ; competently (adv. 胜任地)
tip_zh: competence 不要和 competition（比赛）或 compete 弄混。形容词 competent。

meanings_zh: v. 点头 | n. 点头
definition_en: to move the head down and up to agree or greet | that movement
example1_en: Nod if you can hear the question.
example1_zh: 听得见问题就点头。
example2_en: She gave a nod to the conductor and then turned the page without a word.
example2_zh: 她对指挥点了一下头，然后一言不发地翻页。
collocations: nod one's head｜点头 ; a nod of agreement｜点头同意
tip_zh: 点头同意是 nod。摇头是 shake one's head。过去式 nodded，双写 d。

definition_en: a solid with six equal square sides, or the result of multiplying a number by itself twice
example1_en: Each cube of ice went into a glass.
example1_zh: 每块冰都进了一个杯子。
example2_en: The cube of 3 is 27, which you can check by building a stack three blocks wide.
example2_zh: 3 的立方是 27，你可以搭一个三块宽的堆来核对。
collocations: a cube of sugar｜一块方糖 ; the cube of 2｜2 的立方
word_family: cubic (adj. 立方的) ; cubed (adj. 立方的；切成方块的)
tip_zh: 立方体和「某数的立方」都是 cube。形容词 cubic 本库另有一条。

meanings_zh: adj. 失去知觉的；无意识的
definition_en: not awake, or done without realising
example1_en: The player was unconscious for a minute.
example1_zh: 那名队员昏迷了大约一分钟。
example2_en: An unconscious habit of tapping the desk annoyed the people sitting beside him.
example2_zh: 他无意识地敲桌子，惹恼了坐在旁边的人。
collocations: knock unconscious｜打昏 ; unconscious of｜未察觉
tip_zh: 昏迷是 unconscious。无意识的习惯也用这个词。意识是 conscious。

meanings_zh: adj. 明显的；表面上的 | adj. 表面上的；看似的
definition_en: easy to see; seeming | Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.
example1_en: It was apparent that he was tired.
example1_zh: 很明显他累了。
example2_en: Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
example2_zh: 尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。
collocations: become apparent｜变得明显 ; for no apparent reason｜无明显原因 ; apparent contradiction｜表面上的矛盾
tip_zh: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

definition_en: to suffer or die because there is not enough food
example1_en: Do not starve yourself before a match.
example1_zh: 比赛前不要饿着肚子。
example2_en: Plants starve without light as surely as people starve without food, which the biology note puts side by side.
example2_zh: 植物没有光会衰竭，正如人没有食物会挨饿，生物笔记把两句放在一起。
collocations: starve to death｜饿死 ; be starving｜饿极了
word_family: starvation (n. 饥饿) ; starving (adj. 极饿的)
tip_zh: starve 可以指严重挨饿，口语 be starving 只是非常饿。不要鼓励节食到伤害身体。本批另有名词 starvation。

meanings_zh: v. 羡慕；妒忌 | n. 羡慕；妒忌
definition_en: to wish you had what someone else has | that feeling
example1_en: I do not envy his early bus.
example1_zh: 我不羡慕他那么早的班车。
example2_en: It is easy to envy a score, and harder to see the hours that sat behind it.
example2_zh: 羡慕一个分数很容易，看见分数背后的那些小时就难了。
collocations: envy sb sth｜羡慕某人某物 ; the envy of｜……所羡慕的对象
word_family: envious (adj. 羡慕的；妒忌的) ; enviable (adj. 令人羡慕的)
tip_zh: envy sb sth。形容词是 envious，形容人；enviable 形容令人羡慕的事物。the envy of the class 是全班羡慕的对象。

definition_en: something you accept as true without proof
example1_en: The plan rests on one assumption: the bus will be on time.
example1_zh: 这个计划靠一个假定：公共汽车会准时。
example2_en: Her assumption that everyone had a laptop was wrong, so we shared three computers.
example2_zh: 她以为人人都有笔记本电脑，这个假定是错的，于是我们合用三台电脑。
collocations: on the assumption that｜假定…… ; make an assumption｜作出假定
tip_zh: assumption 是名词。动词 assume 表示假定。

definition_en: a curved structure over an opening
example1_en: We met under the stone arch by the old gate.
example1_zh: 我们在旧门口的石拱下见面。
example2_en: The arch over the path is low, so the bus cannot pass and we walk the last minute.
example2_zh: 小路上的拱门很矮，公共汽车过不去，最后一分钟我们步行。
collocations: a stone arch｜石拱 ; arch bridge｜拱桥
tip_zh: arch 作名词是拱。architect 是建筑师，不是 arch 的一种形式。

meanings_zh: n. 垃圾；废弃物 | v. 乱扔
definition_en: rubbish left in a public place | to leave rubbish around
example1_en: Pick up litter before you leave the park.
example1_zh: 离开公园前把垃圾捡起来。
example2_en: Papers litter the steps after a windy day, and the class clears them in pairs.
example2_zh: 大风过后纸片散落在台阶上，全班两人一组把它们清掉。
collocations: drop litter｜乱扔垃圾 ; a litter bin｜垃圾箱
tip_zh: litter 强调随地丢下的垃圾。垃圾箱是 a litter bin。动词 litter 是使某处布满杂物。

definition_en: to force liquid or food out of the mouth
example1_en: Spit seeds into a tissue, never onto the path.
example1_zh: 把籽吐进纸巾，不要吐在路上。
example2_en: He spat the bitter seeds into a tissue and threw that tissue into the bin by the door.
example2_zh: 他把苦籽吐进纸巾，再把纸巾扔进门口的垃圾桶。
collocations: spit out｜吐出 ; spit on the ground｜随地吐痰
tip_zh: 过去式是 spat。公共场所不要随地吐痰。本卡只收这个生活义，不写骂人的话。

meanings_zh: adj. 逐渐的 | adj. 坡度平缓的
definition_en: happening slowly | Rising or falling gently rather than steeply
example1_en: Progress is often gradual.
example1_zh: 进步往往是逐渐的。
example2_en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
example2_zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。
collocations: gradual improvement｜逐步改善 ; gradual change｜渐进的变化 ; a gradual slope｜平缓的斜坡
tip_zh: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。

definition_en: a political system based on public ownership
example1_en: The chapter explains socialism in plain words.
example1_zh: 这一章用平实的话解释社会主义。
example2_en: The history test asks how socialism is described in the textbook, not what you shout in class.
example2_zh: 历史考试问教科书怎样描述社会主义，不是问你在课堂上喊什么。
collocations: scientific socialism｜科学社会主义 ; under socialism｜在社会主义制度下
tip_zh: socialism 是名词。社会是 society。不要把两个词拼混。

definition_en: to bring goods in from another country
example1_en: The shop imports tea from Fujian every spring.
example1_zh: 这家店每年春天从福建进茶。
example2_en: Countries that import most of their grain watch the price of ships and fuel.
example2_zh: 粮食大多靠进口的国家，会盯着运费和燃料价格。
collocations: import sth from｜从……进口 ; imported goods｜进口货物
tip_zh: 动词重音在后：import。名词「进口」重音在前。不要和 important 写成一个词。

definition_en: a class or meeting in which a small group discusses a subject
example1_en: The seminar starts with one question.
example1_zh: 讨论课从一个问题开始。
example2_en: Bring a printed page to the seminar, because the room has no screen this week.
example2_zh: 讨论课带一页打印稿，这个星期房间里没有屏幕。
collocations: a seminar on｜关于……的研讨会 ; attend a seminar｜参加讨论课
tip_zh: seminar 人少，大家讨论。面对很多人的演讲是 a lecture。

meanings_zh: n. 改编本 | n. 适应
definition_en: a film or play based on another work | the process of getting used to something
example1_en: This play is an adaptation of a folk tale.
example1_zh: 这部戏是一篇民间故事的改编本。
example2_en: Her adaptation to the new timetable took several days, especially the early lab.
example2_zh: 她适应新课表花了几天，尤其是早实验。
collocations: an adaptation of a novel｜小说改编本 ; adaptation to a timetable｜适应课表
tip_zh: 参考表两个意思都有：适应，改编本。动词是 adapt。

definition_en: a place to stay
example1_en: The school arranged accommodation for the visiting team.
example1_zh: 学校为来访的队伍安排了住宿。
example2_en: Cheap accommodation near the station was full, so we shared a room farther out.
example2_zh: 车站附近便宜的住处满了，于是我们在更远的地方合住一间。
collocations: arrange accommodation｜安排住宿 ; student accommodation｜学生住宿
tip_zh: 英式常用不可数 accommodation。美式有时用 accommodations 表示住处。

meanings_zh: v. 假定；承担 | v. 承担；就任 | v. 呈现；具有
definition_en: to suppose; to take on | To take on a duty, responsibility, or position. | To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.
example1_en: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules.
example1_zh: 不要假定人人都知道规则。
example2_en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
example2_zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。
collocations: assume that｜假定…… ; assume responsibility｜承担责任 ; assume office｜就任
tip_zh: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

meanings_zh: v. 采用；收养 | v. 收养 | v. 正式通过；采纳
definition_en: to take up; to take as one's own | To legally take someone else's child into your family. | To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.
example1_en: The school will adopt a new teaching method.
example1_zh: 学校将采用一种新的教学方法。
example2_en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
example2_zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。
collocations: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法 ; adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策 ; adopt a child｜收养孩子 ; adopt a resolution｜通过决议
tip_zh: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

meanings_zh: n. 权威；当局 | n. 当局；主管机构 | n. 权威人士；专家
definition_en: power to make decisions | an official body responsible for a particular area or service | a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject
example1_en: The school authority made a new rule.
example1_zh: 学校当局制定了新规则。
example2_en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
example2_zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。
collocations: have authority to do something｜有权做某事 ; local authorities｜地方当局 ; an authority on｜某方面的权威 ; abuse of authority｜滥用职权
tip_zh: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

definition_en: a small piece of old cloth
example1_en: Wipe the bench with a dry rag.
example1_zh: 用一块干布把实验台擦一擦。
example2_en: The rag in the art room is for paint, not for the dishes, and it stays in the red box.
example2_zh: 美术教室里的破布是擦颜料的，不是洗碗的，它放在红盒子里。
collocations: an old rag｜一块旧布 ; in rags｜衣衫褴褛
tip_zh: in rags 表示衣服破旧。rag 也可以是小报，那是另一义，本卡先讲布。

meanings_zh: n. 贡献 | n. 捐款；捐赠物 | n. 投稿；稿件
definition_en: something given to help | Money or goods given to support a person or cause. | A piece of writing supplied for a publication.
example1_en: His contribution to science was huge.
example1_zh: 他对科学的贡献巨大。
example2_en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
example2_zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。
collocations: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献 ; a significant contribution｜重大贡献 ; a voluntary contribution｜自愿捐款
tip_zh: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: v. 通信 | v. 符合；对应
definition_en: to write letters or emails to someone | to match or be similar to something
example1_en: We correspond by email once a month.
example1_zh: 我们每个月通一次电子邮件。
example2_en: These figures correspond to last year's table, so the rise is easy to see.
example2_zh: 这些数字和去年的表对应，所以上升很容易看出来。
collocations: correspond with｜与……通信 ; correspond to｜与……相符
word_family: correspondence (n. 通信；一致) ; correspondent (n. 通信者；记者)
tip_zh: correspond with sb 是通信。correspond to sth 是与某事相符或对应。介词决定意思。

definition_en: to put something briefly into a liquid
example1_en: Dip the brush in water before you paint.
example1_zh: 上色前先把刷子在水里蘸一下。
example2_en: She would dip the cloth into warm water and then wipe the ink off the desk.
example2_zh: 她会把布在温水里浸一浸，再擦掉桌上的墨水。
collocations: dip sth in｜把某物蘸进 ; dip into a book｜翻阅一本书
tip_zh: dip 是短时间浸入再取出。长时间泡用 soak。

meanings_zh: v. 欣赏；感激 | v. 欣赏；赏识 | v. 理解；意识到
definition_en: to value or be thankful for | Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something. | Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.
example1_en: I really appreciate your help.
example1_zh: 我真心感激你的帮助。
example2_en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
example2_zh: 政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。
collocations: greatly appreciate｜非常感激 ; appreciate your help｜感谢你的帮助 ; appreciate the importance of｜认识到……的重要性 ; appreciate art｜欣赏艺术
tip_zh: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

definition_en: warm, comfortable, and pleasantly small
example1_en: The reading corner feels cozy.
example1_zh: 这个阅读角让人觉得舒服。
example2_en: A cozy cabin is pleasant in the rain, provided the stove is safe and the window can still open.
example2_zh: 下雨时小屋很温馨，只要炉子安全、窗户仍能打开。
collocations: a cozy room｜舒适的房间 ; cozy and warm｜又舒服又暖和
synonyms: comfortable（舒适的）, snug（温暖舒适的）
tip_zh: cozy 是美式拼写。英式常写 cosy。它多形容地方，不形容一道难题。

definition_en: a small hotel, often in the country
example1_en: We stayed at a small inn near the station.
example1_zh: 我们住在车站附近的一家小旅店。
example2_en: The inn had only six rooms, and ours looked onto a noisy yard.
example2_zh: 这家小旅店只有六个房间，我们那间对着一个吵闹的院子。
collocations: a country inn｜乡村小旅店 ; stay at an inn｜住小旅店
tip_zh: inn 是小旅馆。不要写成 in 或 inner。

definition_en: to say strongly that something is wrong, or to sentence someone
example1_en: The letter condemns wasting public water.
example1_zh: 这封信谴责浪费公共用水。
example2_en: Teachers condemn cheating, and they also explain how to quote a source honestly.
example2_zh: 老师谴责作弊，同时也讲怎样诚实地引用资料。
collocations: condemn sb for｜因……谴责某人 ; condemn a building｜宣布建筑不得使用
tip_zh: condemn sb / sth for。名词 condemnation。宣布房屋危不得使用也可以用 condemn。

meanings_zh: adj. 准确的 | adj. 精准的；命中目标的
definition_en: correct and exact | able to hit or reach the intended target
example1_en: Give an accurate answer, please.
example1_zh: 请给出准确答案。
example2_en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
example2_zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。
collocations: accurate information｜准确信息 ; accurate measurements｜精确测量 ; highly accurate｜高度精确的 ; an accurate prediction｜准确的预测
tip_zh: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

definition_en: graceful and attractive in a simple way
example1_en: The black dress looks elegant and plain.
example1_zh: 那条黑裙子看着优雅又朴素。
example2_en: An elegant solution uses fewer steps, which is why the teacher praised that proof.
example2_zh: 优雅的解法步骤更少，所以老师夸了那个证明。
collocations: elegant dress｜雅致的裙子 ; elegant solution｜简洁巧妙的解法
tip_zh: elegant 可以形容衣着，也可以形容办法简洁漂亮。

definition_en: a person who makes and repairs wooden things
example1_en: A carpenter repaired the stage steps.
example1_zh: 一位木匠修好了舞台台阶。
example2_en: The carpenter measured the shelf twice, because the wall in the lab is not straight.
example2_zh: 木匠把搁板量了两次，因为实验室的墙不直。
collocations: a skilled carpenter｜熟练的木匠 ; carpenter's tools｜木工工具
tip_zh: 木工活是 carpentry。carpenter 是做这行的人。

definition_en: not often
example1_en: She seldom misses a morning run.
example1_zh: 她很少错过晨跑。
example2_en: Seldom does the lab close on a weekday, so a locked door usually means a safety check is under way.
example2_zh: 实验室很少在工作日关门，所以门锁上通常表示正在做安全检查。
collocations: seldom if ever｜极少 ; seldom seen｜很少见到
tip_zh: seldom 放在句首时，后面要部分倒装：Seldom does he...。它的意思接近 rarely，和 often 相反。

definition_en: a unit of land area
example1_en: The school field covers about two acres.
example1_zh: 学校操场大约有两英亩。
example2_en: Farmers measured the field in acres long before the map showed metres and squares.
example2_zh: 早在地图用米和方格之前，农民就用英亩量这块地。
collocations: two acres of land｜两英亩地 ; an acre｜一英亩
tip_zh: acre 是面积单位，大约 4047 平方米。不要和 eagle 看混。

definition_en: a French title for a married woman, or a polite form of address
example1_en: The letter opened with Madame Zhou.
example1_zh: 信的开头是「周夫人」。
example2_en: Call her Madame Curie in the science report, because that is the name on the source card.
example2_zh: 科学报告里称她居里夫人，因为资料卡上写的是这个名字。
collocations: Madame Curie｜居里夫人 ; Dear Madame｜亲爱的夫人
tip_zh: madame 是法语称呼，姓名前要大写：Madame Curie。英语 madam 仍在考纲里，Zipf 更低，本批不收。

meanings_zh: v. 催促；力劝 | n. 强烈的欲望
definition_en: to push someone strongly to do something | a strong wish
example1_en: I urge you to hand the form in today.
example1_zh: 我劝你今天就把表交上去。
example2_en: He felt a sudden urge to leave the noisy hall and finish the reading outside.
example2_zh: 他突然很想离开嘈杂的礼堂，到外面把阅读做完。
collocations: urge sb to do｜催促某人做 ; a strong urge｜强烈的欲望
tip_zh: urge sb to do sth。名词指一时压不住的冲动。

definition_en: done by choice, not because you must
example1_en: The evening rehearsal is voluntary.
example1_zh: 晚上的排练是自愿参加的。
example2_en: Voluntary work at the library counts, but it does not replace the written exam.
example2_zh: 图书馆的志愿工作算数，但不能代替笔试。
collocations: voluntary work｜志愿工作 ; on a voluntary basis｜自愿地
tip_zh: voluntary 是自愿的。名词 volunteer 是志愿者。

definition_en: the feeling of needing a drink, or a strong wish
example1_en: Thirst woke him before dawn.
example1_zh: 渴在黎明前把他渴醒了。
example2_en: Her thirst for maps began in primary school, when one atlas filled a whole shelf at home.
example2_zh: 她对地图的渴望从小学就开始了，那时家里一整层架子都是一本地图册。
collocations: thirst for knowledge｜对知识的渴望 ; die of thirst｜渴死
word_family: thirsty (adj. 渴的) ; thirstily (adv. 口渴地)
tip_zh: 口渴和渴望都是名词。thirst for 表示对知识或成功的渴望。形容词是 thirsty。动词 thirst 很少用，本卡不列。

definition_en: a belief about what will happen
example1_en: The teacher's expectation is a full draft by Monday.
example1_zh: 老师的期望是星期一交完整草稿。
example2_en: The result was below expectation, so the group met again and checked the scale.
example2_zh: 结果低于预期，于是小组又碰了一次头，核对了天平。
collocations: below expectation｜低于预期 ; live up to expectations｜不负期望
tip_zh: expectation 是名词。动词 expect。常用复数 expectations。

definition_en: happening in every part of the country
example1_en: The speech contest is nationwide, so our school can enter.
example1_zh: 演讲比赛是全国性的，我们学校可以参加。
example2_en: A nationwide search for the missing instrument ended when it turned up in a taxi.
example2_zh: 对那件失踪乐器的全国搜寻，在它出现在一辆出租车里时结束了。
collocations: a nationwide contest｜全国性比赛 ; nationwide coverage｜全国报道
tip_zh: 参考表标成 ad.，中文是「全国范围内的」。本卡按形容词。它也可以作副词：sold nationwide。

definition_en: an Australian animal that jumps and carries its young in a pouch
example1_en: A kangaroo crossed the dirt road.
example1_zh: 一只袋鼠穿过了土路。
example2_en: The article explains that a young kangaroo stays in the pouch, and the photo shows only the mother's feet.
example2_zh: 文章说明小袋鼠待在育儿袋里，照片上只拍到了母亲的脚。
collocations: a kangaroo pouch｜育儿袋 ; kangaroo crossing｜袋鼠穿行
tip_zh: kangaroo 复数是 kangaroos。幼崽待的袋子是 pouch。

definition_en: to run away from danger
example1_en: People flee the smoke instead of hiding in it.
example1_zh: 人要离开烟，不要躲在烟里。
example2_en: The villagers fled uphill when the river rose, and the school gym took them in.
example2_zh: 河水上涨时村民往山上撤，学校体育馆收留了他们。
collocations: flee from danger｜逃离危险 ; flee the city｜逃离城市
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词是 fled。flee 强调离开危险。flight 还可以是航班，要看上下文。

meanings_zh: n. 自由 | n. 免受；摆脱
definition_en: the right to act freely | The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.
example1_en: Speech freedom is valued in many places.
example1_zh: 许多地方重视言论自由。
example2_en: Universities should protect academic freedom while encouraging researchers to consider the social consequences of their work.
example2_zh: 大学应保护学术自由，同时鼓励研究人员考虑其工作的社会影响。
collocations: freedom of speech｜言论自由 ; freedom to choose｜选择的自由 ; academic freedom｜学术自由 ; freedom from fear｜免于恐惧
tip_zh: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

definition_en: a grain used to make flour and bread
example1_en: The field beyond the dorm is planted with wheat.
example1_zh: 宿舍那边的地种的是小麦。
example2_en: This region grows wheat, not rice, so the bread here is made from local flour.
example2_zh: 这个地区种小麦，不种水稻，所以这里的面包用本地面粉。
collocations: wheat flour｜小麦粉 ; a wheat field｜麦田
tip_zh: wheat 是植物或谷粒。面粉是 flour。

definition_en: the main land mass, not the islands
example1_en: The ferry links the island to the mainland.
example1_zh: 渡船连接岛屿和大陆。
example2_en: Fruit from the mainland arrives on Thursdays, which is why the market is busiest then.
example2_zh: 大陆来的水果周四到，所以那天集市最挤。
collocations: the mainland｜大陆 ; mainland China｜中国大陆
tip_zh: mainland 相对岛屿而言。前面常加 the。

definition_en: the part of a phone you hold to your ear
example1_en: Put the receiver down if nobody answers.
example1_zh: 如果没人接，就把听筒放下。
example2_en: The receiver was warm from the long call, and the cord barely reached the desk.
example2_zh: 打了很久，听筒是热的，线也勉强够到桌子。
collocations: pick up the receiver｜拿起听筒 ; a radio receiver｜无线电接收器
tip_zh: 动词 receive 已在词库。receiver 也可指接收器，参考表这一行是电话听筒。

definition_en: governing itself, or able to act independently
example1_en: The club is autonomous inside the school.
example1_zh: 这个社团在校内是自主管理的。
example2_en: An autonomous region writes some local rules, while national law still covers the whole area.
example2_zh: 自治区可以制定部分地方规定，全国性法律仍然覆盖整个地区。
collocations: an autonomous region｜自治区 ; autonomous learning｜自主学习
word_family: autonomy (n. 自治；自主) ; autonomously (adv. 自主地)
tip_zh: 名词是 autonomy。autonomous learning 是自己安排的学习，不是离开学校。

meanings_zh: adj. 基本的；根本的 | n. 基本原理；基础知识
definition_en: basic and important | A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.
example1_en: Honesty is a fundamental value.
example1_zh: 诚实是基本价值观。
example2_en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
example2_zh: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。
collocations: fundamental to｜对……至关重要 ; a fundamental principle｜基本原则 ; fundamental change｜根本性改变 ; the fundamentals of｜……的基础知识
tip_zh: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

definition_en: an instrument that makes far objects look nearer
example1_en: The night class uses the telescope fixed on the roof.
example1_zh: 夜课使用固定在屋顶上的望远镜。
example2_en: Through the telescope the moon's craters look sharp, even on a cold night.
example2_zh: 透过望远镜，即使在冷夜里，月球上的环形山也很清楚。
collocations: look through a telescope｜用望远镜看 ; a radio telescope｜射电望远镜
word_family: telescopic (adj. 望远镜的；可伸缩的)
tip_zh: 望远镜是 telescope。显微镜是 microscope。不要对调。

definition_en: the regular beat of blood in the body
example1_en: The nurse checked my pulse after the race.
example1_zh: 赛后护士给我测了脉搏。
example2_en: His pulse was fast, so they made him sit in the shade before he ran again.
example2_zh: 他脉搏很快，于是他们让他在阴凉处坐下，然后再跑。
collocations: check sb's pulse｜测脉搏 ; a weak pulse｜微弱的脉搏
tip_zh: 脉搏是 pulse。把手指放在手腕上数。参考表也写了光或波的脉动。

definition_en: a dry fruit with a hard shell
example1_en: Tell the cook if you cannot eat a nut.
example1_zh: 如果你不能吃坚果，告诉厨师。
example2_en: This bun has a nut in the middle, so it is not for the students with that allergy.
example2_zh: 这个面包中间有一颗坚果，有这种过敏的学生不能吃。
collocations: a nut｜一颗坚果 ; nut allergy｜坚果过敏
tip_zh: 参考表是坚果、果仁。螺母也叫 nut，本卡不收。

definition_en: a bus or train that goes regularly between two places
example1_en: A shuttle runs from the station to the campus.
example1_zh: 有班车从车站开到校园。
example2_en: The evening shuttle stops at the gate, so you do not have to walk across the dark field.
example2_zh: 晚班车在门口停，你就不用穿过那片黑漆漆的场地。
collocations: shuttle bus｜区间班车 ; space shuttle｜航天飞机
tip_zh: 两地之间来回开的车是 shuttle。航天飞机是 space shuttle。

meanings_zh: adv. 在头顶上 | adj. 头顶上的
definition_en: above your head | located above your head
example1_en: Birds flew overhead as we left the hall.
example1_zh: 我们离开礼堂时，鸟从头顶飞过。
example2_en: An overhead light flickered, and the librarian asked someone to change the tube.
example2_zh: 头顶的灯一闪一闪，图书管理员请人去换灯管。
collocations: overhead light｜顶灯 ; fly overhead｜在头顶飞
tip_zh: overhead 可作副词或形容词。经费里的日常开支也叫 overheads，那是另一义。

meanings_zh: n. 事务；事件 | n. 婚外情；私情
definition_en: a matter or event | a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner
example1_en: Public affair need careful attention.
example1_zh: 公共事务需要认真关注。
example2_en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
example2_zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。
collocations: current affairs｜时事 ; foreign affairs｜外交事务 ; a private affair｜私事 ; have an affair｜有婚外情
tip_zh: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

definition_en: to pay someone to work for you
example1_en: The shop will employ two more clerks.
example1_zh: 这家店还要雇两名店员。
example2_en: The factory does not employ children, and the notice by the gate says so plainly.
example2_zh: 工厂不雇用儿童，门口的告示写得很明白。
collocations: employ sb as｜雇某人为 ; employ workers｜雇用工人
tip_zh: employer 是雇主，employee 是雇员。就业是 employment。

meanings_zh: adj. 最初的 | n. 姓名首字母 | v. 用姓名首字母签署
definition_en: first | The first letter of a person's name | To mark a document with the first letters of your names
example1_en: My initial plan was wrong.
example1_zh: 我最初的计划是错的。
example2_en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
example2_zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。
collocations: initial reaction｜最初的反应 ; initial assessment｜初步评估 ; initial cost｜初期费用 ; initial stages｜初始阶段
tip_zh: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

definition_en: a list of names, or a folder of files
example1_en: Her name is in the school directory.
example1_zh: 她的名字在学校名录里。
example2_en: Save the photos in a new directory so they do not mix with last year's files.
example2_zh: 把照片存进新目录，免得和去年的文件混在一起。
collocations: telephone directory｜电话簿 ; file directory｜文件目录
tip_zh: 纸质名录和电脑里的文件夹都可以叫 directory。

definition_en: to state formally that you are leaving a job
example1_en: She will resign at the end of term.
example1_zh: 她学期结束时辞职。
example2_en: He chose not to resign, because the team still needed him for the last month.
example2_zh: 他决定不辞职，因为团队最后一个月还需要他。
collocations: resign from｜从…辞职 ; resign as captain｜辞去队长
tip_zh: resign from 是辞职。resign yourself to 是无可奈何地接受，不是把事情交给别人。

meanings_zh: v. 作弊；欺骗 | n. 骗子；作弊
definition_en: to act dishonestly, especially in a test | a person who cheats, or the act
example1_en: Nobody is allowed to cheat on the quiz.
example1_zh: 测验时谁也不许作弊。
example2_en: He tried to cheat by hiding notes in his sleeve, and the teacher saw the paper.
example2_zh: 他想把笔记藏在袖子里作弊，老师看见了那张纸。
collocations: cheat on a test｜考试作弊 ; cheat sb out of｜骗走某人的
tip_zh: 考试作弊是 cheat on/in a test。名词 cheat 也可指作弊的人。

definition_en: of the region around the North Pole
example1_en: Arctic air reached the city, and the pond froze.
example1_zh: 北极冷空气到了这座城市，池塘结冰了。
example2_en: The Arctic fox in the documentary changes color when the snow comes.
example2_zh: 纪录片里的北极狐在下雪时会换毛色。
collocations: the Arctic｜北极 ; Arctic Ocean｜北冰洋
tip_zh: 作专名时常大写：the Arctic。南极是 the Antarctic。

definition_en: a person paid to work in someone's house
example1_en: In the play, the servant hears the secret first.
example1_zh: 剧里，仆人最先听到那个秘密。
example2_en: The old house once kept a servant beside the kitchen, in a room now used for storage.
example2_zh: 这栋老房子从前在厨房旁边住着一个仆人，那间房现在用来堆东西。
collocations: a civil servant｜公务员 ; a public servant｜公职人员
tip_zh: servant 是为人工作的人。civil servant 是公务员，不是家里的佣人。

definition_en: the sense of what is right and wrong
example1_en: His conscience would not let him cheat.
example1_zh: 他的良心不允许他作弊。
example2_en: She listened to her conscience and returned the wallet she had found on the bus.
example2_zh: 她听从良心，把在公交车上捡到的钱包还了回去。
collocations: a clear conscience｜问心无愧 ; guilty conscience｜内疚
tip_zh: conscience 中间有 science 的形，但意思是良心。意识是 consciousness。

meanings_zh: v. 急速移动；拉近镜头 | n. 变焦
definition_en: to move very fast, or to make a camera image larger | a camera setting that changes how close things look
example1_en: Bikes zoom past the library steps.
example1_zh: 自行车从图书馆台阶边飞驰而过。
example2_en: Zoom in on the label so the expiry date is large enough to read without guessing.
example2_zh: 把镜头拉近到标签上，让保质期大到不用猜就能看清。
collocations: zoom in｜拉近 ; zoom out｜拉远
tip_zh: zoom in 拉近，zoom out 拉远。车子飞驰也可以用 zoom。第一义是动词。

definition_en: a crash between moving things
example1_en: The collision blocked the bridge for an hour.
example1_zh: 这场碰撞让桥堵了一个小时。
example2_en: No one was hurt in the collision, but both mirrors lay in pieces on the road.
example2_zh: 碰撞中没有人受伤，但两面镜子都碎在路上。
collocations: a head-on collision｜迎面相撞 ; in collision with｜与…相撞
tip_zh: collision 是名词。动词是 collide with。

definition_en: a small enclosed stall
example1_en: Wait in the phone booth; I'll be one minute.
example1_zh: 在电话亭里等一下，我一分钟就来。
example2_en: Each club had a booth in the gym, with a sign and a signup sheet.
example2_zh: 每个社团在体育馆里都有一个小隔间，挂着牌子和报名表。
collocations: a phone booth｜电话亭 ; a ticket booth｜售票亭
tip_zh: 参考表音标写成了 /buːð/。booth 的辅音是 /θ/，本卡不采用那条音标。

definition_en: a nut with a hard wrinkled shell
example1_en: A walnut cracked under the spoon.
example1_zh: 一颗核桃在勺子下裂开了。
example2_en: She added a chopped walnut to the salad, after checking that nobody at the table had a nut allergy.
example2_zh: 她确认同桌没有人对坚果过敏之后，才把切碎的核桃加进沙拉。
collocations: walnut cake｜核桃蛋糕 ; a shelled walnut｜去壳核桃
tip_zh: walnut 是核桃。复数 walnuts。坚果过敏在共享食物时要先问，这是生活礼貌。

meanings_zh: adv. 向后 | adj. 向后的；落后的
definition_en: towards the back | directed back, or less developed
example1_en: Lean backward only if someone holds the chair.
example1_zh: 有人扶着椅子再向后靠。
example2_en: A backward glance showed that the queue was still at the tree, not at the door.
example2_zh: 他向后看了一眼，队伍还在树那儿，没有到门口。
collocations: backward and forward｜来回 ; a backward step｜后退的一步
word_family: backwards (adv. 向后) ; forward (adv. 向前)
tip_zh: backward 可作副词或形容词。带 s 的 backwards 已在库里。形容地区「落后」时语气重，少用。

definition_en: an ancient stone monument, or a solid with triangular sides meeting at a point
example1_en: The pyramid throws a long shadow.
example1_zh: 金字塔投下长长的影子。
example2_en: In maths a pyramid has a point at the top, and the base can be a square.
example2_zh: 数学里的棱锥顶部是一个点，底可以是正方形。
collocations: the Pyramids｜金字塔 ; a square pyramid｜正方棱锥
tip_zh: 埃及金字塔和几何棱锥都是 pyramid。专名前可加 the：the Great Pyramid。

definition_en: to take back, or to take money out
example1_en: You can withdraw cash at the machine by the gate.
example1_zh: 你可以在门口的机器上取现金。
example2_en: She withdrew her name from the race after the doctor looked at her ankle.
example2_zh: 医生看过她的脚踝后，她退出了比赛。
collocations: withdraw money｜取钱 ; withdraw from｜从……退出
tip_zh: 过去式 withdrew，过去分词 withdrawn。取钱和退出比赛都用这个动词。

definition_en: a woman whose husband has died
example1_en: The widow next door teaches piano on Saturdays.
example1_zh: 隔壁的遗孀星期六教钢琴。
example2_en: In the novel the widow keeps her husband's letters in a tin under the bed.
example2_zh: 小说里，这位遗孀把丈夫的信放在床下一个铁盒里。
collocations: a widow｜一位遗孀 ; widow's pension｜遗孀抚恤金
tip_zh: 参考表没有 widow 这一行。鳏夫是 widower。

definition_en: something added to make a place or object look special
example1_en: Paper stars were the only decoration.
example1_zh: 装饰只有纸星星。
example2_en: The decoration on the window must come down before the exam notices are taped there.
example2_zh: 考试通知贴上去之前，窗户上的装饰得先取下来。
collocations: interior decoration｜室内装饰 ; Christmas decorations｜圣诞装饰
word_family: decorate (v. 装饰) ; decorative (adj. 装饰性的) ; decorator (n. 装修者)
tip_zh: 动词是 decorate。一件饰品是 a decoration，节日里常用复数 decorations。

definition_en: a rule or fact that limits what you can do
example1_en: The restriction on phones starts today.
example1_zh: 手机限制从今天开始。
example2_en: One restriction remains: visitors may enter the lab only with a teacher beside them.
example2_zh: 还有一条限制：参观者只能在老师陪同下进实验室。
collocations: a restriction on｜对……的限制 ; without restriction｜不受限制
word_family: restrict (v. 限制) ; restrictive (adj. 限制性的)
tip_zh: restriction on sth。动词 restrict sb / sth。没有限制是 without restriction。

meanings_zh: v. 抓住；理解 | n. 理解；掌握
definition_en: to hold firmly, or to understand | an understanding of something
example1_en: Grasp the rope with both hands.
example1_zh: 用两只手抓住绳子。
example2_en: Once you grasp the rule, the later exercises take much less time to finish.
example2_zh: 一旦理解这条规则，后面的练习就省事得多。
collocations: grasp a chance｜抓住机会 ; a good grasp of｜对…掌握得好
tip_zh: grasp 可以是手里抓住，也可以是脑子里弄懂。

definition_en: an instrument that shows direction, or one that draws circles
example1_en: The compass needle points north.
example1_zh: 指南针的针指向北。
example2_en: Draw the circle with a compass, and do not use a cup if the radius must be exact.
example2_zh: 用圆规画圆；半径必须准确时不要用杯子代替。
collocations: a magnetic compass｜磁罗盘 ; a pair of compasses｜一副圆规
tip_zh: 指南针是 a compass。圆规常说 a pair of compasses。两个意思都要看句子。

definition_en: to make fun of someone, sometimes unkindly
example1_en: Do not tease him about his accent.
example1_zh: 不要拿他的口音取笑。
example2_en: Friends may tease one another lightly, but the joke stops when the other person stops smiling.
example2_zh: 朋友之间可以轻轻逗一逗，可是对方不再笑的时候，玩笑就该停。
collocations: tease sb about｜拿……取笑某人 ; tease apart｜梳理清楚
tip_zh: tease sb about sth。善意的逗和伤人的嘲弄不一样，对方不舒服就要停。名词 a tease 不如动词常见。

definition_en: a plant used to flavour food or in medicine
example1_en: This soup needs one fresh herb.
example1_zh: 这汤需要一种新鲜香草。
example2_en: The herb garden behind the kitchen grows mint, and students may smell it but not pick it.
example2_zh: 厨房后面的香草园种着薄荷，学生可以闻，不能摘。
collocations: a medicinal herb｜药草 ; herb tea｜草药茶
tip_zh: 英式 herb 的 h 常不发音，美式多发音。形容词 herbal。

meanings_zh: v. 宣布；声明 | v. 申报
definition_en: to state officially | to officially report goods, income or other required information
example1_en: The mayor will declare the festival open.
example1_zh: 市长将宣布节日开幕。
example2_en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
example2_zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。
collocations: declare a winner｜宣布获胜者 ; declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态 ; declare goods｜申报物品 ; declare income｜申报收入
tip_zh: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

definition_en: to press something firmly from opposite sides
example1_en: Squeeze the cloth before you hang it up.
example1_zh: 把布拧干再挂起来。
example2_en: We had to squeeze into the last row because the earlier seats were already taken.
example2_zh: 前面的位子满了，我们只好挤进最后一排。
collocations: squeeze out｜挤出 ; squeeze into｜挤进
tip_zh: squeeze into 是勉强挤进。把汁挤出来是 squeeze out。

definition_en: facts and figures
example1_en: Scientists collect data from tests.
example1_zh: 科学家从实验中收集数据。
example2_en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
example2_zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。
collocations: collect data｜收集数据 ; analyse data｜分析数据 ; personal data｜个人数据 ; data protection｜数据保护
tip_zh: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

definition_en: to look at something carefully, often in an official way
example1_en: Inspect the cable for a crack.
example1_zh: 检查电线有没有裂口。
example2_en: Officials inspect the kitchen twice a year, and the canteen must show how it stores milk and meat.
example2_zh: 官员一年两次视察厨房，食堂必须说明牛奶和肉类如何存放。
collocations: inspect a site｜视察现场 ; inspect for damage｜检查有无损坏
word_family: inspection (n. 检查) ; inspector (n. 检查员)
tip_zh: inspect 比 look at 更仔细，也常带官方意味。名词 inspection，人是 inspector。

definition_en: a thin thread of natural or artificial material
example1_en: This rope is made of plant fiber.
example1_zh: 这根绳子是植物纤维做的。
example2_en: The label lists fiber as the main material, not plastic.
example2_zh: 标签把纤维列为主要材料，不是塑料。
collocations: plant fiber｜植物纤维 ; optical fiber｜光纤
tip_zh: 考纲另有 fibre。参考表把 fiber 标成 fibre 的美式拼写，中文是纤维质。本卡记作纤维。

definition_en: to put something into something else
example1_en: Insert the key and turn it to the left.
example1_zh: 把钥匙插入，向左转。
example2_en: Insert the cable before you open the file, or the screen stays blank.
example2_zh: 先插上线再打开文件，否则屏幕一直是空的。
collocations: insert sth into｜把某物插入 ; insert a card｜插入卡片
tip_zh: 动词重音常在后：insert。名词「插入物」重音常在前。参考表这一行是及物动词。

meanings_zh: n. 先锋；开拓者 | v. 开拓
definition_en: a person who is among the first to do something | to be the first to develop something
example1_en: She is a pioneer of village libraries.
example1_zh: 她是乡村图书馆的开拓者。
example2_en: The lab pioneered a cheap test, and other schools copied it the following year.
example2_zh: 实验室率先做出一种便宜的检测方法，第二年其他学校照着做了。
collocations: pioneer in｜…方面的先驱 ; pioneer a method｜开创一种方法
tip_zh: 名词是开拓者。动词 pioneered 表示率先做。少先队员的称呼另有 Young Pioneer。

meanings_zh: n. 环境；情况 | n. 经济状况；境遇
definition_en: a condition around an event | the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation
example1_en: Under no circumstance should you lie.
example1_zh: 在任何情况下你都不该说谎。
example2_en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
example2_zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。
collocations: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下 ; personal circumstances｜个人情况 ; unforeseen circumstances｜意外情况 ; under no circumstances｜绝不
tip_zh: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

definition_en: stated clearly, with nothing left implied
example1_en: The teacher was explicit about the deadline.
example1_zh: 老师把截止日期说得很明确。
example2_en: Please be explicit about which chart you mean, so the group does not argue later.
example2_zh: 请说清楚你指的是哪张图，免得小组过后再争。
collocations: explicit instructions｜明确的指示 ; be explicit about｜对…说清楚
tip_zh: explicit 是把话说透。反义 vague 含糊。副词 explicitly。

definition_en: tasting very good; informal
example1_en: This stew tastes yummy.
example1_zh: 这道炖菜很好吃。
example2_en: Yummy is fine among friends, but a formal report should say delicious or tasty instead.
example2_zh: 朋友之间说 yummy 可以，正式报告里应当改说 delicious 或 tasty。
collocations: yummy food｜好吃的食物 ; smell yummy｜闻起来很香
tip_zh: yummy 是口语。书面作文用 delicious 或 tasty。它是形容词，不要当副词用。

definition_en: a cover for a pot, box, or jar
example1_en: Put the lid back on the paint.
example1_zh: 把油漆的盖子盖回去。
example2_en: A loose lid let the soup splash, so the cook pressed it down before walking.
example2_zh: 盖子松了，汤洒出来，厨师先把它按紧再走。
collocations: a pot lid｜锅盖 ; keep the lid on｜盖上盖子
tip_zh: lid 是容器的盖。眼皮是 eyelid，不是 lid 单独表示。

meanings_zh: adj. 精致的；脆弱的 | adj. 微妙的；需谨慎处理的 | adj. 精巧的；柔和的
definition_en: fine; easily broken | Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence. | Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.
example1_en: Handle the glass with delicate care.
example1_zh: 轻拿轻放这些玻璃。
example2_en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
example2_zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。
collocations: delicate balance｜微妙的平衡 ; delicate fabric｜易损面料 ; delicate flavour｜清淡的风味 ; delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip_zh: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

definition_en: to break a law, rule, or agreement
example1_en: Closed-lab hours are easy to violate by mistake.
example1_zh: 实验室关闭时段很容易被人不小心违反。
example2_en: Cameras that violate the privacy rule are switched off before the meeting starts.
example2_zh: 违反隐私规定的摄像头在会议开始前关掉。
collocations: violate a rule｜违反规定 ; violate the law｜违法
word_family: violation (n. 违反) ; violator (n. 违反者)
tip_zh: violate a rule / the law。名词 violation。本卡只谈规章和法律，不写伤害别人的做法。

definition_en: a person whose work is teaching or education
example1_en: The educator visited three classrooms.
example1_zh: 这位教育工作者走访了三间教室。
example2_en: An educator designs the task so that a wrong answer still teaches the next step.
example2_zh: 教育工作者设计任务时，会让一个错误答案仍然能教出下一步。
collocations: a science educator｜科学教育工作者 ; educator's role｜教育者的职责
word_family: educate (v. 教育) ; education (n. 教育)
tip_zh: educate 和 education 已在库里。educator 比 teacher 范围更广，可以包括课程设计者。

definition_en: to do what a person or rule says
example1_en: Players must obey the line judge.
example1_zh: 队员必须服从边裁。
example2_en: If you obey the fire plan, leave your bags and walk out. Do not run.
example2_zh: 要是遵守消防方案，就把包留下，走出去。不要跑。
collocations: obey the rules｜遵守规则 ; obey an order｜服从命令
word_family: obedience (n. 服从) ; obedient (adj. 服从的)
tip_zh: obey sb / obey a rule，后面直接加宾语。名词 obedience，反义词 disobey。

meanings_zh: v. 区分；辨别 | v. 成为…的特征；使有别于 | v. 看清；听出
definition_en: to tell apart | to make someone or something different from others | to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it
example1_en: Babies learn to distinguish colors early.
example1_zh: 婴儿很早就能学会辨别颜色。
example2_en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
example2_zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。
collocations: distinguish between｜区分两者 ; distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开 ; distinguish yourself｜使自己出众
tip_zh: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

definition_en: a style of cooking
example1_en: Sichuan cuisine can be very hot.
example1_zh: 川菜可以很辣。
example2_en: The food fair puts local cuisine on one side and bread from the port city on the other.
example2_zh: 美食节一边是本地菜，另一边是港口城市的面包。
collocations: local cuisine｜地方菜 ; Chinese cuisine｜中国菜
word_family: cook (v. 烹饪) ; kitchen (n. 厨房)
tip_zh: cuisine 指一个地方或风格的菜，比 cooking 更正式。前面常加地方名。

definition_en: a small common brown bird
example1_en: A sparrow sat on the rail.
example1_zh: 一只麻雀停在栏杆上。
example2_en: Sparrows gathered near the canteen bins, and the guard asked students not to feed them.
example2_zh: 麻雀聚集在食堂垃圾桶附近，警卫请学生不要喂它们。
collocations: a house sparrow｜家麻雀 ; sparrow's nest｜麻雀窝
tip_zh: sparrow 是麻雀。复数 sparrows。喂野生鸟通常不被鼓励，尤其是在食堂附近。

definition_en: a private teacher, or a teacher who guides a student
example1_en: My tutor checked the essay plan.
example1_zh: 我的导师看过了文章提纲。
example2_en: A weekend tutor can explain one weak topic, but the student still has to finish the practice alone.
example2_zh: 周末的辅导老师可以讲清一个薄弱知识点，但练习仍得学生自己做完。
collocations: a private tutor｜私人教师 ; a personal tutor｜个人导师
word_family: tutorial (n. 辅导课) ; tutoring (n. 家教)
tip_zh: tutor 可以是家教，也可以是大学里的导师。动词 tutor sb in sth 是辅导某人某科。

definition_en: real, not a copy
example1_en: The museum label says the coin is authentic.
example1_zh: 博物馆标签写着这枚硬币是真品。
example2_en: The coach wants an authentic signature on the form, not a name typed in a box.
example2_zh: 教练要表格上有真实签名，不是在格子里打出来的名字。
collocations: an authentic document｜真实的文件 ; authentic food｜地道的食物
tip_zh: authentic 表示不是仿造的。副词 authentically，名词 authenticity。

definition_en: in a genuine, honest way
example1_en: I sincerely hope you feel better soon.
example1_zh: 我真心希望你快点好起来。
example2_en: She sincerely thanked the stranger, then wrote his name so she would not forget it.
example2_zh: 她真诚地谢过那位陌生人，然后写下他的名字，免得忘掉。
collocations: yours sincerely｜您真诚的 ; sincerely hope｜衷心希望
tip_zh: 信的结尾 Yours sincerely 用在知道对方姓名时。形容词是 sincere。

meanings_zh: adj. 灵活的 | adj. 柔韧的；易弯曲的
definition_en: able to change easily | able to bend easily without breaking
example1_en: Keep a flexible schedule.
example1_zh: 保持灵活的时间安排。
example2_en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
example2_zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。
collocations: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间 ; a flexible approach｜灵活的方法 ; flexible materials｜柔性材料
tip_zh: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

definition_en: a round juicy fruit with a large stone
example1_en: A ripe peach smells sweet.
example1_zh: 熟桃子闻着是甜的。
example2_en: She cut the peach in half, removed the stone, and shared the fruit with her niece.
example2_zh: 她把桃子切成两半，去掉核，分给侄女吃。
collocations: a peach stone｜桃核 ; peach blossom｜桃花
tip_zh: 复数 peaches。桃核是 stone 或 pit。桃花是 peach blossom。

definition_en: a person you work with
example1_en: A colleague saved me a seat in the hall.
example1_zh: 一位同事在礼堂给我留了座位。
example2_en: She asked a colleague to read the figures before the meeting, so the chart would be accurate.
example2_zh: 她请同事在会前核对数字，好让图表准确。
collocations: a colleague of mine｜我的一位同事 ; work colleague｜同事
tip_zh: 同事是 colleague。同学是 classmate，不要混。

definition_en: a feeling of worry
example1_en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
example1_zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。
example2_en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
example2_zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。
collocations: anxiety about｜对……的焦虑 ; reduce anxiety｜减轻焦虑 ; severe anxiety｜严重焦虑
tip_zh: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

definition_en: to give something and receive something else
example1_en: Can I swap seats with you?
example1_zh: 我能和你换座位吗？
example2_en: They swap books every Friday, and each person writes one line inside the cover.
example2_zh: 他们每周五换书，每人在封面里写一行字。
collocations: swap sth with sb｜与某人交换 ; swap places｜换位置
tip_zh: swap 是口语里的交换。过去式 swapped，p 要双写。

meanings_zh: n. 冲突 | n. 矛盾；抵触 | v. 相冲突；相抵触
definition_en: a serious disagreement | A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree. | To disagree with or be incompatible with something.
example1_en: Talking can reduce family conflict.
example1_zh: 沟通可以减少家庭冲突。
example2_en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
example2_zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。
collocations: resolve a conflict｜解决冲突 ; conflict with｜与……相抵触 ; a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip_zh: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

definition_en: a period when many people are angry and public order is weak
example1_en: The chapter describes urban unrest.
example1_zh: 这一章描述城市里的动荡。
example2_en: Historians study the unrest through diaries and newspapers, and the essay must separate facts from slogans.
example2_zh: 历史学者通过日记和报纸研究那场动荡，文章必须把事实和口号分开。
collocations: social unrest｜社会动荡 ; civil unrest｜内乱
word_family: restless (adj. 不安宁的) ; uneasy (adj. 不安的)
tip_zh: unrest 不可数，多用于历史或新闻。写作时陈述事实，不要把它写成行动指南。

definition_en: to love and admire someone or something deeply
example1_en: The children adore the old storyteller.
example1_zh: 孩子们非常喜欢这位老讲故事的人。
example2_en: She adores early mornings at the market, when the fish is still on ice.
example2_zh: 她热爱市场的清晨，那时鱼还放在冰上。
collocations: adore doing｜非常喜欢做 ; adore sb｜爱慕某人
word_family: adoration (n. 爱慕) ; adoring (adj. 爱慕的)
tip_zh: adore 比 like 强得多。adore doing sth。名词 adoration。

meanings_zh: v. 收缩；缩小 | n. 收缩
definition_en: to become smaller, often after washing or from fear | the process of becoming smaller
example1_en: Hot water will shrink this sweater.
example1_zh: 热水会把这件毛衣缩水。
example2_en: The lake shrank in August, and the boat club moved its rope to a nearer post.
example2_zh: 湖面八月缩小了，划船社团把绳子改系到更近的桩上。
collocations: shrink from｜退缩不前 ; shrink in the wash｜洗后缩水
word_family: shrinkage (n. 收缩量) ; shrunken (adj. 皱缩的)
tip_zh: 过去式 shrank，过去分词 shrunk。毛衣缩水用 shrink。口语里把心理医生叫 shrink 不是本卡的义项。

definition_en: an unmarried man, or a first university degree
example1_en: He is a bachelor and cooks for himself.
example1_zh: 他是单身，自己做饭。
example2_en: He holds a bachelor of science degree, and the form asks which subject he finished.
example2_zh: 他有理学学士学位，表格问他读完的是哪个专业。
collocations: a bachelor's degree｜学士学位 ; bachelor flat｜单身公寓
tip_zh: 学士是 bachelor's degree。未婚女子不是 bachelor。

definition_en: a good moral quality
example1_en: Patience is a virtue in a long queue.
example1_zh: 排长队时，耐心是一种美德。
example2_en: The speech praised honesty as a virtue, then gave two examples from school life.
example2_zh: 演讲把诚实誉为美德，接着举了校园生活里的两个例子。
collocations: virtue and vice｜善与恶 ; by virtue of｜凭借
tip_zh: by virtue of 表示凭借，比 because of 正式。

definition_en: a narrow passage of water between two pieces of land
example1_en: The strait is narrow but deep.
example1_zh: 这条海峡又窄又深。
example2_en: Ships cross the strait at marked times, which the map shows with a thin blue line.
example2_zh: 船只在标出的时间穿过海峡，地图上用一条细蓝线表示。
collocations: a narrow strait｜狭窄的海峡 ; the Taiwan Strait｜台湾海峡
tip_zh: strait 是海峡，和 straight（直的）拼写不同。处于困境可以说 in dire straits，那是引申。

meanings_zh: v. 广播；播放 | n. 广播节目；播出
definition_en: to send out by radio or TV | A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.
example1_en: The match will broadcast live tonight.
example1_zh: 比赛今晚将直播。
example2_en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
example2_zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。
collocations: broadcast live｜现场直播 ; news broadcast｜新闻广播 ; broadcast a programme｜播出节目
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

definition_en: a unit of liquid, about 0.57 litres in Britain
example1_en: Please buy a pint of milk.
example1_zh: 请买一品脱牛奶。
example2_en: A British pint is a little more than half a litre, which the recipe card shows beside the cup size.
example2_zh: 英制品脱比半升略多，食谱卡片在杯子容量旁边标出了这一点。
collocations: a pint of milk｜一品脱牛奶 ; two pints｜两品脱
tip_zh: pint 是容量单位。英制大约 0.57 升。课堂例句用牛奶或配方，不拿它当酒的量词来用。

definition_en: a shape with three straight sides
example1_en: Draw a triangle and mark the right angle.
example1_zh: 画一个三角形，并标出直角。
example2_en: The roof forms a triangle, which is why rain runs off both sides so quickly.
example2_zh: 屋顶构成一个三角形，所以雨水从两侧流得很快。
collocations: right triangle｜直角三角形 ; triangle sides｜三角形的边
tip_zh: 三角形是 triangle。角是 angle。三边是 three sides。

definition_en: a sour liquid used in cooking
example1_en: A spoon of vinegar lifts the soup.
example1_zh: 一勺醋让汤的味道提起来了。
example2_en: Rice vinegar is milder than the dark kind, which the cooking note explains beside the salt.
example2_zh: 米醋比深色的醋更温和，烹饪说明在盐的旁边写了这一点。
collocations: rice vinegar｜米醋 ; vinegar and oil｜油醋
tip_zh: vinegar 不可数。酸是 sour。中餐里的醋和西餐色拉醋都可以用这个词。

definition_en: to provide what is needed for a task
example1_en: The lab will equip every group with goggles.
example1_zh: 实验室会给每组配护目镜。
example2_en: Good courses equip students with methods they can reuse, not only with facts for one test.
example2_zh: 好的课程让学生具备可以再用的方法，而不只是应付一次考试的事实。
collocations: equip sb with｜用……装备某人 ; equip a lab｜装备实验室
word_family: equipment (n. 设备) ; equipped (adj. 装备好的)
tip_zh: equip sb with sth。名词 equipment 已在库里，不可数。过去式 equipped 要双写 p。

definition_en: not stained by rust, or free from a moral stain
example1_en: Use the stainless pot for the soup.
example1_zh: 汤用那口不锈钢锅。
example2_en: Stainless steel spoons stay bright, while the old iron ones mark the cloth.
example2_zh: 不锈钢勺子一直发亮，旧铁勺会在布上留下印。
collocations: stainless steel｜不锈钢 ; a stainless knife｜不锈钢刀
word_family: stain (n. 污渍) ; stain (v. 沾污)
tip_zh: stainless steel 是不锈钢。stain 是污渍或动词「沾污」。

definition_en: suffering or death caused by a lack of food
example1_en: The text defines starvation carefully.
example1_zh: 课文小心地下了挨饿的定义。
example2_en: The geography unit describes starvation as a dangerous lack of food and asks how supplies reach a village.
example2_zh: 地理单元把挨饿写成危险的食物匮乏，并问物资怎样送到村里。
collocations: die of starvation｜饿死 ; starvation wages｜不够活的工资
word_family: starve (v. 挨饿) ; starving (adj. 极饿的)
tip_zh: starvation 是严重缺乏食物。口语里 I'm starving 只是很饿，和真正的 starvation 不是一回事。写作要分清。

definition_en: an oven that cooks with microwaves, or those waves themselves
example1_en: Reheat yesterday's rice in the microwave.
example1_zh: 把昨天的米饭放进微波炉里热一热。
example2_en: Do not put metal in the microwave, even if the bowl looks safe from the outside.
example2_zh: 不要把金属放进微波炉，哪怕碗从外面看是安全的。
collocations: a microwave oven｜微波炉 ; microwave popcorn｜微波炉爆米花
tip_zh: 日常说 the microwave 就是微波炉。金属不能放进去。微波本身是物理名词。

definition_en: violent and aggressive, or very strong
example1_en: A fierce wind bent the young trees.
example1_zh: 猛烈的风把小树吹弯了。
example2_en: The debate grew fierce, yet both sides still listened when the chair asked for quiet.
example2_zh: 辩论变得激烈，但主席要求安静时双方仍然听着。
collocations: fierce competition｜激烈的竞争 ; a fierce animal｜凶猛的动物
tip_zh: fierce 可以形容动物、风，也可以形容竞争或争论。

definition_en: easy to carry
example1_en: This portable radio fits in a school bag.
example1_zh: 这台便携收音机能放进书包。
example2_en: A portable charger kept the recording going when the hall had no socket near the stage.
example2_zh: 礼堂舞台边没有插座，便携充电器让录音得以继续。
collocations: a portable device｜便携设备 ; portable speaker｜便携音箱
tip_zh: portable 强调搬得动。口袋大小更常说 pocket。

definition_en: the reflexive form of you when you means more than one
example1_en: Please time yourselves on this page.
example1_zh: 请给自己计时做这一页。
example2_en: If the map is unclear, work it out yourselves and then compare the route with the other pair.
example2_zh: 地图如果看不清，你们自己先把它弄明白，再和另一组对路线。
collocations: by yourselves｜你们独自 ; help yourselves｜你们自取
word_family: yourself (pron. 你自己) ; you (pron. 你；你们) ; your (det. 你的；你们的)
tip_zh: yourselves 是 you 的复数反身代词。一个人用 yourself，不要写成 yourselfs。

definition_en: unable to stop doing something
example1_en: He is addicted to late-night videos.
example1_zh: 他迷上了深夜看视频。
example2_en: Once you are addicted to a game, set a clock and leave the screen when it rings.
example2_zh: 一旦迷上某个游戏，就定个钟，铃响了就离开屏幕。
collocations: be addicted to｜迷上；对……上瘾 ; addicted to sugar｜嗜糖
word_family: addiction (n. 瘾；沉溺) ; addictive (adj. 使人上瘾的)
tip_zh: 人用 addicted，事物使人上瘾用 addictive。be addicted to sth / doing。本卡只谈学习和生活习惯。

meanings_zh: n. 接力赛 | v. 转达；转播
definition_en: a race in which each person covers one part | to pass on news or a broadcast
example1_en: Our class won the relay by a stride.
example1_zh: 我们班以一步的优势赢了接力。
example2_en: Please relay the new gate time to the other team, because their coach has no signal on the field.
example2_zh: 请把新的入场时间转达给另一队，他们的教练在场地上没有信号。
collocations: a relay race｜接力赛 ; relay a message｜转达消息
word_family: relay race (n. 接力赛) ; relay station (n. 中继站)
tip_zh: 名词是接力赛。动词 relay sth to sb 是转达。接力棒叫 baton。

definition_en: a small house, especially in the country
example1_en: The reading camp is in a cottage by the lake.
example1_zh: 阅读营在湖边的一间小屋里。
example2_en: The cottage had a low door, and the tallest student had to bend to enter.
example2_zh: 小屋的门很矮，最高的学生得弯腰才能进去。
collocations: a country cottage｜乡村小屋 ; a cottage garden｜村舍花园
tip_zh: cottage 是乡下的小屋。城里的公寓不是 cottage。

definition_en: to forbid something officially
example1_en: Local law prohibits fires on this hill.
example1_zh: 当地法规禁止在这座山上点火。
example2_en: Signs prohibit visitors from touching the models, and a guard repeats the rule at the door.
example2_zh: 标牌禁止参观者触摸模型，门口的警卫会再重复一遍。
collocations: prohibit sb from｜禁止某人做 ; strictly prohibit｜严格禁止
word_family: prohibition (n. 禁令) ; prohibited (adj. 被禁止的) ; prohibitive (adj. 高得令人却步的)
tip_zh: prohibit sb from doing，不说 prohibit to do。forbid 也可以表示禁止，结构是 forbid sb to do。prohibit 更正式。

meanings_zh: n. 胶水 | v. 粘合
definition_en: a sticky substance used to join things | to join things with that substance
example1_en: This glue dries clear on paper.
example1_zh: 这种胶水在纸上干了是透明的。
example2_en: Glue the photo at the corners only, so you can lift it later without tearing the page.
example2_zh: 只在四角抹胶水，以后揭照片才不会把这一页撕破。
collocations: a tube of glue｜一管胶水 ; glue sth together｜把某物粘在一起
tip_zh: glue 可数时是一种胶或一管胶，也可以作动词。液体胶水常不可数。

definition_en: to hit one's hands together to show approval
example1_en: We clap when the choir finishes.
example1_zh: 合唱结束时我们鼓掌。
example2_en: Do not clap during the quiet movement; wait until the conductor lowers both hands.
example2_zh: 安静的乐章进行时不要鼓掌，等指挥把双手放下。
collocations: clap one's hands｜拍手 ; a round of clapping｜一阵掌声
tip_zh: clap 是拍手。applaud 更正式，可以不用手而用言语称赞。过去式 clapped。

definition_en: towards the back; in the reverse order
example1_en: He spelled his name backwards as a joke.
example1_zh: 他开玩笑把自己的名字倒着拼。
example2_en: The video plays backwards if you hold this key, and the dancer seems to rise from the floor.
example2_zh: 按住这个键，视频会倒放，舞者好像从地板上站起来。
collocations: spell sth backwards｜倒着拼 ; backwards and forwards｜来回地
tip_zh: 考纲里 backward 与 backwards 都单列。参考表写成 backward(s)，音标没有词尾的 /z/，本卡按 backwards 收尾补上。

meanings_zh: n. 功能；作用 | v. 运转；发挥作用 | n. 函数
definition_en: the purpose of something | To work or operate in the intended way. | A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.
example1_en: What is the function of this button?
example1_zh: 这个按钮的功能是什么？
example2_en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
example2_zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。
collocations: perform a function｜发挥作用 ; function properly｜正常运转 ; function as｜起……作用 ; basic function｜基本功能
tip_zh: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

definition_en: an official paper showing you have finished a course
example1_en: She framed the diploma above the desk.
example1_zh: 她把文凭裱起来挂在书桌上方。
example2_en: The diploma arrives by post next month, so the ceremony itself does not hand you the paper.
example2_zh: 文凭下个月寄到，典礼当天并不把证书交到你手上。
collocations: a high school diploma｜高中文凭 ; receive a diploma｜获得文凭
tip_zh: diploma 是学历证书。diplomacy 是外交，词根相近但意思不同，不要混。

definition_en: a game in which you roll a ball at pins
example1_en: Our class booked a lane for bowling on Friday.
example1_zh: 我们班星期五订了一条保龄球道。
example2_en: Bowling looks easy until you try to hit the last pin without stepping over the line.
example2_zh: 保龄球看起来容易，等你试着不越线击中最后一只瓶就知道了。
collocations: go bowling｜去打保龄球 ; a bowling alley｜保龄球馆
tip_zh: bowling 是这项运动。碗是 bowl。go bowling 中间没有 to。

definition_en: completely unreasonable or silly
example1_en: The rumour about the exam is absurd.
example1_zh: 关于考试的那个传闻很荒谬。
example2_en: It is absurd to blame the rain for a mistake that was written into the plan.
example2_zh: 计划里写错的东西，却怪到下雨头上，这太荒谬了。
collocations: absurd idea｜荒谬的想法 ; utterly absurd｜荒谬透顶
tip_zh: absurd 语气重，表示完全说不通。名词 absurdity。

meanings_zh: n. 关心；担忧 | n. 令人担忧的事；关注事项 | v. 涉及；使担忧
