definition_en: a worry or interest | An issue that matters or causes worry | To relate to someone or something, or cause worry
example1_en: Health is a shared concern for all.
example1_zh: 健康是所有人共同的关切。
example2_en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
example2_zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。
collocations: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧 ; raise concerns｜引发担忧 ; a major concern｜一个主要问题 ; concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip_zh: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

meanings_zh: v. 抵制 | n. 抵制
definition_en: to refuse to buy something or take part, as a protest | that kind of protest
example1_en: Some readers boycott the unfair magazine.
example1_zh: 有些读者抵制那份不公平的杂志。
example2_en: The boycott of plastic bottles lasted a month and pushed the canteen to offer jugs of water.
example2_zh: 抵制塑料瓶持续了一个月，食堂因此改供应大壶水。
collocations: boycott a product｜抵制某产品 ; call for a boycott｜呼吁抵制
tip_zh: boycott 可作动词或名词。它是公开的集体拒绝，不是偷偷破坏。

definition_en: required by a rule, not left to choice
example1_en: Lab goggles are compulsory here.
example1_zh: 这里必须戴实验护目镜。
example2_en: Sports day is compulsory for every class, though students who are ill can bring a note from the clinic.
example2_zh: 运动会每班都得参加，生病的学生可以带校医室的证明。
collocations: compulsory education｜义务教育 ; compulsory subjects｜必修课
word_family: compel (v. 强迫) ; compulsion (n. 强迫) ; compulsorily (adv. 强制地)
tip_zh: compulsory 后面常接名词。be compulsory for sb 表示某人必须做。反义是 optional。

definition_en: a formal style of dancing on the toes
example1_en: She has ballet practice on Thursday evening.
example1_zh: 她周四晚上练芭蕾。
example2_en: The school ballet tells an old story, and the dancers made their own paper trees.
example2_zh: 学校的芭蕾讲一个老故事，舞者自己做了纸树。
collocations: ballet dancer｜芭蕾舞者 ; ballet shoes｜芭蕾舞鞋
tip_zh: 芭蕾的 t 不发音，末尾读 /eɪ/。

definition_en: deserving respect and approval
example1_en: Her patience is admirable.
example1_zh: 她的耐心令人钦佩。
example2_en: It was admirable of him to share the notes, even though he had finished them late the night before.
example2_zh: 他能把笔记分给别人，这很可敬，尽管那些笔记是前一天夜里很晚才写完的。
collocations: an admirable quality｜可敬的品质 ; admirable courage｜令人钦佩的勇气
word_family: admire (v. 钦佩) ; admiration (n. 钦佩) ; admirably (adv. 极好地)
tip_zh: admire 已在库里，是动词。admirable 是形容词。It is admirable of sb to do 是常见句型。

definition_en: based on theory, not on practice
example1_en: The theoretical result did not match the lab reading.
example1_zh: 理论结果和实验读数对不上。
example2_en: A theoretical model is useful only if someone later tests it with real data.
example2_zh: 理论模型只有后来有人用真实数据检验，才有用。
collocations: theoretical physics｜理论物理 ; in theory｜理论上
tip_zh: theoretical 对 practical。名词 theory。

definition_en: to agree to do a task, or to start it
example1_en: We undertake the cleaning every Friday.
example1_zh: 我们每个星期五负责打扫。
example2_en: The college will undertake a survey of the playground before any new paint is bought.
example2_zh: 学院会在购买新涂料之前先对操场做调查。
collocations: undertake a task｜承担一项任务 ; undertake to do｜答应做
tip_zh: undertake to do sth 是答应去做。过去式 undertook，过去分词 undertaken。

meanings_zh: v. 孵出；孵化 | n. 舱口
definition_en: to break out of an egg, or to make an egg do that | an opening in a ship or aircraft floor
example1_en: The chicks hatch near the warm lamp.
example1_zh: 小鸡在暖灯旁出壳。
example2_en: Three eggs hatch by Friday, and the farmer will move those chicks into a dry box.
example2_zh: 有三枚蛋星期五孵出来，农场主会把那些小鸡挪进干燥的箱子。
collocations: hatch out｜孵出 ; hatch a plan｜策划一个计划
word_family: hatchery (n. 孵化场) ; hatchling (n. 刚孵出的幼体)
tip_zh: 第一义是孵出。hatch a plan 是暗中策划。名词 hatch 还可指船上的舱口。

definition_en: a small piece of thick material that lies on the floor or a table
example1_en: Leave wet shoes on the mat.
example1_zh: 湿鞋放在垫子上。
example2_en: He rolled the exercise mat after practice so nobody would trip in the dark corridor.
example2_zh: 训练后他把运动垫卷起来，免得有人在暗走廊里绊倒。
collocations: a door mat｜门垫 ; an exercise mat｜运动垫
word_family: doormat (n. 门垫) ; mattress (n. 床垫)
tip_zh: mat 是小垫子。床垫是 mattress，大得多。不要和 maths 混在一个词里。

definition_en: to move an event to a later time
example1_en: We postponed the match until Monday.
example1_zh: 我们把比赛推迟到周一。
example2_en: They postponed printing the paper until the missing chart arrived, rather than guessing the numbers.
example2_zh: 他们把报纸的付印推迟到缺失的图送到之后，而不是去猜那些数字。
collocations: postpone a meeting｜推迟会议 ; postpone doing｜推迟做
tip_zh: postpone 后接名词或 doing，不说 postpone to do。推迟到某时用 until 或 to。反义可以是 bring forward。

definition_en: unable to walk well, or weak as an excuse
example1_en: The lame dog waited by the kitchen door.
example1_zh: 那只跛脚的狗等在厨房门口。
example2_en: Saying he forgot the date is a lame excuse, because the notice has been up all week.
example2_zh: 说自己忘了日期站不住脚，通知已经贴了整整一周。
collocations: a lame excuse｜站不住脚的借口 ; lame in one leg｜一条腿瘸
tip_zh: 形容腿是跛。形容借口是站不住脚。后一种很常见。

definition_en: a branch of mathematics that uses letters for numbers
example1_en: Algebra uses letters for unknown numbers.
example1_zh: 代数用字母表示未知数。
example2_en: In algebra we solve for x, and we show each step so a classmate can follow it.
example2_zh: 代数课上我们求 x，并且把每一步写出来，让同学跟得上。
collocations: learn algebra｜学代数 ; an algebra problem｜一道代数题
tip_zh: 学科名前通常不加 the：study algebra。形容词 algebraic。

definition_en: a small change that makes something better
example1_en: One adjustment made the chair comfortable.
example1_zh: 调了一下，椅子就舒服了。
example2_en: A small adjustment to the timetable let the lab group finish before the bus left.
example2_zh: 时间表稍作调整，实验小组就能在车开走前做完。
collocations: make an adjustment｜做调整 ; price adjustment｜价格调整
tip_zh: adjustment 是名词。动词 adjust 已在本库。

definition_en: written forms and records that a job requires
example1_en: The paperwork took the whole afternoon.
example1_zh: 文书工作占了整整一下午。
example2_en: Finish the paperwork before Friday, or the exchange office cannot hold your place.
example2_zh: 星期五之前把文书做完，否则交流办公室留不住你的名额。
collocations: fill in paperwork｜填写材料 ; cut down paperwork｜减少文书
tip_zh: paperwork 不可数。一份表格是 a form，成堆的手续才是 paperwork。

definition_en: a thin cloud near the ground that is lighter than fog
example1_en: Morning mist hid the far goal.
example1_zh: 晨雾挡住了远处的球门。
example2_en: The mist lifted before the ferry left, so passengers could see both banks of the river.
example2_zh: 渡船离开前雾散了，乘客能看见河的两岸。
collocations: morning mist｜晨雾 ; lost in the mist｜消失在雾中
tip_zh: mist 比 fog 更薄。形容词是 misty。不要和 missed（错过）弄混。

meanings_zh: n. 要洗的衣服；洗衣店
definition_en: clothes to be washed, or a place that washes them
example1_en: The dorm laundry closes at nine.
example1_zh: 宿舍洗衣房九点关门。
example2_en: Her laundry was still damp at breakfast, so she wore yesterday's shirt.
example2_zh: 早饭时她要洗的衣服还是潮的，于是她穿了昨天的衬衫。
collocations: do the laundry｜洗衣服 ; a laundry basket｜洗衣篮
tip_zh: laundry 既可以是待洗的衣服，也可以是洗衣的地方。

definition_en: a small long soft creature with no legs
example1_en: A worm crossed the wet path.
example1_zh: 一条蚯蚓爬过湿漉漉的小路。
example2_en: Birds pull a worm from the soil after rain, which the biology note asks you to describe.
example2_zh: 雨后鸟会从土里拽出蚯蚓，生物笔记让你描写这一点。
collocations: an earthworm｜蚯蚓 ; a worm in the apple｜苹果里的虫
tip_zh: 蚯蚓常说 earthworm，泛指小软虫用 worm。电脑里的 worm 是蠕虫病毒，看上下文。

meanings_zh: n. 缺席；缺乏 | n. 缺乏；不存在
definition_en: the state of being away | a situation in which something does not exist or occur
example1_en: His absence from class worried the teacher.
example1_zh: 他缺课让老师担心。
example2_en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
example2_zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。
collocations: absence from work｜缺勤 ; in someone's absence｜在某人不在时 ; in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下 ; leave of absence｜获准休假
tip_zh: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

definition_en: an adult male of the cattle family, often used for farm work
example1_en: An ox stood in the old photo.
example1_zh: 旧照片里站着一头牛。
example2_en: One ox can pull a wooden cart, which the museum model shows beside the rice tools.
example2_zh: 一头牛可以拉木车，博物馆的模型把它放在稻作农具旁边。
collocations: an ox cart｜牛车 ; strong as an ox｜力大如牛
tip_zh: 复数是 oxen，不是 oxes。泛指牛常用 cattle 或 cow。ox 常强调役用的公牛。

definition_en: a person who carries bags, or who watches a door
example1_en: The porter carried our bags to the train.
example1_zh: 搬运工把行李送到了火车上。
example2_en: Ask the porter at the gate whether the hall stays open after nine.
example2_zh: 问问门口的门房，礼堂九点后还开不开。
collocations: a hotel porter｜旅馆门房 ; railway porter｜火车站搬运工
tip_zh: 车站帮你拿箱子的，和守门的，考纲里都可以是 porter。

definition_en: a place where a dead person is buried, often with a stone
example1_en: The old tomb is closed to visitors.
example1_zh: 那座古墓不对参观者开放。
example2_en: Flowers on the tomb are replaced each spring by students from the nearest school.
example2_zh: 墓上的花每年春天由最近那所学校的学生更换。
collocations: ancient tomb｜古墓 ; tomb stone｜墓碑
tip_zh: tomb 的 b 不发音。墓碑常说 tombstone，一个词。

meanings_zh: adj. 持续的；不变的 | adj. 恒定的；不变的 | n. 常数；恒量
definition_en: happening all the time | remaining the same over time | a value or quantity that does not change
example1_en: There is constant noise from the street.
example1_zh: 街上有持续的噪音。
example2_en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
example2_zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。
collocations: constant pressure｜持续的压力 ; constant temperature｜恒温 ; remain constant｜保持不变
tip_zh: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

meanings_zh: adj. 人造的；虚假的 | adj. 不自然的；做作的
definition_en: made by people, not natural | Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour
example1_en: artificial light can hurt sleep.
example1_zh: 人造光可能影响睡眠。
example2_en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
example2_zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。
collocations: artificial intelligence｜人工智能 ; artificial lighting｜人工照明 ; artificial sweeteners｜人工甜味剂 ; an artificial smile｜做作的微笑
tip_zh: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

definition_en: a brown powder from cocoa beans, or a hot drink made from it
example1_en: Hot cocoa warmed our hands.
example1_zh: 热可可暖了我们的手。
example2_en: The cook mixed cocoa with milk rather than water, so the drink was thick enough for a cold morning.
example2_zh: 厨师用牛奶而不是水来调可可，所以冷天早上这杯饮料够浓。
collocations: hot cocoa｜热可可 ; cocoa powder｜可可粉
tip_zh: cocoa 是可可粉或可可饮料。巧克力是 chocolate，原料相关，但不是同一个词。

meanings_zh: v. 分发；分配 | v. 使分布；使散布
definition_en: to give out | to spread something over an area
example1_en: Volunteers distribute food to the poor.
example1_zh: 志愿者向穷人分发食物。
example2_en: Governments must distribute healthcare resources fairly so that rural communities receive the same quality of care as urban residents.
example2_zh: 政府必须公平分配医疗资源，让农村社区享有与城市居民同等质量的医疗服务。
collocations: distribute food｜分发食物 ; distribute resources｜分配资源 ; evenly distributed｜均匀分布的 ; widely distributed｜广泛分布的
tip_zh: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

meanings_zh: v. 贡献；捐献 | v. 促成；是原因之一 | v. 投稿；撰稿
definition_en: to give for a purpose | To help cause a particular result | To write material for a publication or website
example1_en: Everyone can contribute to the project.
example1_zh: 每个人都能为这个项目做贡献。
example2_en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
example2_zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。
collocations: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论 ; contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长 ; contribute funds｜捐助资金 ; contribute an article｜撰写稿件
tip_zh: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

meanings_zh: adj. 绝对的；完全的 | adj. 绝对的；不受限制的
definition_en: total; complete | not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities
example1_en: He has absolute confidence in the team.
example1_zh: 他对团队有绝对信心。
example2_en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
example2_zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。
collocations: absolute silence｜鸦雀无声 ; absolute certainty｜绝对肯定 ; absolute power｜绝对权力 ; an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip_zh: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

definition_en: to gather or increase gradually
example1_en: Dust can accumulate under the bed.
example1_zh: 灰尘会在床底下越积越多。
example2_en: Small errors accumulate if nobody checks the sum, and the final chart then misleads the class.
example2_zh: 如果没人核对总数，小错误就会累积，最后的图表便会误导全班。
collocations: accumulate experience｜积累经验 ; accumulate data｜积累数据
word_family: accumulation (n. 积累) ; accumulative (adj. 累积的)
tip_zh: accumulate 强调逐渐变多。名词 accumulation。人积累经验，灰尘也会 accumulate。

definition_en: a person who speaks officially for a group
example1_en: The spokesman read a short statement.
example1_zh: 发言人宣读了一份简短声明。
example2_en: A spokesman for the museum said the dinosaur hall will reopen after the roof is dry.
example2_zh: 博物馆发言人说，屋顶干了以后恐龙馆会重新开放。
collocations: a government spokesman｜政府发言人 ; act as spokesman｜担任发言人
word_family: spokeswoman (n. 女发言人) ; spokesperson (n. 发言人)
tip_zh: spokesman 传统上指男性。女性是 spokeswoman，中性说法是 spokesperson。复数 spokesmen。

definition_en: to travel on water using sails or a boat | a sheet of cloth that catches the wind
example1_en: They sail on the lake when the wind is steady.
example1_zh: 风稳定时他们在湖上航行。
example2_en: A red sail showed beyond the pier, then disappeared behind the boathouse.
example2_zh: 码头外露出一面红帆，然后消失在船库后面。
collocations: set sail｜起航 ; go sailing｜去航海
tip_zh: 本卡动词在前。帆是名词 sail。开船的人是 sailor，不要和 sail 当成同一个词。

meanings_zh: v. 决定；测定 | v. 决定；影响结果 | v. 决定；下决心
definition_en: to decide firmly; to find out | To control or strongly influence what happens. | To make a firm decision to do something.
example1_en: Tests help determine your progress.
example1_zh: 测试有助于测定你的进步。
example2_en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
example2_zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。
collocations: determine the cause｜查明原因 ; determine whether｜确定是否 ; determine the outcome｜决定结果 ; be determined to｜决心做……
tip_zh: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

definition_en: a thin thread, or the part of food that helps digestion
example1_en: Oats add fibre to breakfast.
example1_zh: 燕麦给早餐增加纤维。
example2_en: Cotton fibre and dietary fibre share a name, but one is cloth and the other is part of what you eat.
example2_zh: 棉纤维和膳食纤维共用一个名字，但一个是布料，一个是食物里的成分。
collocations: dietary fibre｜膳食纤维 ; cotton fibre｜棉纤维
tip_zh: fibre 是英式。美式 fiber 已在库里。膳食纤维 dietary fibre 通常不可数。

meanings_zh: adj. 无辜的；天真的 | adj. 天真的；单纯的 | adj. 无恶意的；无害的
definition_en: not guilty; pure | Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life. | Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.
example1_en: The child looked innocent.
example1_zh: 孩子看上去很天真。
example2_en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
example2_zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。
collocations: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪 ; innocent victims｜无辜的受害者 ; an innocent mistake｜无心之失
tip_zh: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

definition_en: a shop selling food and household goods
example1_en: We stopped at the grocery for milk and eggs.
example1_zh: 我们在杂货店停下，买了牛奶和鸡蛋。
example2_en: The grocery on the corner closes at nine, later than the school canteen.
example2_zh: 拐角的杂货店九点关门，比学校食堂晚。
collocations: a grocery store｜杂货店 ; grocery list｜购物清单
tip_zh: 参考表没有单独的 grocery。常见说法是 a grocery 或 a grocery store，卖食品和日用品。

definition_en: based on chance or personal wish, not on a fair reason
example1_en: The order of names looked arbitrary.
example1_zh: 名单的顺序看起来很随意。
example2_en: An arbitrary rule that ignores the written guide will be hard for the class to accept.
example2_zh: 一条不顾书面说明、只凭武断的规定，全班很难接受。
collocations: an arbitrary decision｜武断的决定 ; arbitrary power｜专断的权力
word_family: arbitrarily (adv. 任意地) ; arbitrariness (n. 任意；武断)
synonyms: random（随机的）, capricious（反复无常的）
tip_zh: arbitrary 强调没有正当理由。random 只是随机，不一定武断。副词是 arbitrarily。

definition_en: extremely good
example1_en: The view from the old tower was superb.
example1_zh: 旧塔上的景色好极了。
example2_en: Reviewers called the performance superb, and the choir was asked to sing it again.
example2_zh: 评论称演出极好，合唱团被请来再唱一遍。
collocations: a superb view｜极好的景色 ; superb performance｜出色的演出
tip_zh: superb 语气很强，比 good 高一档。重音在第二音节。

definition_en: a surprising chance happening
example1_en: It was a coincidence that we wore the same tie.
example1_zh: 我们系了同一条领带，纯属巧合。
example2_en: By coincidence both stories begin on a rainy night in a station, though the writers never met.
example2_zh: 巧合的是两个故事都始于车站的雨夜，尽管两位作者从未见过面。
collocations: by coincidence｜碰巧 ; a mere coincidence｜纯属巧合
tip_zh: by coincidence 作状语。不要说 a coincidence chance。

definition_en: a narrow street or path between buildings
example1_en: The bakery is down a narrow alley.
example1_zh: 面包店在一条窄巷里。
example2_en: Lights were added in the alley so students could walk home without crossing the main road.
example2_zh: 巷子里加了灯，学生回家就不必穿过大路。
collocations: a back alley｜后巷 ; blind alley｜死胡同
tip_zh: 小巷是 alley。盲巷、死胡同是 a blind alley，也可比喻行不通的办法。

definition_en: the height of something above sea level
example1_en: The town sits at a high altitude.
example1_zh: 这座小镇海拔很高。
example2_en: At that altitude the air is thin, so the team walked slowly and drank more water.
example2_zh: 那个高度空气稀薄，队伍走得慢，水也喝得更多。
collocations: high altitude｜高海拔 ; at an altitude of｜在…的高度
tip_zh: altitude 多指海拔。态度是 attitude，只差一个字母。

meanings_zh: n. 大纲；轮廓 | v. 概述
definition_en: the main points of something, or its outer shape | to give the main points
example1_en: An outline comes first, then the full essay.
example1_zh: 先有大纲，再写全文。
example2_en: The teacher outlined the chapter in five points, then left us to read the examples.
example2_zh: 老师用五点概述了这一章，然后让我们自己读例子。
collocations: write an outline｜写大纲 ; in outline｜概括地
tip_zh: 名词 outline 是提纲或轮廓。动词是「概述」，例句里可用 outlined。

definition_en: words printed under a picture, or on a screen
example1_en: The caption names every person in the photo.
example1_zh: 说明文字写出了照片里的每个人。
example2_en: Turn on the caption if the film is quiet, so the back row can still follow the story.
example2_zh: 电影声音小时打开字幕，后排也能跟上情节。
collocations: a photo caption｜图片说明 ; with captions｜带字幕
tip_zh: 图下的说明是 caption。影片字幕也可以说 captions，英式还说 subtitles。

definition_en: to judge the quality or value of something
example1_en: Two teachers assess the oral test together so one opinion does not decide it.
example1_zh: 两位老师一起评定口试，避免一个人说了算。
example2_en: We assess a source by asking who wrote it and whether the date is clear.
example2_zh: 我们评价一份资料，会问是谁写的、日期是否清楚。
collocations: assess sth｜评定某物 ; assess the damage｜评估损失
tip_zh: assess 是作出评价。名词 assessment。不要和 access（进入）搞混。

definition_en: the country you come from
example1_en: She wrote poems about her homeland.
example1_zh: 她写诗写自己的故乡。
example2_en: He returned to his homeland after university and taught in the school he once attended.
example2_zh: 大学毕业后他回到故乡，在自己曾经就读的学校教书。
collocations: love one's homeland｜爱故乡；爱国 ; return to one's homeland｜回到故乡
tip_zh: homeland 可指祖国，也可指故乡那一片土地。

definition_en: not ready or not happy to do something
example1_en: He is unwilling to share the password.
example1_zh: 他不愿意把密码给人。
example2_en: Unwilling helpers slow a group project, so the teacher lets students choose jobs they can accept.
example2_zh: 不情愿的帮手会拖慢小组作业，所以老师让学生选自己能接受的任务。
collocations: unwilling to do｜不愿做 ; an unwilling helper｜不情愿的帮手
word_family: willing (adj. 愿意的) ; unwillingly (adv. 不情愿地) ; unwillingness (n. 不情愿) ; willingness (n. 意愿)
tip_zh: unwilling to do sth，不要说 unwilling doing。副词 unwillingly 已经包含否定，不要再加 not。

meanings_zh: n. 激动；震颤 | v. 使激动
definition_en: a sudden feeling of excitement | to make someone feel that
example1_en: The goal gave the crowd a thrill.
example1_zh: 这个进球让观众激动起来。
example2_en: It still thrills her to hear the violin from the stairwell at the end of practice.
example2_zh: 训练结束时从楼梯间听见小提琴，仍然让她激动。
collocations: the thrill of victory｜胜利时的激动 ; thrill at｜对……感到激动
word_family: thrilled (adj. 非常兴奋的) ; thrilling (adj. 令人兴奋的) ; thriller (n. 惊险小说)
tip_zh: 人感到激动用 thrilled，事物令人激动用 thrilling。thriller 是惊险故事，不是形容词。

definition_en: to clean a floor with a broom
example1_en: Please sweep the classroom after the party.
example1_zh: 聚会结束后请把教室扫一扫。
example2_en: They sweep the leaves off the path each morning before the gates open.
example2_zh: 他们每天早上开门前把小路上的叶子扫掉。
collocations: sweep the floor｜扫地 ; sweep away｜扫掉
tip_zh: 过去式和过去分词都是 swept。扫帚是 broom。

definition_en: to make something clearer and easier to understand
example1_en: Could you clarify the second step?
example1_zh: 你能把第二步说清楚吗？
example2_en: The editor asked him to clarify who paid for the trip before the article went into the paper.
example2_zh: 编辑让他在文章见报前说明这次出行是谁出的钱。
collocations: clarify a point｜澄清一点 ; clarify one's position｜表明立场
word_family: clarification (n. 澄清) ; clarity (n. 清楚) ; clear (adj. 清楚的)
tip_zh: clarify 后面接名词。名词 clarification。clear 是形容词，clarify 是动词。

definition_en: a heavy metal object that keeps a boat in place | to lower the anchor
example1_en: The boat dropped its anchor near the wooden dock.
example1_zh: 船在木码头附近抛了锚。
example2_en: They anchored in a shallow bay because the wind was too strong for the open water.
example2_zh: 风太大，不适合去开阔水面，他们在一个浅湾抛了锚。
collocations: drop anchor｜抛锚 ; weigh anchor｜起锚
tip_zh: 参考表是锚、抛锚。新闻主播也叫 anchor，本卡不收。

definition_en: a fastener that joins two edges of cloth
example1_en: The zip on this coat is stuck.
example1_zh: 这件外套的拉链卡住了。
example2_en: Pull the zip slowly, or the cloth will catch and the coat will not close.
example2_zh: 拉链要慢慢拉，不然布会卡住，外套就合不上。
collocations: zip fastener｜拉链 ; zip code｜邮政编码（美式）
tip_zh: 英式里 zip 常指拉链。美式邮政编码是 zip code。动词 zip up 是拉上拉链。

definition_en: expecting that good things will happen
example1_en: She stays optimistic even when the score is low.
example1_zh: 比分落后时她仍然乐观。
example2_en: An optimistic plan still needs a second bus, in case the first one is full.
example2_zh: 乐观的计划也要留第二辆车，以防第一辆坐满。
collocations: optimistic about｜对…乐观 ; remain optimistic｜保持乐观
tip_zh: optimistic about sth。名词 optimism。反义 pessimistic。

definition_en: an arch of colors in the sky after rain
example1_en: A rainbow stood over the playground after the shower.
example1_zh: 阵雨后一道彩虹挂在操场上空。
example2_en: We stopped the bus to photograph the rainbow, and it faded before everyone was ready.
example2_zh: 我们让车停下拍彩虹，还没等大家都准备好，它就淡了。
collocations: a rainbow｜一道彩虹 ; rainbow colors｜彩虹色
tip_zh: rainbow 是一个词。雨后对着太阳的方向才容易看见。

definition_en: excellent, or very impressive to look at
example1_en: What a splendid catch at the back.
example1_zh: 后场这一接太漂亮了。
example2_en: The splendid view from the tower lasted only until clouds covered the far hills.
example2_zh: 塔上的壮丽景色只持续到云挡住远山为止。
collocations: a splendid idea｜极好的主意 ; splendid scenery｜壮丽的景色
tip_zh: splendid 既可以夸景色，也可以夸主意或表现。语气比 good 强。

meanings_zh: adj. 合适的 | v. 擅自占用；挪用 | v. 拨款；拨出
definition_en: suitable | to take something for your own use without permission | to officially set aside money for a particular purpose
example1_en: Wear appropriate clothes for the interview.
example1_zh: 面试穿合适的衣服。
example2_en: Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
example2_zh: 政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。
collocations: appropriate for｜适合于 ; appropriate measures｜适当措施 ; appropriate behaviour｜得体的行为 ; appropriate funds for｜为……拨款
tip_zh: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

meanings_zh: n. 便利 | n. 便利设施；方便的事物
definition_en: ease of use | Something that makes daily life easier.
example1_en: Online shopping offers great convenience.
example1_zh: 网购提供极大便利。
example2_en: Although online shopping offers convenience, it may encourage unnecessary spending and increase packaging waste.
example2_zh: 虽然网上购物带来了便利，但它可能助长不必要的消费，并增加包装垃圾。
collocations: for convenience｜为了方便 ; at your convenience｜在你方便时 ; modern conveniences｜现代便利设施 ; convenience store｜便利店
tip_zh: 表示“方便”通常不可数；形容词是convenient。

meanings_zh: v. 猛冲 | n. 短跑；冲刺
definition_en: to run somewhere very quickly | a short fast run
example1_en: We dash to the canteen if the break is short.
example1_zh: 课间短的时候，我们冲向食堂。
example2_en: He made a dash for the closing door and still had to wait for the next lift.
example2_zh: 他朝正在关上的门冲过去，结果还是得等下一趟电梯。
collocations: make a dash for｜冲向 ; the 100-meter dash｜百米赛跑
tip_zh: dash 是短而快的跑。a dash of 也可以表示少许，参考表这一行是快跑、冲刺。

definition_en: a person who formally asks for a job, place, or grant
example1_en: Each applicant brought a short form.
example1_zh: 每位申请人都带了一张简表。
example2_en: The club reads every applicant with the same checklist, so a famous school name is not an advantage.
example2_zh: 社团用同一张清单看每位申请人，名校名字并不能加分。
collocations: a job applicant｜求职者 ; screen an applicant｜筛选申请人
word_family: apply (v. 申请) ; application (n. 申请) ; applicable (adj. 适用的)
tip_zh: applicant 是提出申请的人。apply for 是申请。application 是申请书或申请这个行为。

definition_en: the bright burning gas of a fire
example1_en: Keep your sleeve away from the flame.
example1_zh: 袖子离火焰远一点。
example2_en: The flame turned yellow when the air hole was closed, so we opened it again.
example2_zh: 气孔关上时火焰变黄了，于是我们又打开。
collocations: in flames｜燃烧着 ; a flame｜一朵火焰
tip_zh: 参考表还写了「光辉」。本卡先记看得见的火焰。

meanings_zh: adj. 年长的 | n. 长者
definition_en: older, of people in a family | an older person
example1_en: My elder sister starts university this autumn.
example1_zh: 我姐姐今年秋天上大学。
example2_en: The village elders sat at the front and listened to the students' report.
example2_zh: 村里的长者坐在前排，听学生们的汇报。
collocations: elder sister｜姐姐 ; elder brother｜哥哥
tip_zh: 家庭里年长的用 elder：elder sister。更老的物品一般用 older，不用 elder。

meanings_zh: n. 后果 | n. 重要性
definition_en: a result of an action | The quality of being important or worth considering.
example1_en: Every choice has a consequence.
example1_zh: 每个选择都有后果。
example2_en: One serious consequence of rapid urban growth is increased pressure on public transport and housing.
example2_zh: 城市快速扩张的一个严重后果是公共交通和住房承受的压力增大。
collocations: as a consequence｜因此 ; face the consequences｜面对后果 ; of little consequence｜无关紧要
tip_zh: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

definition_en: able to be understood in more than one way
example1_en: The ending is deliberately ambiguous.
example1_zh: 这个结尾是故意写得可以有多种理解的。
example2_en: An ambiguous instruction caused two groups to measure different sides of the same triangle.
example2_zh: 一条有歧义的说明让两个组去量同一个三角形的不同边。
collocations: an ambiguous sentence｜有歧义的句子 ; deliberately ambiguous｜故意含糊
word_family: ambiguity (n. 歧义) ; ambiguously (adv. 含糊地)
tip_zh: ambiguous 是能有两种理解。vague 只是不清楚。名词 ambiguity。

definition_en: to give money or goods to help
example1_en: Our class donated winter coats to the community center.
example1_zh: 我们班把冬衣捐给了社区中心。
example2_en: She donated the prize money to the library so it could buy more science books.
example2_zh: 她把奖金捐给图书馆，用来多买科学书。
collocations: donate sth to｜把某物捐给 ; donate blood｜献血
tip_zh: 参考表没有 donate。donate sth to sb/sth。名词 donation。

definition_en: an activity you do for pleasure
example1_en: The recreation room has a piano and two board games.
example1_zh: 娱乐室里有一架钢琴和两套棋牌。
example2_en: Swimming is his only recreation during exams, twenty minutes and then back to the desk.
example2_zh: 考试期间他唯一的消遣是游泳，游二十分钟再回到书桌前。
collocations: a recreation room｜娱乐室 ; outdoor recreation｜户外娱乐
tip_zh: recreation 是放松的活动。re-creation 加连字符才是「再创造」。

definition_en: a public room where people can sit and relax
example1_en: Passengers wait in the lounge upstairs.
example1_zh: 旅客在楼上的休息室等候。
example2_en: The teachers' lounge has a kettle and a few chairs, but no space for a meeting.
example2_zh: 教师休息室有水壶和几把椅子，但开不了会。
collocations: departure lounge｜候机室 ; teachers' lounge｜教师休息室
tip_zh: lounge 是可以坐着休息的公共房间。动词 lounge about 是闲荡。

definition_en: not occupied or filled
example1_en: The vacant seat is beside the window.
example1_zh: 空位在窗边。
example2_en: A vacant shop on the corner has been empty since winter, and the sign is still up.
example2_zh: 拐角的空店从冬天起就没人，牌子还挂着。
collocations: a vacant seat｜空位 ; a vacant post｜空缺的职位
word_family: vacancy (n. 空位；空房) ; vacate (v. 腾出)
tip_zh: vacant 常指座位、房间、职位空着。名词 vacancy。人离开腾地方是 vacate。

meanings_zh: v. 放弃；遗弃 | v. 放弃；终止 | n. 放纵；无拘无束
definition_en: to leave or give up | To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished. | A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.
example1_en: We had to abandon the plan after the storm.
example1_zh: 暴风雨过后我们不得不放弃那个计划。
example2_en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
example2_zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。
collocations: abandon a vehicle｜弃车 ; abandon a plan｜放弃计划 ; abandon hope｜放弃希望 ; with abandon｜纵情地
tip_zh: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

meanings_zh: n. 行人 | adj. 行人的；平淡的
definition_en: a person walking in the street | for people on foot, or dull
example1_en: A pedestrian waited at the crossing.
example1_zh: 一位行人在人行横道边等着。
example2_en: The pedestrian bridge keeps walkers above the traffic at the school corner.
example2_zh: 天桥让步行的人从学校拐角的车流上方过去。
collocations: a pedestrian crossing｜人行横道 ; pedestrian area｜步行区
tip_zh: 行人是 pedestrian。人行横道是 a pedestrian crossing，美式也说 crosswalk。作形容词还可以表示平淡。

definition_en: of the face
example1_en: The facial cream stung the cut on his cheek.
example1_zh: 这款面部乳膏刺痛了他脸颊上的伤口。
example2_en: Facial expressions in the video told us who was nervous before anyone spoke.
example2_zh: 视频里的面部表情在开口之前就告诉了我们谁紧张。
collocations: facial expression｜面部表情 ; facial hair｜胡须
tip_zh: 参考表写「面部用的」，本卡收作形容词「面部的」。face 是名词。

definition_en: a person who has at least a million pounds or dollars
example1_en: The story's millionaire still rides a bicycle.
example1_zh: 故事里的百万富翁仍然骑自行车。
example2_en: Becoming a millionaire is not the aim of the club; paying for the bus is.
example2_zh: 成为百万富翁不是社团的目标，凑齐车费才是。
collocations: become a millionaire｜成为百万富翁 ; a millionaire businessman｜百万富翁商人
tip_zh: millionaire 是拥有百万（货币）的人。百万这个数是 million。

definition_en: a place where beer is made
example1_en: The old brewery is now a museum.
example1_zh: 那家旧啤酒厂现在是博物馆。
example2_en: Geography class studied how a riverside brewery uses local water, without suggesting that students should drink.
example2_zh: 地理课研究了河边啤酒厂怎样使用当地的水，并没有暗示学生应当去喝。
collocations: a local brewery｜本地啤酒厂 ; brewery tour｜啤酒厂参观
word_family: brew (v. 酿造) ; brewer (n. 酿酒商)
tip_zh: brewery 是生产啤酒的工厂。课堂里把它当产业来讲，不鼓励未成年饮酒。动词是 brew。

definition_en: a school for very young children
example1_en: Kindergarten ends at three in this town.
example1_zh: 这个镇的幼儿园三点放学。
example2_en: The kindergarten keeps a spare coat by the door because the children forget theirs.
example2_zh: 幼儿园在门口放一件备用外套，因为孩子们会忘带自己的。
collocations: a kindergarten teacher｜幼儿教师 ; in kindergarten｜在上幼儿园
word_family: kindergartener (n. 幼儿园小朋友；幼儿教师)
tip_zh: 高考里常把 kindergarten 译成幼儿园。美式多指上一年级前的那一年，大约五岁，不是整个学前阶段。英式幼儿班更常说 nursery。

definition_en: the part of mathematics about shapes and space
example1_en: Geometry homework is on page forty.
example1_zh: 几何作业在第四十页。
example2_en: In geometry we proved that the angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees.
example2_zh: 几何课上我们证明了三角形的内角和是 180 度。
collocations: geometry class｜几何课 ; solid geometry｜立体几何
tip_zh: 几何是 geometry。地理是 geography。两词都长，不要看混。

meanings_zh: adj. 简单明了的；坦率的
definition_en: easy to understand, or honest and direct
example1_en: The instructions are straightforward.
example1_zh: 这些说明简单明了。
example2_en: Give a straightforward answer about the missing key, even if the truth is awkward.
example2_zh: 丢失的钥匙要坦率回答，哪怕实情让人难堪。
collocations: a straightforward task｜一项直截了当的任务 ; straightforward advice｜坦率的建议
word_family: straight (adj. 直的) ; forward (adv. 向前)
antonyms: complicated（复杂的）, roundabout（拐弯抹角的）
tip_zh: straightforward 指不绕弯、好懂。它不是 straight 和 forward 的简单相加，但可以这样帮助记忆。

definition_en: sending out harmful energy from the nucleus of an atom
example1_en: Radioactive samples stay in a locked cupboard.
example1_zh: 放射性样品放在上锁的柜子里。
example2_en: The sign says the waste is radioactive, so students do not open the yellow box.
example2_zh: 牌子写着这些废物有放射性，所以学生不要打开黄盒子。
collocations: radioactive waste｜放射性废物 ; a radioactive element｜放射性元素
word_family: radiation (n. 辐射) ; radioactivity (n. 放射性)
tip_zh: radioactive 形容物质会放出辐射。名词 radioactivity。课堂只讲标志和安全，不涉及武器。

meanings_zh: n. 爪子 | v. 用爪抓
definition_en: a sharp curved nail on an animal's foot | to scratch or tear with claws
example1_en: The crab's claw tapped the glass.
example1_zh: 螃蟹的钳子敲了敲玻璃。
example2_en: The cat may claw the curtain if it is shut in, so we leave the door ajar during the visit.
example2_zh: 猫要是被关在里面，可能会抓窗帘，所以参观时我们让门留一条缝。
collocations: a crab's claw｜蟹钳 ; claw at｜抓
tip_zh: 蟹钳和猫爪都可以叫 claw。动词 claw at 是抓。例句只讲动物，不讲对人使用。

definition_en: the supply of water to land so crops can grow
example1_en: Irrigation keeps the rice field green.
example1_zh: 灌溉让稻田保持青绿。
example2_en: The village plans new irrigation so dry weeks do not ruin the vegetables along the canal.
example2_zh: 村里计划新建灌溉设施，免得连续干旱毁掉水渠边的蔬菜。
collocations: an irrigation canal｜灌溉渠 ; irrigation water｜灌溉用水
word_family: irrigate (v. 灌溉) ; irrigated (adj. 有灌溉的)
tip_zh: irrigation 是名词，动词是 irrigate。它多作不可数名词。

definition_en: a machine that records sound, or a simple wind instrument
example1_en: The recorder captured the whole interview.
example1_zh: 录音机把整段采访录了下来。
example2_en: In music class the recorder is a wind instrument, not the machine on the shelf.
example2_zh: 音乐课上的 recorder 是竖笛，不是架子上那台机器。
collocations: a tape recorder｜磁带录音机 ; play the recorder｜吹竖笛
word_family: record (v. 录制) ; recording (n. 录音)
tip_zh: recorder 在旧课本里多是录音机，在音乐课上常是竖笛。看句子才能确定。动词是 record。

definition_en: to start moving or happening faster
example1_en: The cart began to accelerate downhill.
example1_zh: 小车开始向坡下加速。
example2_en: Extra practice can accelerate progress, but only if the student understands each step first.
example2_zh: 额外练习可以加快进步，但前提是学生先弄懂每一步。
collocations: accelerate the process｜加快进程 ; accelerate away｜加速离开
word_family: acceleration (n. 加速) ; accelerator (n. 加速器；油门)
tip_zh: accelerate 是动词。名词 acceleration 是物理课里的加速度。反义可用 slow down。

definition_en: related to a cube, or measured in cubes
example1_en: The tank holds two cubic metres.
example1_zh: 水箱能装两立方米。
example2_en: Label the carton 240 cubic centimetres after you measure its length, width and height.
example2_zh: 量完长、宽、高之后，在纸箱上标 240 立方厘米。
collocations: a cubic metre｜一立方米 ; cubic centimetre｜立方厘米
tip_zh: 立方米是 a cubic metre。立方体本身是 cube，本库另有一条。

definition_en: a long pole with a sharp point, seen in history or fishing
example1_en: A wooden spear stands in the glass case.
example1_zh: 一支木矛立在玻璃柜里。
example2_en: The coastal chapter shows a fishing spear and explains that families used it to catch fish.
example2_zh: 沿海那一章画着一把鱼叉，并说明人家用它捕鱼。
collocations: a fishing spear｜鱼叉 ; throw a spear｜投矛
word_family: spearhead (n. 矛头；先锋) ; spear (v. 用矛刺)
tip_zh: 高考里 spear 多作名词，出现在历史或渔猎语境。标枪是 javelin，不一定能互换。

definition_en: the rubber ring around a wheel; the British spelling
example1_en: The front tyre is flat.
example1_zh: 前胎瘪了。
example2_en: A worn tyre on the bicycle needs replacing before the long ride, or the rim may bend.
example2_zh: 长途骑行前，自行车上磨旧的轮胎得换掉，不然轮圈可能变形。
collocations: a flat tyre｜瘪了的轮胎 ; spare tyre｜备用轮胎
tip_zh: tyre 是英式「轮胎」。美式拼写 tire 在本库是另一个词，意思是使疲劳，不要当成这条的美式写法去跳转。

definition_en: a soft white or coloured stick for writing on a board
example1_en: Blue chalk marked the diagram.
example1_zh: 蓝色粉笔在图上做了记号。
example2_en: Please leave a spare stick of chalk on the tray, because the afternoon class still has a diagram to draw.
example2_zh: 请在粉笔槽里留一支备用粉笔，下午的班还要画一张图。
collocations: a piece of chalk｜一支粉笔 ; coloured chalk｜彩色粉笔
tip_zh: chalk 作粉笔时多不可数。一支说 a piece of chalk 或 a stick of chalk。

definition_en: a religion based on the teachings of the Buddha
example1_en: Buddhism spread along the trade roads.
example1_zh: 佛教沿着商路传播。
example2_en: The history chapter treats Buddhism as a religion with temples, texts, and festivals, and it asks students to write with respect.
example2_zh: 历史这一章把佛教写成有寺院、典籍和节日的宗教，并要求学生行文保持尊重。
collocations: Tibetan Buddhism｜藏传佛教 ; the spread of Buddhism｜佛教的传播
word_family: Buddhist (n. 佛教徒) ; Buddhist (adj. 佛教的)
tip_zh: Buddhism 是宗教名称，首字母大写。信仰者是 Buddhist。课堂里按历史事实来写，保持尊重。

meanings_zh: v. 敬礼；致敬 | n. 敬礼
definition_en: to raise the hand to the head as a sign of respect, or to honour someone | that sign
example1_en: Soldiers salute when the flag is raised.
example1_zh: 升旗时士兵敬礼。
example2_en: The letter is a salute to the nurses who stayed on duty through the storm.
example2_zh: 这封信向暴风雨中仍然值班的护士致敬。
collocations: salute the flag｜向旗帜敬礼 ; in salute｜以敬礼的方式
tip_zh: salute 可以是军礼，也可以是书面上的致敬。书信开头的称呼是 salutation，比 salute 正式。

definition_en: physical education as a school subject
example1_en: PE is on the field this afternoon.
example1_zh: 今天下午的体育课在操场。
example2_en: Bring trainers for PE, because the hall floor is too smooth for ordinary shoes.
example2_zh: 体育课带运动鞋，礼堂地面太滑，普通鞋不合适。
collocations: a PE lesson｜一节体育课 ; PE kit｜体育服装
word_family: physical education (n. 体育) ; sport (n. 运动)
tip_zh: 考纲里的 PE 就是体育课，读作两个字母。带点的 P.E. 仍在词表里，Zipf 更低，本批不收。

definition_en: a polite title for a man, the full form of Mr
example1_en: Mister Cole coaches the junior team.
example1_zh: 科尔先生执教少年队。
example2_en: Children sometimes say mister when they do not know a man's name, though Mister plus the surname is more polite.
example2_zh: 孩子不知道男士姓名时有时只说 mister，但 Mister 加姓更有礼貌。
collocations: Mister plus a surname｜先生加姓 ; say mister｜称呼先生
tip_zh: 书面几乎总是缩写 Mr，没有句点的美式 Mr 和英式 Mr 都常见。单独喊 Mister 不如加上姓。

meanings_zh: v. 使恢复精力 | v. 刷新
definition_en: to make someone feel fresh again | to load a page or screen again
example1_en: A cold drink can refresh you.
example1_zh: 一杯冷饮能让你恢复精神。
example2_en: Refresh the lab page if the graph vanishes, and wait until the new numbers finish loading.
example2_zh: 如果图表消失了，就刷新实验页面，等新的数字加载完。
collocations: refresh one's memory｜唤起记忆 ; refresh a page｜刷新页面
word_family: refreshing (adj. 提神的) ; refreshment (n. 恢复；茶点) ; refreshed (adj. 恢复了精神的)
tip_zh: refresh 可以是休息后恢复精神，也可以是把网页重新载入。茶点常用复数 refreshments。

meanings_zh: n. 青少年 | adj. 青少年的
definition_en: a young person between childhood and adulthood | relating to that age
example1_en: An adolescent needs more sleep than a rumour suggests.
example1_zh: 青少年需要的睡眠比传闻里说的更多。
example2_en: Adolescent growth can be uneven, so the clinic asks students not to compare heights every week.
example2_zh: 青少年的生长可能不均衡，所以校医室请学生不要每周比身高。
collocations: an adolescent boy｜少年 ; adolescent health｜青少年健康
tip_zh: adolescent 可以是名词或形容词。时期是 adolescence。语气要尊重，不要把这个年龄写成问题本身。

meanings_zh: v. 消化；领会 | n. 摘要
definition_en: to change food in the stomach, or to understand information fully | a short account of a longer text
example1_en: Walk slowly while you digest a large meal.
example1_zh: 大餐之后慢慢走一走，帮助消化。
example2_en: Digest the article tonight, and tomorrow write a digest of no more than eighty words.
example2_zh: 今晚把这篇文章读懂，明天写一篇不超过八十字的摘要。
collocations: digest food｜消化食物 ; a news digest｜新闻摘要
word_family: digestion (n. 消化) ; digestive (adj. 消化的)
tip_zh: 第一义是动词：消化或领会。名词 digest 是文摘、摘要。形容词 digestive，名词 digestion。

definition_en: a disc that stores video or data; the full form of DVD
example1_en: This digital versatile disk holds the photos.
example1_zh: 这张数字多功能光盘存着照片。
example2_en: The library still lends a digital versatile disk of the play, because not every home can stream the file.
example2_zh: 图书馆仍出借这部戏的数字多功能光盘，因为不是每个家庭都能在线播放那个文件。
collocations: a digital versatile disk｜一张数字多功能光盘 ; play a digital versatile disk｜播放光盘
tip_zh: 口语说 DVD。全称是 digital versatile disk，目录 id 用连字符。disk 已在库里。不要把它写成 compact disk，那是另一条。

definition_en: a small animal with a bushy tail
example1_en: A squirrel crossed the bike path.
example1_zh: 一只松鼠穿过了自行车道。
example2_en: The park notice asks visitors not to feed a squirrel, because human snacks can make the animals ill.
example2_zh: 公园告示请参观者不要喂松鼠，因为人吃的零食会让它们生病。
collocations: a red squirrel｜红松鼠 ; a squirrel's tail｜松鼠尾巴
tip_zh: squirrel 的复数是 squirrels。考试里它就是动物，不要写成人名。

definition_en: familiar with something because it has happened often
example1_en: I am accustomed to early drills.
example1_zh: 我已经习惯了清早的操练。
example2_en: New students become accustomed to the timetable within a month, once the bells no longer surprise them.
example2_zh: 新同学大约一个月就会习惯课程表，等铃声不再让他们吃惊。
collocations: accustomed to｜习惯于 ; grow accustomed to｜渐渐习惯
word_family: accustom (v. 使习惯) ; custom (n. 习俗) ; unaccustomed (adj. 不习惯的)
tip_zh: accustomed to 后面接名词或 doing，不接 to do。和 used to do（过去常常）不是同一个结构。

definition_en: a tight roll of tobacco leaves for smoking
example1_en: A cigar is still tobacco.
example1_zh: 雪茄仍然是烟草。
example2_en: The clinic states that a cigar harms the lungs, and the school shop does not sell tobacco to students.
example2_zh: 校医室写明雪茄会伤害肺部，学校商店也不向学生出售烟草。
collocations: a cigar box｜雪茄盒 ; cigar smoke｜雪茄烟
tip_zh: cigar 比 cigarette 更粗，叶子通常不切碎。健康课只讲危害，不把吸烟写成享受。

meanings_zh: adv. 向侧面 | adj. 向侧面的
definition_en: towards one side, not forwards or back | directed to one side
example1_en: The sign had slipped sideways.
example1_zh: 牌子向一边滑了下去。
example2_en: Turn the sofa sideways if you want it through the door, or the legs will catch on the frame.
example2_zh: 想把沙发搬进门，就把它侧过来，不然腿会卡在门框上。
collocations: look sideways｜朝旁边看 ; a sideways glance｜侧目一瞥
tip_zh: sideways 多作副词。也可以放在名词前作形容词：a sideways look。没有 sideway 这个常见形式。

meanings_zh: v. 摔跤 | v. 努力解决
definition_en: to fight by holding and trying to throw someone, as a sport | to struggle to deal with a problem
example1_en: They wrestle on a soft mat.
example1_zh: 他们在软垫上摔跤。
example2_en: I still wrestle with this formula, but writing each step in words makes it less frightening.
example2_zh: 我仍在跟这个公式较劲，但把每一步写成文字之后，它就没那么吓人了。
collocations: wrestle with a problem｜努力解决一个问题 ; wrestle on a mat｜在垫子上摔跤
word_family: wrestler (n. 摔跤运动员) ; wrestling (n. 摔跤)
tip_zh: wrestle 在体育课是摔跤，要用垫子和规则。wrestle with a problem 是费力思考，不是动手。

definition_en: unable to feel, from cold, pressure, or shock
example1_en: My toes went numb in the snow.
example1_zh: 我的脚趾在雪地里麻了。
example2_en: His fingers were numb after the snowball game, so he warmed them before he tried to write.
example2_zh: 打过雪仗后他的手指麻了，所以他先把手暖热再动笔。
collocations: numb with cold｜冻麻了 ; go numb｜变得麻木
word_family: numbness (n. 麻木) ; numbly (adv. 麻木地)
tip_zh: numb 的 b 不发音。可以是身体麻，也可以是震惊后情绪麻木。身体麻得不正常要告诉老师。

definition_en: a tall plant with hard hollow stems
example1_en: Bamboo grows fast beside the wall.
example1_zh: 墙边的竹子长得很快。
example2_en: The craft room uses dried bamboo for frames, and students sand the ends so nobody gets a splinter.
example2_zh: 手工教室用晾干的竹子做框架，学生把末端打磨光滑，免得扎到人。
collocations: a bamboo forest｜竹林 ; bamboo shoots｜竹笋
tip_zh: bamboo 通常不可数，不说 bamboos 来数种类以外的竹子。竹笋是 bamboo shoots。

definition_en: a violent tropical storm in the western Pacific
example1_en: The typhoon closed the ferry.
example1_zh: 台风让渡船停了。
example2_en: During a typhoon, students stay indoors, and the school sends the all-clear before anyone leaves.
example2_zh: 台风期间学生留在室内，学校发出解除信号之后才可以离开。
collocations: typhoon warning｜台风警报 ; the eye of the typhoon｜台风眼
tip_zh: typhoon 主要用于西北太平洋。大西洋的同类风暴常叫 hurricane。作文里写防护，不写追逐风暴。

definition_en: a light inside a frame, often carried or hung at festivals
example1_en: A red lantern hung over the gate.
example1_zh: 一盏红灯笼挂在门上方。
example2_en: Children carried a paper lantern along the river, and adults kept the candles away from loose sleeves.
example2_zh: 孩子们提着纸灯笼沿河走，大人不让烛火靠近松散的袖子。
collocations: a paper lantern｜纸灯笼 ; lantern festival｜元宵节
tip_zh: Lantern Festival 常用来指元宵节。灯笼里如果有火，例句只讲安全，不讲怎么点火。

meanings_zh: v. 承办饮食 | v. 迎合
definition_en: to provide food for a meeting or party | to provide what a particular group wants
example1_en: The canteen can cater for sixty.
example1_zh: 食堂可以承办六十人的伙食。
example2_en: This club caters to quiet readers as well as students who want the stage.
example2_zh: 这个社团既照顾喜欢安静阅读的人，也照顾想上台的学生。
collocations: cater for a party｜为聚会承办饮食 ; cater to a need｜满足一种需要
word_family: caterer (n. 餐饮承办商) ; catering (n. 餐饮服务)
tip_zh: cater for 多指提供饮食。cater to 常指迎合需要。两种介词不要随便换。

meanings_zh: n. 裁缝 | v. 量身定制
definition_en: a person who makes or alters clothes | to make or adapt something for a particular need
example1_en: The tailor shortened both sleeves.
example1_zh: 裁缝把两只袖子都改短了。
example2_en: Teachers tailor the passage to the class, so beginners read a shorter text with the same question.
example2_zh: 老师按班级改写文章，初学者读更短的文本，问题仍然一样。
collocations: a tailor's shop｜裁缝店 ; tailor a course｜按需要调整课程
word_family: tailored (adj. 定做的) ; tailoring (n. 裁缝业)
tip_zh: 名词是做衣服的人。动词 tailor sth to sb 是按对象调整，不限于衣服。

meanings_zh: n. 克隆体 | v. 克隆
definition_en: a living copy grown from one parent | to grow a living copy from one parent
example1_en: This plant clone matches the parent.
example1_zh: 这株克隆植物和母株一样。
example2_en: In the lab lesson, students read how scientists clone a plant from one cell and then compare it with seed-grown plants.
example2_zh: 实验课上，学生读了科学家如何用一个细胞克隆植物，再把它和种子长成的植株比较。
collocations: a plant clone｜植物克隆体 ; clone a cell｜克隆一个细胞
word_family: cloning (n. 克隆) ; cloned (adj. 克隆的)
tip_zh: clone 先是名词「克隆出来的个体」，也可以作动词。课堂里用植物例子即可，不要写成操作步骤。

meanings_zh: n. 妈妈 | n. 木乃伊
definition_en: an informal British word for mother | a preserved body from ancient Egypt
example1_en: Mummy packed an extra apple.
example1_zh: 妈妈多装了一个苹果。
example2_en: The museum mummy lies in a glass case, and the label asks visitors not to use a flash.
example2_zh: 博物馆里的木乃伊躺在玻璃柜中，说明请参观者不要用闪光灯。
collocations: mummy's bag｜妈妈的包 ; an Egyptian mummy｜埃及木乃伊
tip_zh: 英式口语里 mummy 是妈妈，美式常说 mommy。另一个意思是木乃伊。两义都要看上下文。

meanings_zh: n. 钢琴家；钢琴演奏者
definition_en: a person who plays the piano
example1_en: The pianist bowed twice.
example1_zh: 钢琴演奏者鞠了两次躬。
example2_en: A young pianist practised the left hand slowly, then joined the school concert on Sunday.
example2_zh: 一位年轻的钢琴演奏者把左手练得很慢，然后参加了周日的学校音乐会。
collocations: a concert pianist｜音乐会钢琴家 ; pianist's score｜钢琴谱
tip_zh: piano 已在库里。pianist 是演奏的人。英式常读 /ˈpiːənɪst/。

meanings_zh: n. 自助餐 | v. 连续冲击
definition_en: a meal where people serve themselves | to hit repeatedly, as wind or waves do
example1_en: Lunch is a buffet in the hall.
example1_zh: 午饭在大厅里吃自助餐。
example2_en: Strong wind can buffet a tent, so the camp team ties every rope before anyone sleeps.
example2_zh: 大风会一次次冲击帐篷，所以露营队在大家入睡前把每根绳子都系好。
collocations: a buffet lunch｜自助午餐 ; buffet the coast｜冲击海岸
tip_zh: 自助餐的 buffet 英式常读 /ˈbʊfeɪ/，美式常读 /bəˈfeɪ/。动词「冲击」读 /ˈbʌfɪt/。词条音标按自助餐。

meanings_zh: adj. 外向的 | adj. 即将卸任的
definition_en: liking to meet and talk to people | soon to leave a job or position
example1_en: An outgoing student greeted the guests.
example1_zh: 一个外向的学生向客人打了招呼。
example2_en: The outgoing captain handed her notes to the next captain after the final match.
example2_zh: 卸任的队长在最后一场比赛后把笔记交给了下一任队长。
collocations: an outgoing personality｜外向的性格 ; the outgoing president｜即将离任的主席
tip_zh: outgoing 最常见是性格外向。the outgoing chair 是即将离任的主席，和 incoming 相对。

definition_en: a piece of underwear, or a sleeveless jacket
example1_en: He wore a vest under the shirt.
example1_zh: 他在衬衫里面穿了一件汗衫。
example2_en: The orange vest makes the volunteer easy to see when cars pass the school gate.
example2_zh: 橙色背心让志愿者在车辆经过校门时容易被看见。
collocations: a cotton vest｜棉汗衫 ; a safety vest｜安全背心
tip_zh: 英式 vest 常指内衣汗衫。美式 vest 多指西装背心，英式叫 waistcoat。安全背心两边都说 vest。

definition_en: already containing furniture
example1_en: The furnished room includes a desk.
example1_zh: 这间带家具的房间里有一张书桌。
example2_en: A furnished flat costs more each month, but students then need not buy beds before term starts.
example2_zh: 带家具的公寓月租更高，但学生开学前就不必再买床。
collocations: a furnished flat｜带家具的公寓 ; furnished accommodation｜配备家具的住处
word_family: furnish (v. 为……配备家具) ; furniture (n. 家具) ; unfurnished (adj. 不带家具的)
tip_zh: furnished 是已经配了家具。家具的总称 furniture 不可数。反义是 unfurnished。

definition_en: a small strong vehicle for rough roads
example1_en: The jeep climbed the farm track.
example1_zh: 吉普车爬上了农场小路。
example2_en: A green jeep carried the tents as far as the mud, and we walked the rest.
example2_zh: 一辆绿色吉普车把帐篷运到泥地边上，剩下的路我们步行。
collocations: drive a jeep｜开吉普车 ; an army jeep｜军用吉普车
tip_zh: 课本里的 jeep 指适合烂路的小越野车。它原是商标，考试按普通名词理解即可。

meanings_zh: n. 反复的调子 | v. 反复唱；齐声喊
definition_en: words sung or shouted on a few notes | to sing or shout in that way
example1_en: The team chant filled the hall.
example1_zh: 队伍的呼喊声充满了大厅。
example2_en: Students chant the irregular verbs together for two minutes, then write five of them from memory.
example2_zh: 学生把不规则动词齐声念两分钟，再凭记忆写出五个。
collocations: a team chant｜队伍口号 ; chant a phrase｜反复念一个短语
tip_zh: chant 可以是运动会上的口号，也可以是反复吟唱。写作时保持尊重，不拿宗教吟唱开玩笑。

definition_en: a hole for a plug, or a hollow that something fits into
example1_en: The lamp plug fits this socket.
example1_zh: 灯的插头适合这个插座。
example2_en: The ball of the shoulder sits in a small socket, which the biology diagram draws without extra labels.
example2_zh: 肩头的圆头嵌在一个小窝里，生物图上没有再加别的标签。
collocations: a wall socket｜墙上插座 ; an eye socket｜眼窝
tip_zh: socket 在生活里多是电源插座。解剖里 eye socket 是眼窝，shoulder socket 是肩窝。插头是 plug。

definition_en: the money charged for sending a letter or parcel
example1_en: The postage is higher for a parcel.
example1_zh: 包裹的邮资更高。
example2_en: Check the postage before you queue, because a thick envelope may need an extra stamp.
example2_zh: 排队前先看邮资，厚信封可能要再贴一张邮票。
collocations: postage stamp｜邮票 ; postage paid｜邮资已付
word_family: post (v. 邮寄) ; postal (adj. 邮政的)
tip_zh: postage 是寄信的费用，不可数。post 已在库里，可以是邮件、岗位或邮寄。邮票是 postage stamp。

definition_en: without limits or conditions
example1_en: The offer was unconditional.
example1_zh: 这个录取是无条件的。
example2_en: Their support was unconditional, so she could try the new club without having to win first.
example2_zh: 他们的支持没有附加条件，所以她不必先赢一场就可以去试那个新社团。
collocations: unconditional support｜无条件的支持 ; an unconditional offer｜无条件录取
word_family: condition (n. 条件) ; conditionally (adv. 有条件地)
tip_zh: unconditional offer 在英国升学里是无条件录取。反义 conditional。不要漏掉字母 l 前面的结构。

definition_en: not easily convinced; having doubts
example1_en: I am skeptical of that rumour.
example1_zh: 我对那个传闻持怀疑态度。
example2_en: A skeptical reader checks the date and the source before trusting a surprising claim in the paper.
example2_zh: 抱怀疑态度的读者会先核对日期和出处，再相信报上令人吃惊的说法。
collocations: skeptical of｜对……怀疑 ; a skeptical look｜怀疑的神情
word_family: skeptic (n. 怀疑者) ; skepticism (n. 怀疑态度) ; skeptically (adv. 怀疑地)
tip_zh: skeptical of 或 skeptical about 都可以。英式拼写是 sceptical，不在本条里另开词头。

meanings_zh: n. 南极地区 | adj. 南极的
definition_en: the region around the South Pole | relating to that region
example1_en: The Antarctic is covered in ice.
example1_zh: 南极地区覆盖着冰。
example2_en: An Antarctic research station recycles water, which the science article explains with a simple diagram.
example2_zh: 南极科考站会循环用水，科学文章用一张简单的图说明了这一点。
collocations: the Antarctic｜南极地区 ; Antarctic ice｜南极冰
word_family: Antarctica (n. 南极洲) ; Arctic (n. 北极)
tip_zh: the Antarctic 是南极地区。大陆名 Antarctica 多一个 a。北极是 the Arctic，不要写反。首字母通常大写。

definition_en: a wide fast road with no traffic lights
example1_en: The freeway skirts the old town.
example1_zh: 高速公路绕着老城走。
example2_en: Repairs closed one freeway lane, so the team bus left an hour early and still reached the stadium.
example2_zh: 修路封了一条高速车道，球队的车便提前一小时出发，还是赶到了体育场。
collocations: a freeway exit｜高速出口 ; freeway traffic｜高速路车流
synonyms: motorway（高速公路，英式）, expressway（高速公路）
tip_zh: freeway 是美式高速公路。英式常用 motorway。它不是市内普通大街。

definition_en: an open space surrounded by buildings
example1_en: Children read in the courtyard.
example1_zh: 孩子们在院子里读书。
example2_en: The hotel courtyard stays quiet at night, which makes it a good place to revise before bed.
example2_zh: 旅馆的庭院夜里很安静，适合睡前复习。
collocations: a hotel courtyard｜旅馆庭院 ; across the courtyard｜穿过院子
word_family: court (n. 庭院；法庭) ; yard (n. 院子)
tip_zh: courtyard 是建筑物围起来的院子。court 还可以是法庭或球场，不要只记一个意思。

definition_en: a close-fitting covering for the foot and leg
example1_en: A stocking hung by the fireplace.
example1_zh: 一只长筒袜挂在壁炉边。
example2_en: She bought a thicker stocking for the play, because the stage lights made the thin pair look pale.
example2_zh: 她为演出买了更厚的长筒袜，因为舞台灯会让薄的那双看起来发白。
collocations: a pair of stockings｜一双长筒袜 ; a Christmas stocking｜圣诞袜
tip_zh: stocking 比 sock 长。圣诞传统里也会把礼物放进 a Christmas stocking。通常说 a pair of stockings。

definition_en: an adult female chicken
example1_en: A brown hen guarded twelve eggs.
example1_zh: 一只褐色母鸡守着十二个蛋。
example2_en: A hen in the school garden lays eggs for the cooking class, and students do not chase her.
example2_zh: 学校园子里的母鸡给烹饪课下蛋，学生不去追它。
collocations: a hen house｜鸡舍 ; hen and chicks｜母鸡和小鸡
tip_zh: hen 是母鸡。公鸡是 rooster 或 cock。鸡的总称是 chicken。

definition_en: the force that slows sliding, or disagreement between people
example1_en: Friction keeps the shoes from sliding.
example1_zh: 摩擦力让鞋不打滑。
example2_en: Friction between the two clubs faded after they shared the same practice hour.
example2_zh: 两个社团之间的摩擦在共用同一个训练时段之后消退了。
collocations: friction between｜……之间的摩擦或不和 ; reduce friction｜减小摩擦
tip_zh: 物理里 friction 是摩擦力。人与人之间的摩擦、不和也用这个词。

meanings_zh: n. 害虫 | n. 讨厌的人
definition_en: an insect or animal that damages crops or homes | a person who keeps annoying others
example1_en: Aphids are a pest on the beans.
example1_zh: 蚜虫是豆子上的害虫。
example2_en: Calling a classmate a pest is unkind; talk about the behaviour, not a label that sticks.
example2_zh: 把同学叫做讨厌鬼并不友善；要谈具体行为，不要贴一个甩不掉的标签。
collocations: a garden pest｜园中害虫 ; pest control｜害虫防治
tip_zh: pest 在生物课是害虫。用来骂人很不礼貌，作文里要慎重。农药是 pesticide。

meanings_zh: n. 韵；押韵词 | v. 押韵
definition_en: a word with the same ending sound as another | to have the same ending sound
example1_en: Cat and hat form a rhyme.
example1_zh: cat 和 hat 押韵。
example2_en: Time does not rhyme with team, so the poem's last line had to change before the show.
example2_zh: time 和 team 不押韵，所以演出前诗的最后一行得改。
collocations: a nursery rhyme｜童谣 ; rhyme with｜与……押韵
word_family: rhyming (adj. 押韵的) ; rhyme scheme (n. 韵式)
tip_zh: 名词 rhyme 是韵，动词 rhyme with 是与某个词押韵。nursery rhyme 是童谣。不要写成 rime。

meanings_zh: v. 腐烂 | n. 腐烂
definition_en: to decay through natural change | decay in wood, fruit, or other matter
example1_en: Those apples rot in a warm box.
example1_zh: 那些苹果在暖和的盒子里会烂。
example2_en: Gardeners cut the rot out of the branch so the healthy wood can dry before the next rain.
example2_zh: 园丁把树枝上烂掉的部分削掉，好让健康的木头在下一场雨前晾干。
collocations: rot away｜烂掉 ; stop the rot｜阻止腐烂
word_family: rotten (adj. 腐烂的) ; rotting (n. 腐烂)
tip_zh: 动词过去式 rotted。形容词是 rotten，不是 roted。名词 the rot 指已经烂掉的部分。

definition_en: a game in which players mark numbers and shout when they finish
example1_en: Bingo night is in the school hall.
example1_zh: 宾戈之夜在学校礼堂。
example2_en: She shouted bingo only after checking every number against the card in her hand.
example2_zh: 她对照手里的卡片核对了每个数字，才喊宾戈。
collocations: play bingo｜玩宾戈 ; a bingo card｜宾戈卡
tip_zh: 喊 Bingo! 表示这一张卡完成了。它是游戏名，也是那一声喊。

meanings_zh: n. 附录 | n. 阑尾
definition_en: extra information at the end of a book | a small organ attached to the large intestine
example1_en: The appendix lists every source.
example1_zh: 附录列出了每一条出处。
example2_en: Pain near the appendix needs a doctor, so he stopped the race and called the school clinic.
example2_zh: 阑尾附近疼就要看医生，于是他停了比赛并联系校医室。
collocations: in the appendix｜在附录里 ; appendix pain｜阑尾部位的疼痛
word_family: append (v. 附加) ; appendices (n. 附录，复数)
tip_zh: appendix 既是书后附录，也是阑尾。书的复数常用 appendices，器官复数是 appendixes。身体疼痛告诉老师，不要自己判断。

definition_en: a flat plastic disc that stores music or data
example1_en: This compact disk holds the whole concert.
example1_zh: 这张光盘装着整场音乐会。
example2_en: Scratch a compact disk and the last song may jump, so keep it in the case.
example2_zh: 光盘划伤了，最后一首歌可能会跳，所以放回盒子里。
collocations: a compact disk player｜光盘播放机 ; on compact disk｜以光盘形式
word_family: disk (n. 磁盘；光盘) ; CD (n. 光盘，缩写)
tip_zh: 考纲写 compact disk，两个词。缩写 CD 已在库里。disk 的美式拼写也已单列。

definition_en: a large black-and-white animal from China
example1_en: The panda chewed a bamboo stalk.
example1_zh: 熊猫嚼着一根竹子。
example2_en: Visitors may photograph the panda, but they must stay behind the rail and must not tap the glass.
example2_zh: 参观者可以给熊猫拍照，但必须站在栏杆外，也不能敲玻璃。
collocations: a giant panda｜大熊猫 ; panda habitat｜熊猫栖息地
tip_zh: giant panda 是大熊猫。red panda 是小熊猫，不是同一种动物。

definition_en: relating to plants or the scientific study of them
example1_en: The botanical garden opens at nine.
example1_zh: 植物园九点开门。
example2_en: A botanical drawing shows roots as well as flowers, which the art teacher asked the class to notice.
example2_zh: 植物学绘图会把根和花都画出来，美术老师让全班注意这一点。
collocations: a botanical garden｜植物园 ; botanical name｜植物学名
word_family: botany (n. 植物学) ; botanist (n. 植物学家)
tip_zh: botanical garden 是植物园。学科是 botany。它是形容词，后面要接名词。
